<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>World Sandbox v0.4 — Full World Historical Atlas</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net" crossorigin>
<link rel="dns-prefetch" href="//cdn.jsdelivr.net">
<link rel="preload" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/world-atlas@2.0.2/countries-110m.json" as="fetch" crossorigin="anonymous">
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cinzel:wght@600;900&family=Crimson+Pro:ital,wght@0,400;0,600;1,400&display=swap');
*,*::before,*::after{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#0d1f2d}
canvas{display:block;cursor:crosshair;position:fixed;inset:0}
#base-c{z-index:0;pointer-events:none;cursor:default}
#map-c{display:none!important;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;cursor:default}
#c{z-index:2}
#label-c{z-index:3;pointer-events:none;cursor:default;transform-origin:0 0}
#fx-c{z-index:4;pointer-events:none;cursor:default}

/* ══ MAP EDITOR ══ */
/* Transparent overlay that sits above the canvas, captures all pointer events */
#ed-capture{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:800;display:none;cursor:crosshair;}
#ed-capture.active{display:block;}
#map-editor{position:fixed;left:0;top:44px;width:222px;max-height:calc(100vh - 54px);overflow-y:auto;background:rgba(7,4,1,.97);backdrop-filter:blur(18px);border-right:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.24);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.18);border-radius:0 0 10px 0;z-index:820;transform:translateX(-226px);transition:transform .22s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);pointer-events:none;scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:rgba(200,140,50,.18) transparent}
#map-editor.open{transform:translateX(0);pointer-events:auto}
#map-editor::-webkit-scrollbar{width:3px}
#map-editor::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:rgba(200,140,50,.18);border-radius:2px}
#ed-header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:11px 14px 9px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.14);flex-shrink:0}
#ed-title{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:#f0c060;letter-spacing:2px}
#ed-close-btn{background:none;border:none;color:#a08040;font-size:17px;cursor:pointer;padding:0 2px;line-height:1;transition:color .1s}
#ed-close-btn:hover{color:#f0a030}
#ed-tools{display:flex;gap:5px;padding:9px 10px 7px}
.ed-tool-btn{flex:1;font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:9px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.8px;padding:7px 4px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .11s;border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.28);background:rgba(20,14,5,.7);color:#b09050;user-select:none;text-align:center}
.ed-tool-btn:hover{border-color:rgba(240,160,40,.45);color:#c0a060;background:rgba(38,24,8,.8)}
.ed-tool-btn.active{border-color:#f0a030;background:rgba(60,38,10,.85);color:#f8d860;box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(240,150,30,.18)}
.ed-sec-label{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:2px;color:#b09060;padding:5px 13px 3px}
#ed-search{display:block;width:calc(100% - 22px);margin:0 11px 5px;background:rgba(16,10,3,.85);border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.18);border-radius:6px;padding:6px 10px;font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-size:12px;color:#d0b070;outline:none;box-sizing:border-box}
#ed-search::placeholder{color:#b09060}
#ed-search:focus{border-color:rgba(240,160,40,.4)}
#ed-create-nation{margin:2px 11px 9px;padding:9px;background:rgba(34,22,7,.72);border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.2);border-radius:7px}
#ed-create-title{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:1.7px;color:#d0a34f;margin-bottom:6px}
#ed-new-name{width:100%;background:rgba(12,8,2,.88);border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.22);border-radius:5px;padding:6px 8px;font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-size:12px;color:#e0c080;outline:none;margin-bottom:6px}
#ed-new-name:focus{border-color:rgba(240,160,40,.5)}
#ed-new-name::placeholder{color:#846b46}
#ed-new-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
#ed-new-color{width:36px;height:30px;padding:2px;border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.3);border-radius:5px;background:#100a03;cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0}
#ed-new-create{flex:1;font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:8px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:1px;padding:8px 6px;border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid rgba(90,190,90,.34);background:rgba(17,55,14,.8);color:#8fd176;transition:all .12s}
#ed-new-create:hover{background:rgba(26,78,20,.9);border-color:rgba(110,220,100,.55);color:#b0ef94}
#ed-new-status{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-size:10px;color:#9a8050;min-height:12px;margin-top:5px;line-height:1.2}
#ed-new-status.ok{color:#76be63}
#ed-new-status.err{color:#d06b5d}
#ed-alliance-editor{margin:2px 11px 9px;padding:9px;background:rgba(18,25,38,.72);border:1px solid rgba(90,140,210,.24);border-radius:7px}
.ed-al-title{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:1.6px;color:#7fb3e8;margin-bottom:6px}
.ed-al-input,.ed-al-select{width:100%;background:rgba(8,12,20,.9);border:1px solid rgba(100,150,220,.24);border-radius:5px;padding:6px 7px;color:#b8d5ee;font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-size:11px;outline:none;margin-bottom:5px}
.ed-al-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:5px}.ed-al-btn{border:1px solid rgba(100,150,220,.28);border-radius:5px;padding:6px 4px;background:rgba(15,35,58,.75);color:#8fc0eb;font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:6.5px;letter-spacing:.5px;cursor:pointer}.ed-al-btn:hover{border-color:#78b8ef;color:#d2eaff}.ed-al-btn.danger{border-color:rgba(210,80,70,.3);background:rgba(60,16,14,.66);color:#df7d70}
#ed-al-members{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-size:10px;line-height:1.35;color:#99b7d0;margin:5px 0;min-height:14px;max-height:60px;overflow:auto}.ed-al-status{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-size:10px;color:#88a9c5;min-height:12px;margin-top:5px}.ed-al-status.err{color:#d9796b}.ed-al-status.ok{color:#78c47d}
#ed-nation-list{padding:0 7px 5px;scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:rgba(200,140,50,.12) transparent}
#ed-nation-list::-webkit-scrollbar{width:3px}
#ed-nation-list::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:rgba(200,140,50,.12);border-radius:2px}
.ed-nitem{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:5px 7px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .09s;border:1px solid transparent;user-select:none}
.ed-nitem:hover{background:rgba(38,24,8,.65);border-color:rgba(200,140,50,.12)}
.ed-nitem.active{background:rgba(55,35,8,.85);border-color:rgba(240,160,40,.32)}
.ed-ndot{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;border:1.5px solid rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.ed-nname{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-size:11.5px;color:#c0a060;flex:1;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.ed-nitem.active .ed-nname{color:#f0d080}
.ed-nprovs{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:8px;color:#8a7050;letter-spacing:.5px;flex-shrink:0}
#ed-divider{height:1px;background:rgba(200,140,50,.1);margin:7px 11px}
#ed-export-section{padding:6px 11px 13px}
#ed-export-btn{width:100%;font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:9px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:1.5px;padding:9px 0;border-radius:7px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .12s;border:1px solid rgba(100,200,80,.28);background:rgba(18,46,13,.75);color:#68c058}
#ed-export-btn:hover{background:rgba(28,66,20,.85);border-color:rgba(100,200,80,.5);color:#88e070}
#ed-status{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:10px;color:#9a8050;text-align:center;padding:4px 0 0;min-height:14px;transition:color .2s}
#ed-brush-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:4px 11px 7px}
#ed-brush-label{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:1.5px;color:#b09060;white-space:nowrap}
#ed-brush-val{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:9px;color:#c0a060;width:14px;text-align:right;flex-shrink:0}
#ed-brush-slider{flex:1;-webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;height:3px;background:rgba(200,140,50,.18);border-radius:2px;outline:none;cursor:pointer}
#ed-brush-slider::-webkit-slider-thumb{-webkit-appearance:none;width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:#c0902a;border:2px solid #f0c060;cursor:pointer}
#ed-brush-slider::-moz-range-thumb{width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;background:#c0902a;border:2px solid #f0c060;cursor:pointer}
/* instruction banner shown when no nation selected */
#ed-instruction{margin:0 11px 6px;padding:8px 10px;background:rgba(240,160,40,.08);border:1px solid rgba(240,160,40,.2);border-radius:6px;font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-size:11.5px;color:#c09040;text-align:center;line-height:1.4}
#ed-instruction.hidden{display:none}
#ed-bar-badge{display:none;font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:2px;color:#f0a030;background:rgba(55,34,8,.9);border:1px solid rgba(240,150,30,.35);border-radius:4px;padding:3px 8px;flex-shrink:0}
#ed-bar-badge.vis{display:inline-block}

#ed-exit-btn{width:100%;margin-top:6px;font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:9px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:1.5px;padding:9px 0;border-radius:7px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .12s;border:1px solid rgba(200,80,60,.35);background:rgba(50,12,8,.7);color:#d06050}
#ed-exit-btn:hover{background:rgba(80,18,12,.9);border-color:rgba(220,80,60,.6);color:#ff8070}

/* ── LOAD SCREEN ── */
#loadScreen{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9000;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 55%,#1c1005,#050303);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:16px}
#loadScreen h1{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:52px;font-weight:900;color:#f0c060;letter-spacing:8px;text-shadow:0 0 50px rgba(240,150,30,.55),0 3px 0 #3a1800}
#loadScreen .sub{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:17px;color:#b09060;letter-spacing:4px}
#loadBar{width:320px;height:5px;background:rgba(255,200,80,.1);border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden}
#loadFill{height:100%;width:0%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#c05500,#f09020,#f8e060);border-radius:3px;transition:width .18s}
#loadMsg{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-size:13px;color:#9a8050;letter-spacing:1px;min-height:18px}
#loadMascot{display:block;width:min(220px,42vw);height:auto;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 24px rgba(255,170,210,.22)) drop-shadow(0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.32));user-select:none;pointer-events:none}

/* ── CIVILISATION SELECT SCREEN ── */
#selScreen{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:8000;background:rgba(4,2,1,.97);display:none;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;overflow:hidden}
#selScreen.open{display:flex}
#sel-top{padding:28px 36px 0;flex-shrink:0}
#sel-top h2{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:28px;font-weight:900;color:#f0c060;letter-spacing:6px;margin-bottom:4px}
#sel-top p{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:14px;color:#9a8050;letter-spacing:2px;margin-bottom:18px}
#sel-search{background:rgba(20,14,5,.8);border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.22);border-radius:7px;padding:9px 14px;font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-size:14px;color:#d0b070;outline:none;width:280px;margin-bottom:16px}
#sel-search::placeholder{color:#8a7050}
#sel-search:focus{border-color:rgba(240,160,40,.5)}
#sel-grid{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:0 28px 20px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(190px,1fr));gap:9px;align-content:start}
#sel-grid::-webkit-scrollbar{width:5px}
#sel-grid::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:transparent}
#sel-grid::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:rgba(200,140,50,.25);border-radius:3px}
.sel-card{background:rgba(18,12,4,.8);border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.14);border-radius:9px;padding:13px 14px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .13s;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;user-select:none}
.sel-card:hover{background:rgba(38,24,8,.85);border-color:rgba(240,160,40,.4);transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 6px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.sel-card.active{border-color:#f0a030;background:rgba(60,38,10,.8);box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(240,150,30,.2)}
.sel-cname{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:#e0c080;letter-spacing:.5px}
.sel-meta{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-size:11px;color:#9a8050;display:flex;gap:10px}
.sel-dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;margin-top:3px;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.sel-row{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:9px}
#sel-bot{flex-shrink:0;padding:14px 28px 22px;display:flex;gap:10px;border-top:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.1);background:rgba(6,4,1,.9)}
.sel-btn{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:2px;padding:11px 22px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .13s;border:1px solid}
#sel-play{background:rgba(120,75,15,.8);border-color:#f0a030;color:#f8d860}
#sel-play:hover{background:#c08820;box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(240,150,30,.35)}
#sel-play:disabled{opacity:.35;cursor:default}
#sel-spec{background:rgba(20,35,60,.7);border-color:#4477cc;color:#88aaee}
#sel-spec:hover{background:rgba(30,55,100,.8)}
#sel-sand{background:rgba(25,40,20,.7);border-color:#4a9a4a;color:#80cc80}
#sel-sand:hover{background:rgba(35,60,30,.8)}
#sel-chosen{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:13px;color:#b09060;margin-left:auto;align-self:center}

/* ── SCENARIO PICKER ── */
#scen-bar{flex-shrink:0;padding:0 28px 0;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:10px}
.scen-btn{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:1.5px;padding:7px 13px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .13s;border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.22);background:rgba(18,12,4,.7);color:#a08858;white-space:nowrap;user-select:none}
.scen-btn:hover{border-color:rgba(240,160,40,.5);color:#c0a060;background:rgba(38,24,8,.85)}
.scen-btn.active{border-color:#f0a030;background:rgba(60,38,10,.85);color:#f0d060;box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(240,150,30,.18)}
.scen-label{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:9px;color:#b09060;letter-spacing:2px;margin-right:4px;white-space:nowrap}
#scen-desc{flex-shrink:0;padding:0 28px 8px;font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:12px;color:#9a8050;letter-spacing:.5px;min-height:18px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.08);margin-bottom:4px}

/* ── TOP BAR ── */
#top-bar{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:44px;z-index:600;background:rgba(8,5,2,.97);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.22);display:none;align-items:center;padding:0 10px;gap:0;box-shadow:0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.55);pointer-events:auto}
#top-bar.game-visible{display:flex}
/* Civ identity */
#tb-civ{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding-right:14px;border-right:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.18);flex-shrink:0}
#hud-dot{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;border:1.5px solid rgba(0,0,0,.4);background:#888}
#hud-civname{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;color:#f0a030;letter-spacing:1.5px;white-space:nowrap}
/* Resources strip */
#tb-res{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2px;flex:1;padding:0 10px;overflow:hidden}
.tr{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:5px;background:rgba(20,14,5,.55);border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.12);flex-shrink:0}
.tr-icon{font-size:13px;line-height:1}
.tr-val{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;color:#f0d090;min-width:28px;text-align:right}
/* View toggles — icon pills */
#tb-views{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:0 10px;border-left:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.18);border-right:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.18);flex-shrink:0}
.tvb{width:30px;height:28px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.14);background:rgba(25,17,8,.7);font-size:14px;transition:all .12s;opacity:.45;user-select:none;text-decoration:none}
.tvb.on{opacity:1;border-color:rgba(200,140,50,.4);background:rgba(40,27,10,.9);box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(240,150,30,.18)}
.tvb:hover{opacity:1;border-color:rgba(240,150,30,.5)}
/* Speed controls */
#tb-speed{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding-left:10px;flex-shrink:0}
.spd-btn{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.5px;padding:4px 9px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .12s;border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.18);background:rgba(20,14,5,.7);color:#9a8050;user-select:none;min-width:30px;text-align:center}
.spd-btn:hover{border-color:rgba(240,160,40,.5);color:#c0a060;background:rgba(38,24,8,.85)}
.spd-btn.active{border-color:#f0a030;background:rgba(60,38,10,.85);color:#f8d860;box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(240,150,30,.2)}
.spd-btn.pause.active{border-color:#e05050;background:rgba(60,10,10,.85);color:#ff8080;box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(220,50,50,.25)}
#time-date{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:9px;color:#a08040;letter-spacing:1.5px;min-width:62px;text-align:center}
#hud-mode{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:2px;color:#9a8050;padding-left:6px;white-space:nowrap}

/* ── PROVINCE PANEL — slides from right, below top bar ── */
#pp{position:fixed;top:44px;right:0;width:266px;max-height:calc(100vh - 54px);overflow-y:auto;background:rgba(8,5,2,.97);backdrop-filter:blur(18px);border-left:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.24);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.18);border-radius:0 0 0 10px;z-index:590;transform:translateX(270px);transition:transform .22s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);pointer-events:auto}
#pp.open{transform:translateX(0)}
.pp-hdr{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:11px 14px 9px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.12)}
.pp-cdot{width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;border:1.5px solid rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.pp-title{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:#f0c060;flex:1;letter-spacing:.5px}
.pp-sub{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-size:11px;color:#a08858;margin-top:1px}
.pp-cls{background:none;border:none;color:#a08040;font-size:18px;cursor:pointer;padding:0 2px;line-height:1;flex-shrink:0}
.pp-cls:hover{color:#f0a030}
.pp-srow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.09);flex-wrap:wrap}
.pp-badge{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1.5px;padding:3px 7px;border-radius:3px;border:1px solid}
.pp-badge.owned{color:#6ad06a;border-color:rgba(100,200,80,.35);background:rgba(60,120,40,.18)}
.pp-badge.enemy{color:#e07060;border-color:rgba(200,80,60,.35);background:rgba(80,30,20,.18)}
.pp-badge.adj{color:#f0c060;border-color:rgba(240,160,30,.4);background:rgba(80,50,10,.25)}
.pp-badge.neutral{color:#888;border-color:rgba(150,150,150,.25);background:rgba(50,50,50,.15)}
.pp-owner{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-size:11px;margin-left:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px}
.pp-odot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.pp-clmbtn{background:rgba(80,50,8,.7);border:1px solid rgba(240,150,30,.4);color:#f0c060;padding:5px 11px;border-radius:6px;font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .12s;margin-left:auto}
.pp-clmbtn:hover{background:rgba(120,75,15,.8);border-color:#f0a030}
.pp-clmbtn:disabled{opacity:.35;cursor:default}
.pp-war-wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-left:auto}.pp-war-select{background:rgba(18,12,5,.94);border:1px solid rgba(240,150,30,.38);color:#f0c060;padding:5px 7px;border-radius:6px;font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-size:11px;max-width:138px}.pp-war-select:focus{outline:1px solid #f0a030}.pp-war-wrap .pp-clmbtn{margin-left:0}
.tech-tier-10{border-color:rgba(70,190,255,.62)!important;box-shadow:inset 0 0 18px rgba(30,120,220,.10)}.tech-tier-11{border-color:rgba(185,90,255,.68)!important;box-shadow:inset 0 0 18px rgba(140,45,220,.12)}.tech-tier-12{border-color:rgba(255,80,175,.72)!important;box-shadow:inset 0 0 20px rgba(230,35,135,.13)}.tech-row-label.tier-10,.tech-mil-arrow.tier-10{color:#55c8ff}.tech-row-label.tier-11,.tech-mil-arrow.tier-11{color:#c778ff}.tech-row-label.tier-12,.tech-mil-arrow.tier-12{color:#ff63b8}
.pp-tabs{display:flex;padding:8px 10px 0;gap:5px}
.pp-tab{flex:1;background:rgba(25,17,8,.5);border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.12);color:#a08858;padding:6px 0;border-radius:6px 6px 0 0;cursor:pointer;font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-size:12px;transition:all .12s;border-bottom:none}
.pp-tab:hover{color:#c0a060}
.pp-tab.on{background:rgba(40,27,8,.9);border-color:rgba(200,140,50,.3);color:#f0c060;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(8,5,2,.97)}
.pp-content{padding:10px 12px 14px;display:none}
.pp-content.on{display:block}
.pp-locked{text-align:center;padding:18px 0;font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-style:italic;color:#8a7050;font-size:12px}
.pp-bld{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:8px 9px;border-radius:7px;margin-bottom:6px;background:rgba(20,14,5,.6);border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.1);transition:background .1s}
.pp-bld:hover{background:rgba(30,20,8,.8)}
.pp-bic{font-size:18px;width:24px;text-align:center;flex-shrink:0}
.pp-binfo{flex:1;min-width:0}
.pp-bname{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:10px;color:#c0a060;letter-spacing:.5px}
.pp-brate{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-size:11px;color:#7aa870;margin-top:1px}
.pp-bright{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;gap:4px;flex-shrink:0}
.pp-lvs{display:flex;gap:3px}
.pp-lv{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(100,80,40,.25);border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.2)}
.pp-lv.on{background:#c88020;border-color:#f0a030;box-shadow:0 0 4px rgba(240,150,30,.4)}
.pp-upg{background:rgba(50,32,8,.7);border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.25);color:#c09040;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:5px;font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-size:10px;cursor:pointer;text-align:center;line-height:1.4;transition:all .12s;white-space:nowrap}
.pp-upg:hover{background:rgba(80,50,12,.8);border-color:#f0a030;color:#f0c060}
.pp-upg:disabled{opacity:.32;cursor:default}
.pp-maxlv{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:10px;color:#7aa870;padding:4px 6px}
.pp-sect{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:9px;color:#a08040;letter-spacing:1.5px;padding:6px 2px 4px;margin-top:2px}
/* Recruit slider UI */
.rc-wrap{padding:8px 0}
.rc-tier-row{display:flex;gap:5px;margin-bottom:10px}
.rc-tier{flex:1;padding:6px 4px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.18);background:rgba(20,14,5,.7);text-align:center;transition:all .12s;font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-size:11px;color:#a08858}
.rc-tier.sel{border-color:#f0a030;background:rgba(60,38,10,.85);color:#f0c060}
.rc-tier:hover:not(.sel){border-color:rgba(240,160,40,.4);color:#c0a060}
.rc-icon{font-size:16px;display:block;margin-bottom:2px}
.rc-name{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.3px}
.rc-slider-wrap{padding:4px 0 8px}
.rc-slider-label{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-size:11px;color:#8a7050;margin-bottom:5px}
.rc-count{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:#f0d090}
input[type=range].rc-slider{width:100%;accent-color:#f0a030;cursor:pointer;margin:2px 0}
.rc-cost-strip{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-size:11px;color:#b09060;background:rgba(20,14,5,.5);border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.12);border-radius:5px;padding:5px 8px;margin:4px 0 8px;display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.rc-cost-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3px}
.rc-cost-item.ok{color:#80c060}
.rc-cost-item.no{color:#e06040}
.rc-recruit-btn{width:100%;padding:8px;border-radius:7px;font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:1.5px;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid rgba(240,150,30,.5);background:rgba(80,50,10,.8);color:#f0c060;transition:all .13s}
.rc-recruit-btn:hover:not(:disabled){background:rgba(120,75,15,.9);border-color:#f0c060;box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(240,150,30,.25)}
.rc-recruit-btn:disabled{opacity:.35;cursor:default}
.rc-max-btn{width:100%;padding:7px;border-radius:7px;font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:9px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:1.5px;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid rgba(100,200,80,.4);background:rgba(20,60,10,.8);color:#80cc60;transition:all .13s;margin-top:5px}
.rc-max-btn:hover:not(:disabled){background:rgba(30,90,15,.9);border-color:#80cc60;box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(80,200,50,.2)}
.rc-max-btn:disabled{opacity:.35;cursor:default}

/* ── GENERAL / EMPIRE SIDEBAR ── */
#gen-bar{position:fixed;top:44px;left:0;width:220px;height:calc(100vh - 44px);display:none;flex-direction:column;background:rgba(8,5,2,.97);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);border-right:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.28);z-index:580;pointer-events:auto;overflow:hidden}
#gen-bar.game-visible{display:flex}
#gen-toggle{display:none!important}

/* Flag banner — REMOVED */

/* Tab bar */
#gb-tabs{display:flex;flex-shrink:0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.22)}
.gb-tab{flex:1;background:rgba(14,9,3,.8);border:none;color:#9a8050;font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:8.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.5px;padding:8px 2px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .12s;border-right:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.14)}
.gb-tab:last-child{border-right:none}
.gb-tab:hover{color:#c0a060;background:rgba(30,20,8,.9)}
.gb-tab.active{background:rgba(40,27,8,.95);color:#f0c060;border-bottom:2px solid #f0a030}

/* Tab content panels */
.gb-tab-content{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;display:none}
.gb-tab-content.active{display:block}
.gb-tab-content::-webkit-scrollbar{width:4px}
.gb-tab-content::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:transparent}
.gb-tab-content::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:rgba(200,140,50,.2);border-radius:2px}

/* Building upgrade rows */
.gb-sect{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:8px;color:#f0a030;letter-spacing:2px;padding:8px 12px 3px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.1)}
.gb-subhead{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:7.5px;color:#a08040;letter-spacing:1.5px;padding:5px 12px 3px}
.gb-mass{margin:4px 8px;border-radius:7px;border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.22);background:rgba(20,14,5,.7);overflow:hidden}
.gb-mass-hdr{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:7px 9px}
.gb-mass-icon{font-size:16px;flex-shrink:0}
.gb-mass-info{flex:1;min-width:0}
.gb-mass-name{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:9px;color:#c0a060;letter-spacing:.3px}
.gb-mass-sub{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-size:10px;color:#7aa870;margin-top:1px}
.gb-mass-btn{background:rgba(50,32,8,.8);border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.3);color:#c09040;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:5px;font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0;transition:all .12s;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:0}
.gb-mass-btn:hover:not(:disabled){background:rgba(80,50,12,.9);border-color:#f0a030;color:#f0c060}
.gb-mass-btn:disabled{opacity:.28;cursor:default}
.gb-mass-all{margin:4px 8px 8px;width:calc(100% - 16px);padding:6px;border-radius:6px;font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:8px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:1.5px;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.3);background:rgba(40,27,8,.8);color:#c0a060;transition:all .13s}
.gb-mass-all:hover:not(:disabled){background:rgba(80,50,12,.9);border-color:#f0d060;color:#f8e080;box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(240,150,30,.2)}
.gb-mass-all:disabled{opacity:.28;cursor:default}
.gb-divider{height:1px;background:rgba(200,140,50,.12);margin:4px 0}

/* Technology placeholder */
.gb-tech-placeholder{padding:28px 16px;text-align:center;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.gb-tech-icon{font-size:36px;opacity:.4}
.gb-tech-title{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:10px;color:#f0a030;letter-spacing:2px;opacity:.6}
.gb-tech-msg{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:11px;color:#8a7050;line-height:1.5}
.gb-tech-badge{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:1.5px;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.3);color:#c0a060;background:rgba(20,14,5,.5)}

/* ── FLAG BANNER ── */
#gb-flag-banner{flex-shrink:0;height:62px;background:rgba(6,4,1,.98);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.28);display:flex;align-items:center;padding:6px 10px;gap:9px}
#gb-flag-canvas{width:76px;height:46px;border-radius:3px;border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.32);flex-shrink:0;display:block}
#gb-flag-civname{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:8.5px;color:#f0c060;letter-spacing:.8px;flex:1;text-align:center;line-height:1.4;overflow:hidden;word-break:break-word}

/* ── ALLIANCE WIDGET ── */
.gb-alliance-wrap{padding:8px 9px}
.gb-alliance-header{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:9px;color:#f0a030;letter-spacing:2px;padding:6px 0 4px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.15);margin-bottom:7px}
.gb-alliance-status-row{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:11px;color:#b09060;line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:6px;min-height:16px}
.gb-alliance-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:8px;color:#f0d060;letter-spacing:.8px;padding:2px 7px;border:1px solid rgba(240,160,40,.45);border-radius:4px;background:rgba(50,32,8,.8);margin-bottom:5px}
.gb-alliance-badge .ab-crown{font-size:10px}
.gb-alliance-name-input{width:100%;background:rgba(12,8,2,.85);border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.22);border-radius:5px;padding:5px 8px;font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-size:12px;color:#d0b070;outline:none;margin-bottom:5px;box-sizing:border-box}
.gb-alliance-name-input:focus{border-color:rgba(240,160,40,.55)}
.gb-alliance-name-input::placeholder{color:#b09060}
.gb-alliance-cost{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:10px;color:#72b050;margin-bottom:5px}
.gb-alliance-cost.no{color:#9a4030}
.gb-ab{width:100%;padding:6px 0;border-radius:6px;font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:8.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:1.2px;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid;margin-bottom:4px;transition:all .12s;text-align:center}
.gb-ab.create{border-color:rgba(100,200,80,.4);background:rgba(18,55,10,.8);color:#80cc60}
.gb-ab.create:hover:not(:disabled){background:rgba(28,80,14,.9);border-color:#80cc60;box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(80,200,50,.15)}
.gb-ab.join{border-color:rgba(80,120,220,.4);background:rgba(10,25,65,.8);color:#88aaee}
.gb-ab.join:hover:not(:disabled){background:rgba(18,40,100,.9);border-color:#88aaee}
.gb-ab.leave{border-color:rgba(200,80,60,.4);background:rgba(55,12,8,.8);color:#e07060}
.gb-ab.leave:hover:not(:disabled){background:rgba(80,18,12,.9);border-color:#e07060}
.gb-ab.promote{border-color:rgba(240,160,40,.4);background:rgba(50,32,8,.8);color:#f0c060}
.gb-ab.promote:hover:not(:disabled){background:rgba(80,50,12,.9);border-color:#f0d060}
.gb-ab:disabled{opacity:.3;cursor:default}
/* GEN territory tools: give land / create sovereign state */
.gb-give-land{margin:8px;border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.22);border-radius:8px;background:rgba(18,12,5,.76);padding:8px}
.gb-give-title{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:8px;color:#f0a030;letter-spacing:1.8px;margin-bottom:6px}
.gb-territory-mode-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:5px;margin-bottom:6px}
.gb-territory-mode-row .gb-ab{margin:0;min-width:0;padding:7px 4px;font-size:7px}
.gb-give-hint{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-size:11px;color:#a98a58;line-height:1.25;margin:5px 0 7px}
.gb-give-status{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:8px;color:#d8bd82;letter-spacing:.6px;margin:5px 0 7px;min-height:12px}
.gb-give-select,.gb-territory-input{width:100%;background:rgba(20,14,5,.9);border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.3);border-radius:6px;color:#d8bd82;padding:6px;font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-size:12px;margin-bottom:6px;outline:none}
.gb-territory-brush{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;margin:5px 0 7px;padding:5px 7px;border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.16);border-radius:6px;background:rgba(12,8,3,.55)}
.gb-territory-brush label{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:7px;letter-spacing:1px;color:#a98a58;white-space:nowrap}.gb-territory-brush input[type=range]{flex:1;min-width:0;accent-color:#f0a030}.gb-territory-brush span{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:8px;color:#f0c060;min-width:14px;text-align:center}
.gb-territory-new-row{display:flex;gap:5px;align-items:center}.gb-territory-new-row .gb-territory-input{margin:0;flex:1;min-width:0}.gb-territory-new-row input[type=color]{width:38px;height:30px;padding:2px;border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.3);border-radius:5px;background:#100a03;cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0}
.gb-give-actions{display:flex;gap:5px;margin-top:6px}.gb-give-actions .gb-ab{margin:0;flex:1}
.gb-give-active{border-color:#f0a030!important;box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(240,160,48,.18)}
.gb-give-land.mode-new{border-color:rgba(90,160,230,.42)!important;box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(80,150,230,.16)}
.gb-give-land.mode-free{border-color:rgba(122,205,150,.46)!important;box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(90,190,125,.15)}
.gb-ab-sm{padding:2px 5px;border-radius:4px;font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:7px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.8px;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid;transition:all .1s;white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0}
.gb-ab-sm.kick-btn{border-color:rgba(200,100,30,.4);background:rgba(55,22,5,.8);color:#e08040}
.gb-ab-sm.kick-btn:hover{background:rgba(80,32,8,.9);border-color:#e08040}
.gb-ab-sm.betray-btn{border-color:rgba(200,40,40,.4);background:rgba(60,8,8,.8);color:#e04040}
.gb-ab-sm.betray-btn:hover{background:rgba(90,12,12,.9);border-color:#e04040}
.gb-alliance-divider{height:1px;background:rgba(200,140,50,.12);margin:4px 0 7px}
.gb-alliance-members-hdr{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:8px;color:#a08040;letter-spacing:1.5px;margin-bottom:4px}
.gb-alliance-member-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:3px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.07)}
.gb-alliance-member-dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.gb-alliance-member-name{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:8px;color:#c0a060;flex:1;letter-spacing:.3px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.gb-alliance-member-crown{font-size:9px;color:#f0c060;flex-shrink:0}
.gb-alliance-no-members{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:10px;color:#b09060;padding:4px 0}
.gb-alliance-join-select{width:100%;background:rgba(12,8,2,.85);border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.22);border-radius:5px;padding:5px 8px;font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-size:11px;color:#d0b070;outline:none;margin-bottom:5px;cursor:pointer;box-sizing:border-box}
.gb-alliance-join-select:focus{border-color:rgba(240,160,40,.45)}
.gb-alliance-join-select option{background:#1a1205;color:#d0b070}

/* ── VIEW MODE TOGGLE ── */
#view-mode-toggle{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;padding:0 8px;border-left:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.18);border-right:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.18);flex-shrink:0}
.vm-btn{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:8px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.8px;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.18);background:rgba(20,14,5,.7);color:#9a8050;transition:all .12s;user-select:none;white-space:nowrap}
.vm-btn.active{border-color:#f0a030;background:rgba(60,38,10,.85);color:#f0c060}
.vm-btn:hover:not(.active){border-color:rgba(240,160,40,.5);color:#c0a060}

/* ── MILITARY BAR ── */
#mil-bar{position:fixed;bottom:14px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(90px);transition:transform .22s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1),opacity .15s;z-index:500;display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;background:rgba(10,7,3,.93);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.26);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 18px;box-shadow:0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.65);pointer-events:auto;max-width:calc(100vw - 24px)}
#mil-bar.visible{transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}
.mb{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:1.5px;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:7px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .13s;border:1px solid;background:rgba(25,17,8,.7);border-color:rgba(200,140,50,.28);color:#c0a060;white-space:nowrap}
.mb:hover{background:rgba(50,32,8,.85);border-color:#f0a030;color:#f0d060}
.mb.active{background:rgba(98,61,8,.94);border-color:#ffd35a;color:#ffe58a;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(255,211,90,.18),0 0 18px rgba(240,160,48,.16)}
.mb:disabled{opacity:.32;cursor:default}
#mil-border-wrap{position:relative}
#mil-border-menu{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:calc(100% + 10px);transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(5px);width:224px;padding:7px;background:rgba(8,5,2,.98);border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.28);border-radius:9px;box-shadow:0 12px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.7);display:none;z-index:520}
#mil-border-menu.open{display:block;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}
.mil-plan-option{width:100%;display:block;text-align:left;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:transparent;color:#c9ab72;padding:8px 10px;font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer}
.mil-plan-option:hover{background:rgba(70,43,11,.75);color:#f4cf72}
.mil-plan-option.danger{color:#c47c69;border-top:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.12);margin-top:4px;padding-top:9px}
#border-picker{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:calc(100% + 10px);transform:translateX(-50%);width:min(430px,calc(100vw - 24px));padding:10px 12px;background:rgba(8,5,2,.98);border:1px solid rgba(240,160,40,.42);border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 12px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.72);display:none;z-index:525}
#border-picker.open{display:block}
#border-picker-title{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1.3px;color:#f0c060;margin-bottom:4px}
#border-picker-help{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-size:11px;color:#a88d61;margin-bottom:7px}
#border-picked{min-height:25px;display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:8px}
.border-chip{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-size:11px;padding:3px 7px;border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.26);border-radius:999px;color:#d8bd86;background:rgba(50,31,9,.72)}
#border-picker-actions{display:flex;gap:7px;justify-content:flex-end}
#border-picker-actions button{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.8px;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.28);background:rgba(25,17,8,.8);color:#c0a060}
#border-apply{border-color:rgba(100,200,80,.4)!important;color:#8ed174!important}
#mil-info{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:12px;color:#8a7050;padding:0 6px;min-width:120px;text-align:center;white-space:nowrap}



#landscapeGate{display:none!important}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MAIN MENU
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
#mainMenu{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:7500;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(5,3,1,.20) 0%,rgba(8,4,1,.06) 54%,rgba(5,3,1,.25) 100%)}
#mainMenu.open{display:flex}
.mm-inner{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:0}
.mm-title{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:72px;font-weight:900;color:#f0c060;letter-spacing:12px;text-shadow:0 0 80px rgba(240,150,30,.6),0 4px 0 #3a1800,0 0 200px rgba(240,100,10,.3);text-align:center;line-height:1}
.mm-subtitle{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:18px;color:#b09060;letter-spacing:6px;margin:10px 0 52px;text-align:center}
.mm-version{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:9px;color:#b09060;letter-spacing:3px;margin-bottom:8px}
.mm-btn{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:4px;padding:16px 64px;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .18s;border:1px solid;display:block;text-align:center;width:320px;margin-bottom:10px;background:rgba(12,7,2,.7);backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
.mm-btn.primary{border-color:rgba(240,160,40,.5);color:#f0d060;background:rgba(80,50,10,.7)}
.mm-btn.primary:hover{background:rgba(140,90,15,.8);border-color:#f0a030;box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(240,150,30,.3);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.mm-btn.secondary{border-color:rgba(200,140,50,.2);color:#8a7040;background:rgba(18,12,4,.6)}
.mm-btn.secondary:hover{border-color:rgba(200,140,50,.45);color:#c0a060;background:rgba(35,23,8,.8);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.mm-btn.tertiary{border-color:rgba(100,100,100,.25);color:#5a5040;background:rgba(14,10,3,.6)}
.mm-btn.tertiary:hover{border-color:rgba(150,150,120,.4);color:#8a8060;background:rgba(22,16,5,.7);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.mm-divider{width:1px;height:60px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,rgba(200,140,50,.3),transparent);margin:0 auto 0}
.mm-footer{position:fixed;bottom:20px;font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:12px;color:#7a6040;letter-spacing:2px}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SCENARIO PICKER (HOI4-style)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
#scenPicker{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:7600;display:none;flex-direction:column;background:rgba(4,2,1,.96);overflow:hidden}
#scenPicker.open{display:flex}
#sp-header{flex-shrink:0;padding:28px 40px 0;display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:16px}
#sp-header h2{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:26px;font-weight:900;color:#f0c060;letter-spacing:6px}
#sp-header p{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:13px;color:#9a8050;letter-spacing:2px}
#sp-grid{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:20px 30px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:14px;align-content:start}
#sp-grid::-webkit-scrollbar{width:5px}
#sp-grid::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:rgba(200,140,50,.2);border-radius:3px}
.sp-group-title{grid-column:1/-1;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-height:26px;margin:2px 2px -4px;font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:3px;color:#b99a5f;user-select:none}
.sp-group-title::after{content:'';height:1px;flex:1;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(200,150,80,.30),rgba(200,150,80,0))}
.sp-group-title.tno{color:#9c9386}.sp-group-title.tno::after{background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(170,160,145,.26),rgba(170,160,145,0))}
.sp-card{border-radius:10px;border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.18);cursor:pointer;transition:all .16s;overflow:hidden;position:relative;height:180px;flex-shrink:0;user-select:none}
.sp-card:hover{border-color:rgba(240,160,40,.5);transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.sp-card.active{border-color:#f0a030;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #f0a030,0 10px 40px rgba(240,150,30,.25)}
.sp-card-bg{position:absolute;inset:0;background-size:cover;background-position:center;transition:transform .3s}
.sp-card:hover .sp-card-bg{transform:scale(1.04)}
.sp-card-overlay{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(0,0,0,.18) 0%,rgba(0,0,0,.55) 60%,rgba(0,0,0,.85) 100%)}
.sp-card.active .sp-card-overlay{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(240,150,30,.08) 0%,rgba(0,0,0,.5) 60%,rgba(0,0,0,.85) 100%)}
.sp-card-content{position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;padding:12px 14px 13px}
.sp-card-art{position:absolute;top:0;right:0;font-size:72px;opacity:.22;transform:translate(8px,-6px);line-height:1;pointer-events:none;user-select:none}
.sp-card-year{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:10px;color:rgba(200,150,50,.7);letter-spacing:3px;margin-bottom:3px}
.sp-card-name{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:#f0d080;letter-spacing:1px;margin-bottom:4px;text-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.8)}
.sp-card-desc{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:11px;color:rgba(180,150,80,.8);line-height:1.4;max-height:34px;overflow:hidden}
.sp-card-check{position:absolute;top:10px;right:10px;width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:#f0a030;border:2px solid #f8d860;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;color:#7a6040;font-weight:900}
.sp-card.active .sp-card-check{display:flex}
#sp-footer{flex-shrink:0;padding:14px 30px 20px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;border-top:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.12);background:rgba(6,4,1,.9)}
#sp-sel-name{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:13px;color:#b09060;flex:1}
#sp-back{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:2px;padding:10px 22px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.2);background:rgba(18,12,4,.7);color:#a08040;transition:all .13s}
#sp-back:hover{border-color:rgba(240,160,40,.4);color:#c0a060}
#sp-editor{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:1.5px;padding:10px 18px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.3);background:rgba(22,16,6,.8);color:#c0a060;transition:all .13s}
#sp-editor:hover{border-color:rgba(240,160,40,.5);color:#f0d070;background:rgba(40,27,8,.85)}
#sp-confirm{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:2.5px;padding:12px 30px;border-radius:7px;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid #f0a030;background:rgba(100,62,12,.8);color:#f8d860;transition:all .15s}
#sp-confirm:hover{background:rgba(160,100,15,.9);box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(240,150,30,.3);transform:translateY(-1px)}
#sp-confirm:disabled{opacity:.3;cursor:default;transform:none}

/* ── Starting Alliances toggle row in sp-footer ── */
#sp-footer-left{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex:1}
#sp-alliances-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:5px 12px;border-radius:6px;background:rgba(14,9,3,.7);border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.16);cursor:pointer;user-select:none;flex-shrink:0;transition:border-color .13s}
#sp-alliances-row:hover{border-color:rgba(240,160,40,.4)}
#sp-alliances-label{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:9px;font-weight:600;color:#8a7040;letter-spacing:1.5px;white-space:nowrap}
#sp-alliances-toggle{position:relative;width:36px;height:20px;flex-shrink:0}
#sp-alliances-toggle input{opacity:0;width:0;height:0;position:absolute}
#sp-alliances-toggle .sp-tog-track{position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(40,30,10,.7);border-radius:10px;border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.25);cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s}
#sp-alliances-toggle input:checked ~ .sp-tog-track{background:rgba(120,80,10,.8);border-color:rgba(240,150,30,.5)}
#sp-alliances-toggle .sp-tog-thumb{position:absolute;top:2px;left:2px;width:14px;height:14px;background:#6a5030;border-radius:50%;transition:transform .2s;pointer-events:none}
#sp-alliances-toggle input:checked ~ .sp-tog-thumb{transform:translateX(16px);background:#f0a030}

/* ── Load Save File bar (full-width strip above scenario grid) ── */
#sp-load-bar{
  flex-shrink:0;
  margin:14px 30px 0;
  border-radius:10px;
  border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.22);
  background:rgba(18,10,4,.75);
  cursor:pointer;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  padding:0 20px;
  height:64px;
  transition:all .16s;
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
  user-select:none;
}
#sp-load-bar::before{
  content:'';
  position:absolute;
  inset:0;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(40,20,5,.6) 0%,rgba(20,10,2,.3) 60%,rgba(40,20,8,.5) 100%);
  pointer-events:none;
}
#sp-load-bar:hover{
  border-color:rgba(240,160,40,.55);
  background:rgba(35,18,5,.85);
  box-shadow:0 6px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.55);
  transform:translateY(-1px);
}
#sp-load-bar.active{
  border-color:#f0a030;
  background:rgba(55,30,6,.85);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #f0a030,0 8px 32px rgba(240,150,30,.2);
}
#sp-load-bar-left{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;position:relative}
#sp-load-bar-icon{font-size:26px;line-height:1;flex-shrink:0;opacity:.85}
#sp-load-bar-text{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px}
#sp-load-bar-title{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:#f0d080;letter-spacing:3px}
#sp-load-bar-desc{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:12px;color:rgba(180,150,80,.7);letter-spacing:.3px}
#sp-load-bar-right{position:relative;flex-shrink:0}
#sp-load-bar-check{
  width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;
  background:#f0a030;border:2px solid #f8d860;
  display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-size:12px;color:#7a6040;font-weight:900;
}
#sp-load-bar.active #sp-load-bar-check{display:flex}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   COUNTRY SELECTION BAR (left sidebar shown over map)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
#countryBar{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;width:280px;height:100vh;z-index:7400;background:rgba(8,5,2,.97);backdrop-filter:blur(18px);border-right:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.28);display:none;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;transform:translateX(-290px);transition:transform .28s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)}
#countryBar.open{display:flex;transform:translateX(0)}
#cb-header{flex-shrink:0;padding:18px 16px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.15)}
#cb-header h3{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:#f0c060;letter-spacing:4px;margin-bottom:3px}
#cb-scen-badge{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:11px;color:#9a8050;letter-spacing:1px}
#cb-search{background:rgba(20,14,5,.8);border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.22);border-radius:6px;padding:8px 12px;font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-size:13px;color:#d0b070;outline:none;width:100%;margin-top:10px;font-size:14px}
#cb-search::placeholder{color:#3a2818}
#cb-search:focus{border-color:rgba(240,160,40,.5)}
#cb-list{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:6px 8px}
#cb-list::-webkit-scrollbar{width:4px}
#cb-list::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:rgba(200,140,50,.2);border-radius:2px}
.cb-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:9px 10px;border-radius:7px;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid transparent;transition:all .1s;margin-bottom:3px}
.cb-item:hover{background:rgba(35,22,8,.8);border-color:rgba(200,140,50,.2)}
.cb-item.active{background:rgba(55,35,8,.85);border-color:#f0a030;box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(240,150,30,.12)}
.cb-dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;border:1.5px solid rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.cb-name{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;color:#d0b060;letter-spacing:.5px;flex:1}
.cb-provs{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-size:10px;color:#8a7050}
#cb-footer{flex-shrink:0;padding:12px 10px 16px;border-top:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.12);background:rgba(6,4,1,.9);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px}
#cb-chosen{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:11px;color:#a08040;text-align:center;padding:2px 0;min-height:16px}
.cb-btn{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:2px;padding:11px;border-radius:7px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .13s;border:1px solid;text-align:center}
#cb-play{border-color:#f0a030;background:rgba(100,62,12,.8);color:#f8d860}
#cb-play:hover:not(:disabled){background:rgba(160,100,15,.9);box-shadow:0 0 15px rgba(240,150,30,.3)}
#cb-play:disabled{opacity:.32;cursor:default}
#cb-spec{border-color:rgba(70,120,200,.4);background:rgba(20,35,60,.6);color:#6a9aee}
#cb-spec:hover{background:rgba(30,55,100,.7)}
#cb-sand{border-color:rgba(70,160,70,.4);background:rgba(20,50,20,.6);color:#6acc6a}
#cb-sand:hover{background:rgba(30,75,30,.7)}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   ESCAPE / PAUSE MENU
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
#escapeMenu{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:8500;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:rgba(4,2,1,.78);backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
#escapeMenu.open{display:flex}
#esc-panel{background:rgba(8,5,2,.98);border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.3);border-radius:12px;padding:36px 48px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-width:300px;box-shadow:0 20px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.8)}
#esc-title{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:22px;font-weight:900;color:#f0c060;letter-spacing:6px;margin-bottom:16px;text-align:center}
#esc-subtitle{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:13px;color:#9a8050;letter-spacing:2px;margin-top:-14px;margin-bottom:10px}
.esc-btn{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:2.5px;padding:13px 0;border-radius:7px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .14s;border:1px solid;text-align:center;width:220px}
#esc-resume{border-color:rgba(240,160,40,.5);background:rgba(80,50,10,.7);color:#f0d060}
#esc-resume:hover{background:rgba(140,90,15,.85);border-color:#f0a030;box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(240,150,30,.25)}
#esc-save{border-color:rgba(70,140,70,.4);background:rgba(20,50,20,.6);color:#80cc80}
#esc-save:hover{background:rgba(30,75,30,.8);border-color:rgba(90,180,90,.6)}
#esc-load{border-color:rgba(70,120,200,.4);background:rgba(20,35,60,.6);color:#88aaee}
#esc-load:hover{background:rgba(30,55,100,.8);border-color:rgba(90,150,220,.6)}
#esc-menu{border-color:rgba(200,80,60,.35);background:rgba(50,15,10,.6);color:#e07060}
#esc-menu:hover{background:rgba(70,20,12,.8);border-color:rgba(220,80,60,.5)}
.esc-divider{width:80%;height:1px;background:rgba(200,140,50,.1);margin:6px 0}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SETTINGS MODAL
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
#settingsModal{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9100;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:rgba(4,2,1,.82);backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
#settingsModal.open{display:flex}
#set-panel{background:rgba(8,5,2,.99);border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.28);border-radius:12px;padding:32px 40px;min-width:380px;max-width:500px}
#set-title{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:20px;font-weight:900;color:#f0c060;letter-spacing:5px;text-align:center;margin-bottom:26px}
.set-section{margin-bottom:22px}
.set-section-title{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:9px;color:#f0a030;letter-spacing:3px;margin-bottom:12px;padding-bottom:5px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.15)}
.set-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-bottom:13px}
.set-label{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-size:13px;color:#a09060;flex:1}
.set-toggle{position:relative;width:44px;height:24px;flex-shrink:0}
.set-toggle input{opacity:0;width:0;height:0;position:absolute}
.set-toggle-track{position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(40,30,10,.7);border-radius:12px;border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.25);cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s}
.set-toggle input:checked ~ .set-toggle-track{background:rgba(120,80,10,.8);border-color:rgba(240,150,30,.5)}
.set-toggle-thumb{position:absolute;top:3px;left:3px;width:16px;height:16px;background:#6a5030;border-radius:50%;transition:transform .2s}
.set-toggle input:checked ~ .set-toggle-thumb{transform:translateX(20px);background:#f0a030}
.set-slider-wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex:1}
.set-slider{flex:1;accent-color:#f0a030;cursor:pointer}
.set-slider-val{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:11px;color:#c09040;min-width:28px;text-align:right}
#set-close{width:100%;padding:12px;font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:2px;border-radius:7px;border:1px solid rgba(240,150,30,.4);background:rgba(70,44,10,.7);color:#f0c060;cursor:pointer;transition:all .14s;margin-top:8px}
.set-select{min-width:150px;background:rgba(20,14,5,.9);border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.28);border-radius:6px;color:#e0c080;font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1px;padding:7px 9px;outline:none;cursor:pointer}.set-select:focus{border-color:#f0a030}
#set-close:hover{background:rgba(120,78,14,.85);border-color:#f0a030}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   EXIT CONFIRM MODAL
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
#exitConfirm{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9200;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:rgba(4,2,1,.85)}
#exitConfirm.open{display:flex}
#exit-panel{background:rgba(8,5,2,.99);border:1px solid rgba(200,80,60,.35);border-radius:10px;padding:30px 36px;max-width:360px;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.7)}
#exit-msg{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-size:14px;color:#a09060;line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:20px}
#exit-msg strong{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:12px;color:#e07060;letter-spacing:1px;display:block;margin-bottom:10px}
.exit-btns{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center}
.exit-btns button{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:2px;padding:10px 24px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .13s;border:1px solid}
#exit-yes{border-color:rgba(200,60,40,.5);background:rgba(60,15,10,.7);color:#e07060}
#exit-yes:hover{background:rgba(90,20,12,.85);border-color:rgba(220,80,60,.6)}
#exit-no{border-color:rgba(200,140,50,.3);background:rgba(35,22,8,.7);color:#c0a060}
#exit-no:hover{background:rgba(55,35,12,.85);border-color:rgba(240,160,40,.5)}

/* ── TECH TREE MODAL ── */
#tech-modal{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:8500;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:rgba(4,2,1,.9);backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}
#tech-modal.open{display:flex}
#tech-panel{background:rgba(8,5,2,.99);border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.35);border-radius:14px;width:min(1060px,97vw);max-height:90vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;box-shadow:0 32px 90px rgba(0,0,0,.85);overflow:hidden}
#tech-header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:16px 24px 13px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.2);flex-shrink:0;background:rgba(12,8,2,.6)}
#tech-title{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:17px;font-weight:900;color:#f0c060;letter-spacing:4px;flex:1}
#tech-subtitle{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:11px;color:#9a8050;letter-spacing:1px}
#tech-close{background:rgba(20,14,5,.7);border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.3);color:#b09060;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;padding:6px 13px;border-radius:7px;line-height:1;font-family:'Cinzel',serif;transition:all .12s;letter-spacing:1px}
#tech-close:hover{color:#f0c060;border-color:#f0a030;background:rgba(40,27,8,.9)}
#tech-tabs{display:flex;flex-shrink:0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.18)}
.tech-tab-btn{flex:1;padding:11px 0;font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:2px;color:#9a8050;background:rgba(14,9,3,.8);border:none;cursor:pointer;transition:all .12s;border-right:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.14)}
.tech-tab-btn:last-child{border-right:none}
.tech-tab-btn:hover{color:#c0a060;background:rgba(30,20,8,.9)}
.tech-tab-btn.active{background:rgba(40,27,8,.95);color:#f0c060;border-bottom:2px solid #f0a030;box-shadow:inset 0 -2px 8px rgba(240,150,30,.1)}
#tech-body{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:auto;padding:18px 20px 22px}
#tech-body::-webkit-scrollbar{width:5px;height:5px}
#tech-body::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:transparent}
#tech-body::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:rgba(200,140,50,.25);border-radius:3px}
.tech-tree-panel{display:none}
.tech-tree-panel.active{display:block}

/* ── Coins bar ── */
#tech-coins-info{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:11px;color:#c09040;letter-spacing:1px;background:rgba(40,27,8,.6);border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.25);border-radius:7px;padding:5px 14px;white-space:nowrap}

/* ── Shared card base — BOTH trees use the same fixed-size card ── */
.tech-node,.tech-mil-node{
  width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;
  height:118px;                        /* fixed height — all cards identical */
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  background:rgba(18,12,4,.85);
  border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.2);
  border-radius:9px;
  padding:9px 10px 8px;
  cursor:pointer;
  transition:border-color .13s,background .13s,box-shadow .13s,transform .13s;
  position:relative;user-select:none;
  overflow:hidden;
}
.tech-node:hover:not(.researched):not(.locked),
.tech-mil-node:hover:not(.researched):not(.locked){
  border-color:rgba(240,160,40,.6);background:rgba(32,22,8,.95);
  transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
}
.tech-node.researched,.tech-mil-node.researched{
  border-color:rgba(80,210,70,.5);background:rgba(14,44,10,.75);cursor:default;
}
.tech-node.researched::after,.tech-mil-node.researched::after{
  content:'✓';position:absolute;top:6px;right:8px;
  font-size:11px;color:#70d060;font-weight:900;line-height:1;
}
.tech-node.locked,.tech-mil-node.locked{opacity:.32;cursor:not-allowed;filter:saturate(0.4)}
.tech-node.available,.tech-mil-node.available{
  border-color:rgba(240,155,30,.4);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(240,150,30,.1);
}
.tech-node.available.afford,.tech-mil-node.available.afford{
  border-color:rgba(100,220,80,.5);box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(80,200,60,.15);
}

/* ── Card inner layout ── */
.tech-card-top{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:7px;margin-bottom:5px}
.tech-icon{font-size:22px;line-height:1;flex-shrink:0;margin-top:1px}
.tech-card-title{flex:1;min-width:0}
.tech-name{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:#f0d080;letter-spacing:.4px;line-height:1.25;margin-bottom:2px;overflow:hidden;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical}
.tech-tier-tag{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:7.5px;color:#9a8050;letter-spacing:1px}
.tech-bonus-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:3px;flex:1;align-content:flex-start;margin-bottom:4px}
.tech-bp{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:8px;font-weight:600;padding:2px 5px;border-radius:3px;letter-spacing:.3px;line-height:1.3;white-space:nowrap}
.tech-bp.atk{color:#f08040;background:rgba(200,80,20,.2);border:1px solid rgba(200,80,20,.3)}
.tech-bp.def{color:#6090e0;background:rgba(40,80,200,.2);border:1px solid rgba(40,80,200,.3)}
.tech-bp.dmg{color:#60d080;background:rgba(40,160,80,.2);border:1px solid rgba(40,160,80,.3)}
.tech-bp.mov{color:#50c8c0;background:rgba(30,150,150,.2);border:1px solid rgba(30,150,150,.3)}
.tech-bp.cap{color:#c080f0;background:rgba(140,40,200,.2);border:1px solid rgba(140,40,200,.3)}
.tech-bp.eco{color:#b0c040;background:rgba(120,140,20,.18);border:1px solid rgba(120,140,20,.3)}
.tech-card-foot{margin-top:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding-top:4px;border-top:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.1)}
.tech-cost{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:9px;font-weight:600;color:#b09060;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3px}
.tech-cost.can-afford{color:#80d060}
.tech-cost.cant-afford{color:#d06040}
.tech-cost.researched-lbl{color:#50a040;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.5px}

/* ── Economic tree rows ── */
.tech-row-label{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:9px;color:#6a4818;letter-spacing:2px;text-align:center;margin-bottom:7px;margin-top:6px;padding:3px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.1)}
.tech-row{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-start;margin-bottom:10px;position:relative;flex-wrap:wrap}
.tech-row .tech-node{width:160px;flex:0 0 160px}

/* ── Military tree grid ── */
.tech-mil-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);gap:8px;align-items:start}
.tech-mil-col{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0}
.tech-mil-col-label{
  font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:#f0b050;
  letter-spacing:1.5px;text-align:center;padding:7px 4px 9px;
  border-bottom:2px solid rgba(200,140,50,.25);margin-bottom:8px;
  background:rgba(20,14,5,.5);border-radius:6px 6px 0 0;
}
.tech-mil-node{margin-bottom:5px}
.tech-mil-arrow{
  text-align:center;font-size:10px;color:rgba(200,140,50,.4);
  margin-bottom:5px;line-height:1;user-select:none;
}


/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   START FOLDER BAR (inside scenario picker)
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
#sp-start-bar{
  flex-shrink:0;
  margin:10px 30px 0;
  border-radius:10px;
  border:1px dashed rgba(100,180,240,.3);
  background:rgba(8,16,30,.75);
  cursor:pointer;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  padding:0 20px;
  height:52px;
  transition:all .16s;
  user-select:none;
}
#sp-start-bar:hover{border-color:rgba(100,180,240,.65);background:rgba(14,26,50,.85);box-shadow:0 6px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.5);transform:translateY(-1px)}
#sp-start-bar-left{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
#sp-start-bar-icon{font-size:22px;line-height:1;opacity:.85}
#sp-start-bar-text{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px}
#sp-start-bar-title{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;color:#88ccee;letter-spacing:3px}
#sp-start-bar-desc{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:11px;color:rgba(100,160,200,.7)}
.sp-start-card{background:rgba(8,18,35,.8);border:1px solid rgba(100,180,240,.22);border-radius:10px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .16s;overflow:hidden;position:relative;height:180px;flex-shrink:0;user-select:none}
.sp-start-card:hover{border-color:rgba(100,180,240,.55);transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.sp-start-card.active{border-color:#66bbee;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #66bbee,0 10px 40px rgba(80,160,240,.2)}
.sp-start-card .sp-card-bg{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#051828 0%,#0a2840 55%,#061830 100%)}
.sp-start-card .sp-card-overlay{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(0,0,0,.18) 0%,rgba(0,0,0,.55) 60%,rgba(0,0,0,.85) 100%)}
.sp-start-card.active .sp-card-overlay{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(80,160,240,.08) 0%,rgba(0,0,0,.5) 60%,rgba(0,0,0,.85) 100%)}
.sp-start-card .sp-card-check{background:#66bbee;border-color:#aaddff}
.sp-start-card.active .sp-card-check{display:flex}
.sp-start-card .sp-card-year{color:rgba(100,180,240,.7)}
.sp-start-card .sp-card-name{color:#aaddff}
.sp-start-card .sp-card-desc{color:rgba(120,180,220,.75)}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   LOAD GAME MODAL
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
#loadModal{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9500;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:rgba(4,2,1,.88);backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}
#loadModal.open{display:flex}
#lm-panel{background:rgba(8,5,2,.99);border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.32);border-radius:14px;width:min(600px,94vw);max-height:80vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.8);overflow:hidden}
#lm-header{display:flex;align-items:center;padding:18px 22px 0;flex-shrink:0}
#lm-title{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:18px;font-weight:900;color:#f0c060;letter-spacing:4px;flex:1}
#lm-close{background:none;border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.3);color:#a08040;font-size:16px;cursor:pointer;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:6px;line-height:1;font-family:'Cinzel',serif;transition:all .12s}
#lm-close:hover{color:#f0a030;border-color:#f0a030}
#lm-tabs{display:flex;flex-shrink:0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.18);margin-top:16px}
.lm-tab-btn{flex:1;padding:10px 0;font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:2px;color:#9a8050;background:rgba(14,9,3,.8);border:none;cursor:pointer;transition:all .12s;border-right:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.14)}
.lm-tab-btn:last-child{border-right:none}
.lm-tab-btn:hover{color:#c0a060;background:rgba(30,20,8,.9)}
.lm-tab-btn.active{background:rgba(40,27,8,.95);color:#f0c060;border-bottom:2px solid #f0a030}
.lm-panel{display:none;flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:18px 22px 22px;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.lm-panel.active{display:flex}
.lm-panel::-webkit-scrollbar{width:5px}
.lm-panel::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:rgba(200,140,50,.22);border-radius:3px}
#lm-folder-btn{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:2px;padding:11px 22px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid rgba(100,180,240,.4);background:rgba(8,18,35,.8);color:#88ccee;transition:all .13s;flex-shrink:0}
#lm-folder-btn:hover{background:rgba(14,30,60,.9);border-color:#88ccee}
#lm-saves-list{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;min-height:80px}
.lm-save-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:8px;background:rgba(18,12,4,.75);border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.14);cursor:pointer;transition:all .12s}
.lm-save-item:hover{background:rgba(35,22,8,.85);border-color:rgba(240,160,40,.4)}
.lm-save-item.selected{background:rgba(55,35,8,.85);border-color:#f0a030}
.lm-save-icon{font-size:20px;flex-shrink:0}
.lm-save-info{flex:1;min-width:0}
.lm-save-name{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:11px;color:#e0c080;letter-spacing:.5px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.lm-save-date{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-size:11px;color:#9a8050;margin-top:2px}
.lm-saves-empty{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:13px;color:#8a7050;text-align:center;padding:24px 0}
#lm-load-btn{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:2px;padding:12px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid rgba(100,200,80,.4);background:rgba(18,55,10,.8);color:#80cc60;transition:all .13s;flex-shrink:0}
#lm-load-btn:hover:not(:disabled){background:rgba(28,80,14,.9);border-color:#80cc60;box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(80,200,50,.2)}
#lm-load-btn:disabled{opacity:.3;cursor:default}
#lm-upload-input{display:none}
#lm-upload-btn{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:2px;padding:16px;border-radius:10px;cursor:pointer;border:2px dashed rgba(200,140,50,.3);background:rgba(18,12,4,.5);color:#a08040;transition:all .13s;text-align:center;flex-shrink:0}
#lm-upload-btn:hover{border-color:rgba(240,160,40,.55);color:#c0a060;background:rgba(30,18,5,.7)}
#lm-upload-ready{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-size:12px;color:#80c060;text-align:center;padding:4px 0;min-height:18px}
#lm-upload-load-btn{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:2px;padding:12px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid rgba(100,200,80,.4);background:rgba(18,55,10,.8);color:#80cc60;transition:all .13s}
#lm-upload-load-btn:hover:not(:disabled){background:rgba(28,80,14,.9);border-color:#80cc60}
#lm-upload-load-btn:disabled{opacity:.3;cursor:default}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SAVE GAME MODAL
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
#saveModal{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9500;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:rgba(4,2,1,.88);backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}
#saveModal.open{display:flex}
#sm-panel{background:rgba(8,5,2,.99);border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.32);border-radius:14px;width:min(520px,92vw);display:flex;flex-direction:column;box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.8);overflow:hidden}
#sm-header{display:flex;align-items:center;padding:18px 22px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.18);flex-shrink:0}
#sm-title{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:18px;font-weight:900;color:#f0c060;letter-spacing:4px;flex:1}
#sm-close{background:none;border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.3);color:#a08040;font-size:16px;cursor:pointer;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:6px;line-height:1;font-family:'Cinzel',serif;transition:all .12s}
#sm-close:hover{color:#f0a030;border-color:#f0a030}
#sm-body{padding:22px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
.sm-section-title{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:9px;color:#f0a030;letter-spacing:3px;padding-bottom:8px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.15)}
#sm-folder-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
#sm-folder-status{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:12px;color:#9a8050;flex:1}
#sm-folder-btn{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:9px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:1.5px;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid rgba(100,180,240,.35);background:rgba(8,18,35,.8);color:#88ccee;transition:all .12s;flex-shrink:0}
#sm-folder-btn:hover{background:rgba(14,30,60,.9);border-color:#88ccee}
#sm-name-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
#sm-name-label{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-size:12px;color:#a09060;flex-shrink:0}
#sm-name-input{flex:1;background:rgba(20,14,5,.8);border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.25);border-radius:6px;padding:8px 12px;font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-size:13px;color:#d0b070;outline:none}
#sm-name-input:focus{border-color:rgba(240,160,40,.55)}
#sm-save-folder-btn{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:2px;padding:12px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid rgba(100,200,80,.4);background:rgba(18,55,10,.8);color:#80cc60;transition:all .13s}
#sm-save-folder-btn:hover:not(:disabled){background:rgba(28,80,14,.9);border-color:#80cc60;box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(80,200,50,.2)}
#sm-save-folder-btn:disabled{opacity:.3;cursor:default}
.sm-divider{height:1px;background:rgba(200,140,50,.12)}
#sm-download-btn{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:2px;padding:12px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.3);background:rgba(35,22,8,.7);color:#c0a060;transition:all .13s}
#sm-download-btn:hover{background:rgba(55,35,12,.85);border-color:rgba(240,160,40,.5)}
#sm-status{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-size:12px;color:#80c060;text-align:center;min-height:18px;padding:2px 0}

/* ── Desktop: sidebar width override ── */
#gen-bar{width:220px}



/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   PEACE CONFERENCE — simple post-war settlement
   Map is restored to pre-war borders before the player assigns terms.
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
#peaceConference{position:fixed;inset:44px 0 0 0;z-index:880;display:none;pointer-events:none}
#peaceConference.active{display:block}
#pc-banner{position:absolute;top:10px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);padding:7px 12px;border:1px solid rgba(240,160,40,.45);border-radius:7px;background:rgba(8,5,2,.94);font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1.1px;color:#f0c060;text-align:center;pointer-events:none;white-space:nowrap}
#pc-panel{position:absolute;left:10px;top:10px;bottom:10px;width:350px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:rgba(7,4,2,.975);border:1px solid rgba(240,160,40,.32);border-radius:9px;box-shadow:0 12px 42px rgba(0,0,0,.48);pointer-events:auto;overflow:hidden}
#pc-head{padding:11px 12px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.15)}
#pc-kicker{display:none}
#pc-title{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:15px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.6px;color:#f3cb6b;line-height:1.2}
#pc-sub{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-size:11px;color:#a98b58;margin-top:3px;line-height:1.2}
#pc-controls{padding:7px 9px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.12);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px}
.pc-label{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:6.5px;letter-spacing:1px;color:#9c8050}
.pc-select,.pc-input{width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;background:rgba(18,11,4,.95);border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.20);border-radius:5px;padding:6px 7px;color:#d7bd81;font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-size:11px;outline:none}
.pc-select:focus,.pc-input:focus{border-color:rgba(240,160,40,.5)}
.pc-row{display:flex;gap:5px;align-items:center}.pc-row .pc-input{flex:1;min-width:0}
#pc-new-color{width:38px;height:28px;padding:2px;border-radius:5px;background:#111;border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.22)}
#pc-quick{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:4px}
#pc-terms{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:4px}
#pc-liberate-wrap{border:1px solid rgba(90,160,220,.18);border-radius:5px;background:rgba(8,18,30,.42);padding:5px 6px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
#pc-liberate-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;max-height:102px;overflow:auto;scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:rgba(100,160,220,.25) transparent}
.pc-liberate-empty{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:9px;color:#6f8290;padding:3px 2px}
.pc-liberate-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:8px minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:5px;align-items:center;padding:4px 5px;border:1px solid rgba(100,160,220,.14);border-radius:4px;background:rgba(11,24,38,.60)}
.pc-liberate-dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18)}
.pc-liberate-name{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-size:10px;color:#a9c4d7;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.pc-liberate-count{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:6px;color:#6f94ad;margin-top:1px}
.pc-liberate-btn{border:1px solid rgba(90,175,230,.30);background:rgba(20,55,78,.72);color:#8fccee;border-radius:4px;padding:4px 7px;font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:6.2px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.35px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}.pc-liberate-btn:hover{border-color:#8fccee;background:rgba(26,75,105,.88);color:#d6efff}
.pc-mini{border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.16);background:rgba(25,16,5,.65);color:#a98b58;border-radius:5px;padding:5px 3px;font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:6.5px;letter-spacing:.3px;cursor:pointer}
.pc-mini:hover{border-color:rgba(240,160,40,.4);color:#e0bc72}
.pc-mini.danger{border-color:rgba(210,80,55,.34);color:#df8874;background:rgba(58,19,10,.58)}
.pc-mini.danger:hover{border-color:#df775f;color:#ffd1c5;background:rgba(88,28,14,.75)}
.pc-brush-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:4px 6px;border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.14);border-radius:5px;background:rgba(18,11,4,.52)}
.pc-brush-row input[type=range]{flex:1;min-width:0;accent-color:#f0a030}.pc-brush-val{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:7px;color:#f0c060;min-width:18px;text-align:center}
#pc-states{flex:1;overflow:auto;padding:5px 7px 7px;scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:rgba(200,140,50,.22) transparent}
.pc-state{display:grid;grid-template-columns:16px minmax(0,1fr);gap:6px;align-items:center;padding:7px;margin-bottom:4px;border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.10);border-radius:5px;background:rgba(18,12,4,.55);cursor:pointer;user-select:none}
.pc-state:hover{border-color:rgba(240,160,40,.3);background:rgba(34,22,7,.72)}
.pc-state.selected{border-color:#f0a030;background:rgba(70,42,8,.74)}.pc-state.settled{opacity:.74;cursor:pointer}
.pc-check{width:12px;height:12px;border:1px solid rgba(220,180,90,.32);border-radius:3px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#f8d860;font-size:9px}.pc-state.selected .pc-check{background:#8a5d10;border-color:#f0a030}
.pc-state-name{font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-size:11px;color:#d0b477;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.pc-state-meta{font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:6.3px;color:#876f49;margin-top:1px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
#pc-actions{padding:7px;border-top:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.12);background:rgba(9,6,2,.97);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:4px}
.pc-action{border:1px solid rgba(200,140,50,.20);border-radius:5px;padding:7px 4px;background:rgba(30,19,6,.72);color:#cba65f;font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:6.8px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.35px;cursor:pointer;line-height:1.1}.pc-action:hover:not(:disabled){border-color:#f0a030;background:rgba(62,39,9,.86);color:#f5cf72}.pc-action:disabled{opacity:.27;cursor:default}.pc-action.green{color:#80ca70}.pc-action.blue{color:#86bde8}.pc-action.red{color:#df7766}
#pc-log{grid-column:1/-1;max-height:36px;overflow:auto;padding:4px 6px;border-radius:4px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.2);font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;font-size:9px;line-height:1.2;color:#91784d;display:none}#pc-log.has{display:block}
#pc-finish{grid-column:1/-1;border-color:rgba(240,160,40,.48);background:rgba(92,55,10,.82);color:#f8d860;font-size:7.5px;padding:8px}
body.pc-active #gen-bar,body.pc-active #pp,body.pc-active #mil-bar{pointer-events:none;opacity:.18}


/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MOBILE DESKTOP-PARITY VIEWPORT
   Phones/tablets use the SAME desktop UI geometry. The whole game UI is
   uniformly scaled to the device. If the browser refuses physical landscape,
   the game itself rotates while preserving the desktop layout.
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
:root{
  --safe-top:0px;--safe-right:0px;--safe-bottom:0px;--safe-left:0px;
  --physical-vw:100vw;--physical-vh:100vh;
  --mobile-layout-w:100vw;--mobile-layout-h:100vh;
  --mobile-ui-scale:1;
  --mobile-vw:var(--mobile-layout-w);--mobile-vh:var(--mobile-layout-h);
}
#landscapeGate{display:none!important}
body.mobile{
  position:fixed;left:0;top:0;margin:0;
  width:var(--mobile-layout-w);height:var(--mobile-layout-h);
  min-width:0;min-height:0;max-width:none;max-height:none;
  overflow:hidden;overscroll-behavior:none;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;touch-action:manipulation;
  transform-origin:0 0;
