  transform:scale(var(--mobile-ui-scale));
}
body.mobile.virtual-landscape{
  transform:translateX(var(--physical-vw)) rotate(90deg) scale(var(--mobile-ui-scale));
}
body.mobile canvas{cursor:default;width:100%;height:100%}

/* Desktop rules using physical vw/vh are rebound to the virtual desktop box on mobile. */
body.mobile #map-editor{top:88px;max-height:calc(var(--mobile-layout-h) - 98px)}
body.mobile #loadMascot{width:min(220px,42%)}
/* At the enlarged mobile scale the desktop top bar wraps into two PC-style rows
   instead of clipping controls off-screen. Left/right/bottom panels keep their
   desktop anchoring; only the bar consumes a second row. */
body.mobile #top-bar{height:88px;display:none;grid-template-columns:200px minmax(0,1fr);grid-template-rows:44px 44px;padding:0 8px;overflow:hidden}
body.mobile #top-bar.game-visible{display:grid}
body.mobile #tb-civ{grid-column:1;grid-row:1;height:44px;min-width:0}
body.mobile #tb-res{grid-column:2;grid-row:1;height:44px;padding:0 4px;gap:1px;min-width:0}
body.mobile #tb-res .tr{padding:3px 6px}
body.mobile #view-mode-toggle{grid-column:1;grid-row:2;height:44px;border-left:0;padding-left:0;justify-self:start}
body.mobile #view-mode-toggle .vm-btn{font-size:7.5px;padding:4px 6px}
body.mobile #tb-views{grid-column:2;grid-row:2;height:44px;padding:0 6px;justify-self:start}
body.mobile #tb-speed{grid-column:2;grid-row:2;height:44px;justify-self:end;padding-left:5px;min-width:0}
body.mobile #tb-speed .spd-btn{padding-left:7px;padding-right:7px}
body.mobile #time-date{min-width:54px}
body.mobile #pp{top:88px;max-height:calc(var(--mobile-layout-h) - 98px)}
body.mobile #gen-bar{top:88px;height:calc(var(--mobile-layout-h) - 88px)}
body.mobile #peaceConference{inset:88px 0 0 0}
body.mobile #mil-bar{max-width:calc(var(--mobile-layout-w) - 24px)}
body.mobile #border-picker{width:min(430px,calc(var(--mobile-layout-w) - 24px))}
body.mobile #countryBar{height:var(--mobile-layout-h)}
body.mobile #tech-panel{width:min(1060px,97%);max-height:90%}
body.mobile #lm-panel{width:min(600px,94%);max-height:80%}
body.mobile #sm-panel{width:min(520px,92%);max-height:90%}
body.mobile #sm-body{overflow-y:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
body.mobile #set-panel{box-sizing:border-box;min-width:0;width:min(500px,92%);max-height:90%;overflow-y:auto;padding:18px 24px;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
body.mobile #set-title{margin-bottom:14px}
body.mobile .set-section{margin-bottom:12px}
body.mobile #esc-panel{box-sizing:border-box;min-width:0;width:min(360px,86%);max-height:90%;overflow-y:auto;padding:18px 30px;gap:6px;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
body.mobile #esc-title{margin-bottom:8px}
body.mobile #esc-subtitle{margin-top:-6px;margin-bottom:5px}
body.mobile .esc-btn{padding:9px 0}
/* Short landscape phones need compact vertical chrome so the enlarged controls
   do not squeeze the scenario cards out of existence. Structure/placement stays
   identical to desktop: header -> load/start bars -> grouped cards -> footer. */
body.mobile #sp-header{padding:8px 18px 0;gap:10px}
body.mobile #sp-header h2{font-size:18px;letter-spacing:4px}
body.mobile #sp-header p{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1.2px}
body.mobile #sp-load-bar{margin:5px 18px 0;height:38px;padding:0 12px;border-radius:7px}
body.mobile #sp-load-bar-left{gap:8px}
body.mobile #sp-load-bar-icon{font-size:18px}
body.mobile #sp-load-bar-title{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:2px}
body.mobile #sp-load-bar-desc{font-size:9px;line-height:1.05;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;max-width:430px}
body.mobile #sp-start-bar{margin:5px 18px 0;height:36px;padding:0 12px;border-radius:7px}
body.mobile #sp-start-bar-left{gap:8px;min-width:0}
body.mobile #sp-start-bar-icon{font-size:17px}
body.mobile #sp-start-bar-title{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:2px}
body.mobile #sp-start-bar-desc{font-size:9px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;max-width:420px}
body.mobile #sp-grid{padding:7px 18px;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:7px}
body.mobile .sp-group-title{min-height:18px;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:2px;margin:0 2px -2px}
body.mobile .sp-card,body.mobile .sp-start-card{height:112px;border-radius:7px}
body.mobile .sp-card-content{padding:7px 9px 8px}
body.mobile .sp-card-art{font-size:44px}
body.mobile .sp-card-year{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:2px;margin-bottom:1px}
body.mobile .sp-card-name{font-size:12px;margin-bottom:2px}
body.mobile .sp-card-desc{font-size:9px;line-height:1.2;max-height:23px}
body.mobile #sp-footer{padding:6px 18px 7px;gap:7px}
body.mobile #sp-footer-left{gap:6px;min-width:0}
body.mobile #sp-sel-name{font-size:10px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
body.mobile #sp-alliances-row{gap:5px;padding:3px 7px}
body.mobile #sp-alliances-label{font-size:7px;letter-spacing:.8px}
body.mobile #sp-back,body.mobile #sp-editor{font-size:8px;padding:7px 10px;letter-spacing:1px}
body.mobile #sp-confirm{font-size:9px;padding:8px 14px;letter-spacing:1.5px}
/* Peace controls remain on the same left PC panel, but the whole panel becomes
   touch-scrollable at the enlarged mobile scale so no settlement action is lost. */
body.mobile #pc-panel{overflow-x:hidden;overflow-y:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
body.mobile #pc-states{flex:0 0 72px;min-height:72px}
body.mobile #pc-actions{flex-shrink:0}
/* Keep the enlarged mobile main menu fully visible while retaining the same
   centered PC composition. Interactive controls remain ~2× their old physical size. */
body.mobile .mm-title{font-size:48px;letter-spacing:8px;white-space:nowrap}
body.mobile .mm-subtitle{font-size:16px;letter-spacing:4px;margin:7px 0 18px}
body.mobile .mm-version{font-size:8px;margin-bottom:6px}
body.mobile .mm-btn{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:3px;padding:11px 44px;width:300px;margin-bottom:7px}
body.mobile .mm-footer{bottom:8px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1.5px}


/* Stale second mobile override removed: the coherent desktop-parity mobile rules above are authoritative. */

</style>
</head>
<body>

<div id="landscapeGate" aria-live="polite">
  <div class="lg-icon">↻</div>
  <div class="lg-title">LANDSCAPE MODE</div>
  <div class="lg-copy">World Sandbox is locked to a landscape layout on phones and tablets. Rotate your device sideways.</div>
  <button class="lg-btn" id="landscape-enter" type="button">ENTER LANDSCAPE</button>
  <div class="lg-note">On iPhone/iPad, Safari controls physical rotation. This screen automatically disappears as soon as the device is landscape.</div>
</div>

<div id="loadScreen">
  <h1>WORLD SANDBOX</h1>
  <div class="sub">Build your empire across the globe</div>
  <img id="loadMascot" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="World Sandbox mascot">
  <div id="loadBar"><div id="loadFill"></div></div>
  <div id="loadMsg">Awakening the ancient maps…</div>
</div>

<!-- Civilisation Select Screen -->
<div id="selScreen">
  <div id="sel-top">
    <h2>SELECT YOUR CIVILISATION</h2>
    <p>Europe · Russia · Central Asia · Middle East · North Africa</p>
    <input id="sel-search" placeholder="Search countries…" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false">
  </div>
  <div id="scen-bar">
    <span class="scen-label">SCENARIO</span>
    <button class="scen-btn active" data-scen="modern">🌍 Modern Day</button>
  </div>
  <div id="scen-desc">The world as it stands today — all modern nation-states.</div>
  <div id="sel-grid"></div>
  <div id="sel-bot">
    <button class="sel-btn" id="sel-play" disabled>▶ PLAY</button>
    <button class="sel-btn" id="sel-spec">👁 SPECTATOR</button>
    <button class="sel-btn" id="sel-sand">⚡ SANDBOX</button>
    <span id="sel-chosen">No civilisation selected</span>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ══ TECH TREE MODAL ══ -->
<div id="tech-modal">
  <div id="tech-panel">
    <div id="tech-header">
      <div>
        <div id="tech-title">TECHNOLOGY</div>
        <div id="tech-subtitle">Research advancements to strengthen your civilization</div>
      </div>
      <div id="tech-coins-info">🪙 <span id="tech-coin-display">0</span> coins</div>
      <button id="tech-close">✕ CLOSE</button>
    </div>
    <div id="tech-tabs">
      <button class="tech-tab-btn active" data-techtab="econ">🌾 ECONOMIC</button>
      <button class="tech-tab-btn" data-techtab="mil">⚔ MILITARY</button>
    </div>
    <div id="tech-body">
      <!-- Economic Tree -->
      <div class="tech-tree-panel active" id="tech-panel-econ"></div>
      <!-- Military Tree -->
      <div class="tech-tree-panel" id="tech-panel-mil"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="mainMenu">
  <div class="mm-inner">
    <div class="mm-title">WORLD SANDBOX</div>
    <div class="mm-subtitle">Shape the destiny of nations</div>
    <div class="mm-version">v0.4 · FULL WORLD · HISTORICAL ATLAS</div>
    <button class="mm-btn primary" id="mm-start">⚔ &nbsp; START GAME</button>
    <button class="mm-btn secondary" id="mm-editor">✏ &nbsp; MAP EDITOR</button>
    <button class="mm-btn tertiary" id="mm-settings">⚙ &nbsp; SETTINGS</button>
  </div>
  <div class="mm-footer">Entire World · Province-Level Historical Scenarios · 1914–2024</div>
</div>

<!-- ══ SCENARIO PICKER (HOI4-style) ══ -->
<div id="scenPicker">
  <div id="sp-header">
    <h2>SELECT A SCENARIO</h2>
    <p>Choose the historical setting for your game</p>
  </div>
  <!-- Load Save File — full-width bar above the scenario grid -->
  <div id="sp-load-bar" data-scen="loadsave">
    <div id="sp-load-bar-left">
      <span id="sp-load-bar-icon">📂</span>
      <div id="sp-load-bar-text">
        <div id="sp-load-bar-title">LOAD SAVE FILE</div>
        <div id="sp-load-bar-desc">Click to open the Load Game screen — browse your Saves folder or upload a file.</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div id="sp-load-bar-right">
      <div id="sp-load-bar-check">✓</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <!-- Start Folder — browse for custom starting maps -->
  <div id="sp-start-bar">
    <div id="sp-start-bar-left">
      <span id="sp-start-bar-icon">🗂️</span>
      <div id="sp-start-bar-text">
        <div id="sp-start-bar-title">BROWSE START FOLDER</div>
        <div id="sp-start-bar-desc">Load custom starting maps from your <em>Start</em> folder and add them as scenario tabs.</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <span style="font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:9px;color:#7aaccc;letter-spacing:1px;flex-shrink:0">📁 SELECT FOLDER</span>
  </div>
  <input type="file" id="sp-load-input" accept=".txt,.json" style="display:none">
  <div id="sp-grid">
    <div class="sp-group-title realistic">REALISTIC</div>
    <div class="sp-card active" data-scen="modern">
      <div class="sp-card-bg" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0a2a4e 0%,#0d5c3d 55%,#1a3a5e 100%)"></div>
      <div class="sp-card-overlay"></div>
      <div class="sp-card-art">🌍</div>
      <div class="sp-card-content">
        <div class="sp-card-year">2024</div>
        <div class="sp-card-name">Modern Day</div>
        <div class="sp-card-desc">The world as it stands today — all modern nation-states with current borders.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="sp-card-check">✓</div>
    </div>
    <div class="sp-card" data-scen="ww1_1914">
      <div class="sp-card-bg" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#17233a 0%,#5b4a2e 52%,#2a241c 100%)"></div>
      <div class="sp-card-overlay"></div>
      <div class="sp-card-art">⚔</div>
      <div class="sp-card-content">
        <div class="sp-card-year">1914</div>
        <div class="sp-card-name">World War I</div>
        <div class="sp-card-desc">Province-by-province 1914 borders · historical states · alliances · period technology.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="sp-card-check">✓</div>
    </div>
    <div class="sp-card" data-scen="ww1_1917"><div class="sp-card-bg" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#20283c 0%,#675437 55%,#30271d 100%)"></div><div class="sp-card-overlay"></div><div class="sp-card-art">⚔</div><div class="sp-card-content"><div class="sp-card-year">1917</div><div class="sp-card-name">World War I</div><div class="sp-card-desc">Mid-war borders · occupations · updated blocs · period tech.</div></div><div class="sp-card-check">✓</div></div>
    <div class="sp-card" data-scen="hist1933"><div class="sp-card-bg" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#233047,#6b6044 55%,#313843 100%)"></div><div class="sp-card-overlay"></div><div class="sp-card-art">🕰</div><div class="sp-card-content"><div class="sp-card-year">1933</div><div class="sp-card-name">Interwar Europe</div><div class="sp-card-desc">Interwar borders · Danzig · USSR · Czechoslovakia · Yugoslavia.</div></div><div class="sp-card-check">✓</div></div>
    <div class="sp-card" data-scen="hist1936"><div class="sp-card-bg" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#263247 0%,#72513e 55%,#3a3028 100%)"></div><div class="sp-card-overlay"></div><div class="sp-card-art">⚑</div><div class="sp-card-content"><div class="sp-card-year">1936</div><div class="sp-card-name">Europe</div><div class="sp-card-desc">Interwar Europe + opening Spanish Civil War split.</div></div><div class="sp-card-check">✓</div></div>
    <div class="sp-card" data-scen="hist1939"><div class="sp-card-bg" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1d2229 0%,#665546 55%,#222b38 100%)"></div><div class="sp-card-overlay"></div><div class="sp-card-art">⚔</div><div class="sp-card-content"><div class="sp-card-year">1939</div><div class="sp-card-name">World War II</div><div class="sp-card-desc">1 Sep 1939 borders · Axis/Allies · Protectorate · Slovakia.</div></div><div class="sp-card-check">✓</div></div>
    <div class="sp-card" data-scen="hist1942"><div class="sp-card-bg" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#191c21 0%,#574a3d 52%,#34313b 100%)"></div><div class="sp-card-overlay"></div><div class="sp-card-art">⚔</div><div class="sp-card-content"><div class="sp-card-year">1942</div><div class="sp-card-name">Axis High-Water Mark</div><div class="sp-card-desc">Occupied Europe · Vichy France · eastern occupation zones.</div></div><div class="sp-card-check">✓</div></div>
    <div class="sp-card" data-scen="hist1945"><div class="sp-card-bg" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#253142 0%,#505d55 55%,#3f454b 100%)"></div><div class="sp-card-overlay"></div><div class="sp-card-art">🕊</div><div class="sp-card-content"><div class="sp-card-year">1945</div><div class="sp-card-name">Postwar World</div><div class="sp-card-desc">Late 1945 world · Western/Soviet German occupation zones · colonial empires · postwar borders.</div></div><div class="sp-card-check">✓</div></div>
    <div class="sp-card" data-scen="hist1954"><div class="sp-card-bg" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#203149 0%,#526c63 55%,#313d50 100%)"></div><div class="sp-card-overlay"></div><div class="sp-card-art">🌐</div><div class="sp-card-content"><div class="sp-card-year">1954</div><div class="sp-card-name">Cold War World</div><div class="sp-card-desc">Post-Geneva 1954 · FRG/GDR · divided Korea and Vietnam · colonial world in transition.</div></div><div class="sp-card-check">✓</div></div>
    <div class="sp-card" data-scen="hist1967"><div class="sp-card-bg" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#202b40 0%,#596c53 55%,#3d3344 100%)"></div><div class="sp-card-overlay"></div><div class="sp-card-art">☮</div><div class="sp-card-content"><div class="sp-card-year">1967</div><div class="sp-card-name">Cold War · 1967</div><div class="sp-card-desc">11 Jun 1967 · decolonised Africa · divided Germany/Vietnam/Korea · post-Six-Day-War control.</div></div><div class="sp-card-check">✓</div></div>
    <div class="sp-card" data-scen="hist1989"><div class="sp-card-bg" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1d2940 0%,#4d665b 55%,#41364a 100%)"></div><div class="sp-card-overlay"></div><div class="sp-card-art">🧱</div><div class="sp-card-content"><div class="sp-card-year">1989</div><div class="sp-card-name">Cold War · 1989</div><div class="sp-card-desc">April 1989 · FRG/GDR · USSR · Yugoslavia · Czechoslovakia · pre-Wall-fall world.</div></div><div class="sp-card-check">✓</div></div>
    <div class="sp-group-title">CUSTOM WORLDS</div>
    <div class="sp-card" data-scen="unstableSmp">
      <div class="sp-card-bg" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#183528 0%,#66432d 52%,#2f243f 100%)"></div>
      <div class="sp-card-content"><div class="sp-card-era">UNSTABLE SMP</div><div class="sp-card-name">Kingdoms & Civil War</div><div class="sp-card-desc">Lore-inspired custom scenario · Parrot's Kingdom, Cindercrest, Arachnid's Kingdom, Merchant City, The Law and other major powers.</div></div><div class="sp-card-check">✓</div>

    <div class="sp-group-title tno">THE NEW ORDER</div>

      <div class="sp-card-bg" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#151515 0%,#49483f 52%,#4a2f34 100%)"></div>
      <div class="sp-card-overlay"></div>
      <div class="sp-card-art">⌛</div>
      <div class="sp-card-content">
        <div class="sp-card-year">1962</div>
        <div class="sp-card-name">TNO · CURRENT WIKI MAP</div>
        <div class="sp-card-desc">Native full-world 1962 TNO map · current province mesh · no legacy remap/rebuild.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="sp-card-check">✓</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div id="sp-footer">
    <div id="sp-footer-left">
      <div id="sp-alliances-row">
        <label id="sp-alliances-toggle">
          <input type="checkbox" id="sp-alliances-cb" checked>
          <div class="sp-tog-track"></div>
          <div class="sp-tog-thumb"></div>
        </label>
        <span id="sp-alliances-label">🤝 STARTING ALLIANCES</span>
      </div>
      <span id="sp-sel-name">Modern Day · 2024 selected</span>
    </div>
    <button id="sp-back">← BACK</button>
    <button id="sp-editor">✏ MAP EDITOR</button>
    <button id="sp-confirm">CONFIRM →</button>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ══ COUNTRY SELECTION BAR ══ -->
<div id="countryBar">
  <div id="cb-header">
    <h3>SELECT YOUR NATION</h3>
    <div id="cb-scen-badge">Modern Day · 2024</div>
    <input id="cb-search" placeholder="Search nations…" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false">
  </div>
  <div id="cb-list"></div>
  <div id="cb-footer">

<!-- ══ SETTINGS MODAL ══ -->
<div id="settingsModal">
  <div id="set-panel">

        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="set-row">
        <span class="set-label">Music</span>

          <input type="checkbox" id="set-music" checked>
          <div class="set-toggle-track"></div>
          <div class="set-toggle-thumb"></div>
        </label>
      </div>
      <div class="set-row">
        <span class="set-label">Sound Effects</span>
        <label class="set-toggle">
          <input type="checkbox" id="set-sfx" checked>
          <div class="set-toggle-track"></div>
          <div class="set-toggle-thumb"></div>
        </label>
      </div>
      <div class="set-row">
        <span class="set-label">Ambient Sounds</span>
        <label class="set-toggle">
          <input type="checkbox" id="set-ambient" checked>
          <div class="set-toggle-track"></div>
          <div class="set-toggle-thumb"></div>
        </label>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="set-section">
      <div class="set-section-title">GAMEPLAY</div>
      <div class="set-row">
        <span class="set-label">Bot Difficulty</span>
        <select class="set-select" id="set-bot-difficulty">
          <option value="easy">Easy (current)</option>
          <option value="normal">Normal</option>
          <option value="hard">Hard</option>
          <option value="brutal">Brutal</option>
        </select>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="set-section">
      <div class="set-section-title">DISPLAY</div>
      <div class="set-row">
        <span class="set-label">Show Division Labels</span>
        <label class="set-toggle">
          <input type="checkbox" id="set-divlabels" checked>
          <div class="set-toggle-track"></div>
          <div class="set-toggle-thumb"></div>
        </label>
      </div>
      <div class="set-row">
        <span class="set-label">Province Borders</span>
        <label class="set-toggle">
          <input type="checkbox" id="set-borders" checked>
          <div class="set-toggle-track"></div>
          <div class="set-toggle-thumb"></div>
        </label>
      </div>
    </div>
    <button id="set-close">CLOSE</button>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ══ EXIT CONFIRM ══ -->
<div id="exitConfirm">

</div>

<!-- ══ SAVE GAME MODAL ══ -->
<div id="saveModal">

<!-- ══ PEACE CONFERENCE ══ -->
<div id="peaceConference" aria-hidden="true">
  <div id="pc-banner">ALL WARS FINISHED · now decide who gets the land</div>
  <div id="pc-panel">
    <div id="pc-head">
      <div id="pc-kicker">POST-WAR SETTLEMENT</div>
      <div id="pc-title">Peace Settlement</div>
      <div id="pc-sub">Select land → choose a country → give it. That is it.</div>
    </div>
    <div id="pc-controls">
      <div>
        <div class="pc-label">WHO GETS THE SELECTED LAND?</div>
        <select id="pc-recipient" class="pc-select" title="Choose any country that should receive the selected land"></select>
      </div>
      <input id="pc-state-search" class="pc-input" placeholder="Find land…" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false">
      <div class="pc-brush-row">
        <span class="pc-label">MAP BRUSH · HOVER PREVIEW</span>
        <input id="pc-brush-slider" type="range" min="1" max="5" step="1" value="1" title="How many adjacent provinces the map brush selects">
        <span id="pc-brush-val" class="pc-brush-val">1</span>
      </div>
      <div id="pc-quick">
        <button class="pc-mini" id="pc-select-all">SELECT ALL LAND</button>
        <button class="pc-mini" id="pc-clear">CLEAR SELECTION</button>
        <button class="pc-mini" id="pc-annex-all-next">ANNEX THIS COUNTRY → NEXT</button>
        <button class="pc-mini danger" id="pc-annex-all-end">ANNEX ALL DEFEATED → END PEACE</button>
      </div>
      <div class="pc-label">PEACE TERMS FOR THIS DEFEATED COUNTRY</div>
      <div id="pc-terms">
        <button class="pc-mini" id="pc-take-resources">TAKE ALL RESOURCES</button>
        <button class="pc-mini" id="pc-force-leave">FORCE LEAVE ALLIANCE</button>
        <button class="pc-mini" id="pc-force-join">FORCE JOIN MY ALLIANCE</button>
      </div>
      <div id="pc-liberate-wrap">
        <div class="pc-label">FREE ORIGINAL NATIONS INSIDE THE DEFEATED COUNTRY</div>
        <div id="pc-liberate-list"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="pc-label" style="margin-top:2px">OR CREATE A BRAND-NEW INDEPENDENT STATE</div>
      <div class="pc-row">
        <input id="pc-new-name" class="pc-input" placeholder="New state name…" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false">
        <input id="pc-new-color" type="color" value="#4f9ecf" title="New state colour">
      </div>
    </div>
    <div id="pc-states"></div>
    <div id="pc-actions">
      <button class="pc-action red" id="pc-annex">GIVE SELECTED LAND</button>
      <button class="pc-action green" id="pc-release">CREATE NEW STATE FROM SELECTED</button>
      <div id="pc-log"></div>
      <button class="pc-action" id="pc-finish">✓ DONE · NEXT COUNTRY</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="gen-toggle" role="button" aria-label="Empire panel" title="Empire panel">☰</div>
<div id="gen-bar">

    <span id="gb-flag-civname">—</span>
  </div>

  <!-- Tab bar -->
  <div id="gb-tabs">
    <button class="gb-tab active" data-gbtab="general">📋 GEN</button>
    <button class="gb-tab" data-gbtab="bld">🏗 BLD</button>

    <button class="gb-tab" data-gbtab="tech">🔬 TECH</button>
  </div>

  <!-- General tab (Alliance, diplomacy) -->

    <div id="gb-alliance-widget" class="gb-alliance-wrap">
      <!-- Built dynamically by buildAllianceWidget() -->
    </div>
    <div id="gb-give-land-widget" class="gb-give-land">
      <div class="gb-give-title">TERRITORY TOOLS</div>
      <div class="gb-territory-mode-row">
        <button id="gb-give-start" class="gb-ab promote">🗺 GIVE LAND</button>
        <button id="gb-new-state-start" class="gb-ab join">＋ NEW STATE</button>
        <button id="gb-free-nations-start" class="gb-ab create">🕊 FREE NATIONS</button>
      </div>
      <div id="gb-give-controls" style="display:none">
        <div id="gb-give-hint" class="gb-give-hint">Use the brush on your provinces. Hover previews the exact area before you click.</div>

          <label for="gb-give-brush">BRUSH</label>
          <input id="gb-give-brush" type="range" min="1" max="5" step="1" value="1" title="Adjacent province brush size">
          <span id="gb-give-brush-val">1</span>
        </div>
        <div id="gb-give-status" class="gb-give-status">0 provinces selected</div>
        <div id="gb-give-existing-controls">
          <select id="gb-give-recipient" class="gb-give-select" title="Existing state that receives the selected land"></select>
          <button id="gb-give-confirm" class="gb-ab create" style="width:100%;margin:0">GIVE SELECTED LAND</button>
        </div>
        <div id="gb-give-new-controls" style="display:none">
          <div class="gb-territory-new-row">
            <input id="gb-new-state-name" class="gb-territory-input" maxlength="40" placeholder="New state name…" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false">
            <input id="gb-new-state-color" type="color" value="#4f9ecf" title="New state colour">
          </div>
          <button id="gb-new-state-confirm" class="gb-ab join" style="width:100%;margin-top:6px">CREATE STATE FROM SELECTED LAND</button>
        </div>
        <div id="gb-free-controls" style="display:none">
          <button id="gb-free-confirm" class="gb-ab create" style="width:100%;margin:0">🕊 FREE SELECTED NATIONS</button>
        </div>
        <div class="gb-give-actions">
          <button id="gb-give-clear" class="gb-ab promote">CLEAR</button>
          <button id="gb-give-cancel" class="gb-ab leave">CANCEL</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Buildings tab (was Econ) -->
  <div id="gb-tab-bld" class="gb-tab-content">
    <div class="gb-sect">UPGRADE PROVINCES</div>
    <div id="gb-econ-rows"></div>
    <div class="gb-divider"></div>
    <button class="gb-mass-all" id="gb-mass-all-btn">⚡ MASS UPGRADE ALL</button>
  </div>

  <!-- Military tab -->
  <div id="gb-tab-mil" class="gb-tab-content">
    <div class="gb-sect">MILITARY BUILDINGS</div>
    <div id="gb-mil-rows"></div>
  </div>

  <!-- Technology tab -->
  <div id="gb-tab-tech" class="gb-tab-content">
    <div class="gb-tech-placeholder">
      <span class="gb-tech-icon">🔬</span>
      <div class="gb-tech-title">RESEARCH</div>
      <div class="gb-tech-msg">Open the technology tree to research economic and military advancements for your civilization.</div>
      <button id="gb-tech-econ-btn" style="width:100%;padding:9px;border-radius:7px;font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:9px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:1.5px;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid rgba(100,220,80,.4);background:rgba(18,55,10,.8);color:#80cc60;margin-bottom:6px;transition:all .13s" onmouseover="this.style.background='rgba(28,80,14,.9)'" onmouseout="this.style.background='rgba(18,55,10,.8)'">🌾 ECONOMIC TECH TREE</button>
      <button id="gb-tech-mil-btn" style="width:100%;padding:9px;border-radius:7px;font-family:'Cinzel',serif;font-size:9px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:1.5px;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid rgba(220,80,60,.4);background:rgba(55,10,8,.8);color:#e07060;transition:all .13s" onmouseover="this.style.background='rgba(80,14,10,.9)'" onmouseout="this.style.background='rgba(55,10,8,.8)'">⚔ MILITARY TECH TREE</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="pp">

  <div id="pp-recruit" class="pp-content"></div>

  </div>

  </div>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/topojson-client@3.1.0/dist/topojson-client.min.js" onerror="document.write('<script src=&quot;https://unpkg.com/topojson-client@3.1.0/dist/topojson-client.min.js&quot;><\/script>')"></script>
<script>
'use strict';

// ── DEVICE DETECTION ──────────────────────────────────────────────
// Runs before anything else. Sets isMobile and adds body class.
const isMobile = (()=>{
  // Do NOT classify a laptop as mobile merely because it has a touchscreen or
  // Windows display scaling makes screen.width look small in CSS pixels.
  // Prefer explicit browser/UA mobile signals, then require a coarse, non-hover
  // primary pointer for the generic fallback. This keeps convertible laptops on
  // the desktop UI while preserving phones/tablets.
  const ua = navigator.userAgent || '';
  const uaDataMobile = navigator.userAgentData?.mobile === true;
  const explicitMobileUA = /Android|iPhone|iPod|IEMobile|Opera Mini|Mobile/i.test(ua);
  const iPadLike = /iPad/i.test(ua) || (navigator.platform === 'MacIntel' && navigator.maxTouchPoints > 1);
  const coarsePrimary = window.matchMedia?.('(pointer: coarse)')?.matches === true;
  const noHover = window.matchMedia?.('(hover: none)')?.matches === true;
  const desktopUA = /Windows NT|CrOS|Linux x86_64|X11/i.test(ua) && !/Android/i.test(ua);
  const sw = window.screen?.width || window.innerWidth || 9999;
  const sh = window.screen?.height || window.innerHeight || 9999;
  const shortSide = Math.min(sw, sh);
  return uaDataMobile || explicitMobileUA || iPadLike || (!desktopUA && coarsePrimary && noHover && shortSide <= 900);
})();
if(isMobile) document.body.classList.add('mobile');

// ── MOBILE LANDSCAPE / VIEWPORT CONTROL ──────────────────────────
// If the OS/browser refuses physical landscape rotation, World Sandbox rotates
// its own UI/canvas and keeps a logical landscape viewport. Input coordinates
// are normalized back into that landscape coordinate system.
let _virtualLandscape = false;
let _lastMobilePhysicalLandscape = null;
let _mobileLayoutW = 0, _mobileLayoutH = 0, _mobileUiScale = 1;
const MOBILE_DESKTOP_MIN_W = 1180;
const MOBILE_DESKTOP_MIN_H = 664;
const MOBILE_UI_MAX_SCALE = 1;

function _readPhysicalViewport(){
  const vv=window.visualViewport;
  return {
    w:Math.max(1,Math.round(vv?.width||window.innerWidth||document.documentElement.clientWidth||1)),
    h:Math.max(1,Math.round(vv?.height||window.innerHeight||document.documentElement.clientHeight||1))
  };
}
function getGameViewportSize(){
  const {w,h}=_readPhysicalViewport();
  // Performance invariant: canvas stays at physical CSS-pixel resolution even though
  // the DOM is laid out at desktop dimensions and scaled down.
  return (isMobile&&w<h)?{width:h,height:w}:{width:w,height:h};
}
function _setMobileSafeAreaMapping(){
  // Desktop-parity mode intentionally keeps PC edge placement. visualViewport
  // already tracks browser chrome; do not individually shift widgets on mobile.
  const root=document.documentElement.style;
  root.setProperty('--safe-top','0px');root.setProperty('--safe-right','0px');
  root.setProperty('--safe-bottom','0px');root.setProperty('--safe-left','0px');
}
function syncMobileLayout(){
  if(!isMobile)return;
  const {w:vw,h:vh}=_readPhysicalViewport();
  const physicalLandscape=vw>=vh;
  _virtualLandscape=!physicalLandscape;
  const orientedW=physicalLandscape?vw:vh;
  const orientedH=physicalLandscape?vh:vw;

  // Mobile uses the desktop UI unchanged. The 1180×664 logical desktop viewport is
  // only ~8% tighter than a 1280×720 reference, making controls a small percentage
  // larger on phones without switching to a separate mobile composition. The canvas
  // remains at native oriented CSS-pixel resolution.
  const scale=Math.min(MOBILE_UI_MAX_SCALE,orientedW/MOBILE_DESKTOP_MIN_W,orientedH/MOBILE_DESKTOP_MIN_H);
  _mobileUiScale=Math.max(0.40,scale||1);
  _mobileLayoutW=Math.max(MOBILE_DESKTOP_MIN_W,orientedW/_mobileUiScale);
  _mobileLayoutH=Math.max(MOBILE_DESKTOP_MIN_H,orientedH/_mobileUiScale);

  const root=document.documentElement.style;
  root.setProperty('--physical-vw',vw+'px');
  root.setProperty('--physical-vh',vh+'px');
  root.setProperty('--mobile-ui-scale',String(_mobileUiScale));
  root.setProperty('--mobile-layout-w',_mobileLayoutW+'px');
  root.setProperty('--mobile-layout-h',_mobileLayoutH+'px');
  root.setProperty('--mobile-vw',_mobileLayoutW+'px');
  root.setProperty('--mobile-vh',_mobileLayoutH+'px');
  _setMobileSafeAreaMapping();
  document.body.classList.add('landscape');
  document.body.classList.remove('portrait');
  document.body.classList.toggle('virtual-landscape',_virtualLandscape);
  _lastMobilePhysicalLandscape=physicalLandscape;
}
async function tryForceLandscape(){
  if(!isMobile)return;
  try{if(window.screen?.orientation?.lock)await window.screen.orientation.lock('landscape');}catch(_){}
  resize();
}

function clientToCanvasPoint(clientX,clientY){
  const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  if(_virtualLandscape){
    return {
      x:((clientY-r.top)/Math.max(1,r.height))*canvas.width,
      y:((r.right-clientX)/Math.max(1,r.width))*canvas.height
    };
  }
  return {
    x:((clientX-r.left)/Math.max(1,r.width))*canvas.width,
    y:((clientY-r.top)/Math.max(1,r.height))*canvas.height
  };
}
function clientMidpointToCanvas(a,b){
  return clientToCanvasPoint((a.clientX+b.clientX)*.5,(a.clientY+b.clientY)*.5);
}

if(isMobile){
  syncMobileLayout();
  // Real rotation remains a best-effort enhancement; virtual landscape is immediate.
  document.addEventListener('pointerdown',()=>{tryForceLandscape();},{once:true,capture:true,passive:true});
  window.addEventListener('orientationchange',()=>resize(),{passive:true});
  window.screen?.orientation?.addEventListener?.('change',()=>resize());
}

// ── POLYFILLS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// ctx.roundRect is not available in all browsers (added Chrome 99, FF 112)
if(!CanvasRenderingContext2D.prototype.roundRect){
  CanvasRenderingContext2D.prototype.roundRect=function(x,y,w,h,r){
    r=Math.min(r,w/2,h/2);
    this.beginPath();
    this.moveTo(x+r,y);
    this.lineTo(x+w-r,y); this.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+r,r);
    this.lineTo(x+w,y+h-r); this.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x+w-r,y+h,r);
    this.lineTo(x+r,y+h); this.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y+h-r,r);
    this.lineTo(x,y+r); this.arcTo(x,y,x+r,y,r);
    this.closePath();
  };
}

  market:  {tab:'econ',icon:'🏪',name:'Market',   prod:{coins:0.8},mul:[0,1,1.5,1.83], costs:[{w:30,s:30},{w:60,s:60},{w:120,s:120}]},
  barracks:{tab:'mil', icon:'⚔', name:'Barracks', note:'Max foxes +{v}',vals:[0,5,12,25],costs:[{w:25,s:25},{w:50,s:50 },{w:100,s:100}]},
  fort:    {tab:'mil', icon:'🏰',name:'Fort',      note:'Defense ×{v}',  vals:[0,'1.17','1.33','1.50'],  costs:[{w:40,s:60},{w:80,s:120},{w:160,s:240}]},
  tower:   {tab:'mil', icon:'🗼',name:'Watchtower',note:'Range +{v}',     vals:[0,1,2,3],  costs:[{w:20,s:40},{w:40,s:80 },{w:80, s:160}]},
};
const ECON_BLDS=['farm','sawmill','mine','market'];
const MIL_BLDS =['barracks','fort','tower'];
// Pre-cache production pairs to avoid Object.entries() in the hot tickResources loop
for(const bname of ECON_BLDS){
  const def=BLDEFS[bname];

}
