// ── COLOUR UTILITIES ──────────────────────────────────────────────
function hslToHex(h,s,l){const a=s*Math.min(l,1-l);const f=n=>{const k=(n+h/30)%12,v=l-a*Math.max(-1,Math.min(k-3,9-k,1));return Math.round(255*v).toString(16).padStart(2,'0')};return '#'+f(0)+f(8)+f(4)}
function darken(hex,p){let c=hex.replace('#','');if(c.length===3)c=c[0]+c[0]+c[1]+c[1]+c[2]+c[2];const n=parseInt(c,16);return '#'+[((n>>16)-Math.round(255*p)),((n>>8&0xff)-Math.round(255*p)),((n&0xff)-Math.round(255*p))].map(v=>Math.max(0,Math.min(255,v)).toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('')}
function lighten(hex,p){let c=hex.replace('#','');if(c.length===3)c=c[0]+c[0]+c[1]+c[1]+c[2]+c[2];const n=parseInt(c,16);return '#'+[((n>>16)+Math.round((255-(n>>16))*p)),((n>>8&0xff)+Math.round((255-(n>>8&0xff))*p)),((n&0xff)+Math.round((255-(n&0xff))*p))].map(v=>Math.min(255,v).toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('')}
function countryColor(name,idx){if(CCOLORS[name])return CCOLORS[name];return hslToHex((idx*137.508)%360,0.42,0.38+((idx*3)%5)*0.04)}
function hexToAbgr(hex){let c=hex.replace('#','');if(c.length===3)c=c[0]+c[0]+c[1]+c[1]+c[2]+c[2];const n=parseInt(c,16);return(0xFF000000|((n&0xff)<<16)|((n>>8&0xff)<<8)|(n>>16))>>>0}



// ── CANVAS & STATE ────────────────────────────────────────────────
const baseCanvas=document.getElementById('base-c');
const mapCanvas=document.getElementById('map-c');
const canvas=document.getElementById('c');
const labelCanvas=document.getElementById('label-c');
const fxCanvas=document.getElementById('fx-c');
// Mobile WebKit is substantially more memory-sensitive to multiple low-latency canvas
// compositor surfaces. Keep the desktop desynchronised fast path, but request the normal
// buffered path on phones. This changes no pixels or simulation state.
const _screenCanvasDesync=!isMobile;
const baseCtx=baseCanvas.getContext('2d',{alpha:false,willReadFrequently:false,desynchronized:_screenCanvasDesync});
const mapCtx=mapCanvas.getContext('2d',{alpha:true,willReadFrequently:false,desynchronized:_screenCanvasDesync});
let ctx=canvas.getContext('2d',{alpha:true,willReadFrequently:false,desynchronized:_screenCanvasDesync});
const labelCtx=labelCanvas.getContext('2d',{alpha:true,willReadFrequently:false,desynchronized:_screenCanvasDesync});
const fxCtx=fxCanvas.getContext('2d',{alpha:true,willReadFrequently:false,desynchronized:_screenCanvasDesync});

// Compact map core: the old full-world build allocated ~1.7M tiny JS tile objects.
// Keep the public tileAt() shape, but store hot-path map state in typed arrays.
let grid=null, countries=[], provinces=[]; // grid retained as a legacy name; map data lives in typed buffers below
let tileProvMap, validTile;
let tileKindBuf=null;       // Uint8Array: 0 water/outside, 1 land
let tileCountryBuf=null;    // Int16Array: country id, -1 for water/outside
let _countryLandTiles=null; // country id -> row-major land tile indices, filled during rasterisation

let provAdj=new Map();
let selectedProv=-1;
let panelCivId=-1; // tracks which civ's country panel is open

// ── CIVILISATION SYSTEM ───────────────────────────────────────────
// civs[i] = { id, countryId, name, color, terrAbgr, res, ownedProvs, territory, foxes, spawnTick, isPlayer }
let civs=[];
let provOwner;     // Int16Array[numProvinces] → civId (-1 = unowned)
let tileCivBuf;    // Int16Array[WORLD_W*WORLD_H] → civId for territory overlay
let playerCivId=-1;
let gameMode='spectator'; // 'player' | 'spectator' | 'sandbox'

// Convenience getters pointing to player civ's data (or empty dummies)
const _emptySet=new Set(), _emptyRes={wood:0,stone:0,food:0,coins:0};
function playerCiv(){return playerCivId>=0?civs[playerCivId]:null}
function ownedProvs(){return playerCivId>=0?civs[playerCivId].ownedProvs:_emptySet}

// Territory used to eagerly allocate one "x,y" string per owned tile during every
// reset/scenario rebuild. Internal gameplay is province-based, so preserve the public
// Set API but materialise those legacy strings only if somebody actually reads them.
class LazyTerritorySet extends Set{
  constructor(pids=[]){super();this._provIds=new Set(pids);this._materialized=false;}
  _ensure(){if(this._materialized)return;this._materialized=true;for(const pid of this._provIds){const p=provinces[pid];if(!p)continue;for(const ti of p.tiles)super.add(`${ti%WORLD_W},${(ti/WORLD_W)|0}`);}}
  resetProvinces(pids=[]){super.clear();this._provIds=new Set(pids);this._materialized=false;return this;}
  addProvince(pid){if(this._materialized){const p=provinces[pid];if(p)for(const ti of p.tiles)super.add(`${ti%WORLD_W},${(ti/WORLD_W)|0}`);}this._provIds.add(pid);return this;}
  deleteProvince(pid){if(this._materialized){const p=provinces[pid];if(p)for(const ti of p.tiles)super.delete(`${ti%WORLD_W},${(ti/WORLD_W)|0}`);}return this._provIds.delete(pid);}
  get size(){this._ensure();return super.size;}
  has(v){this._ensure();return super.has(v);}
  add(v){this._ensure();return super.add(v);}
  delete(v){this._ensure();return super.delete(v);}
  clear(){this._provIds.clear();this._materialized=true;return super.clear();}
  values(){this._ensure();return super.values();}
  keys(){this._ensure();return super.keys();}
  entries(){this._ensure();return super.entries();}
  forEach(cb,thisArg){this._ensure();return super.forEach(cb,thisArg);}
  [Symbol.iterator](){this._ensure();return super[Symbol.iterator]();}
}
function territory(){return playerCivId>=0?civs[playerCivId].territory:_emptySet}
function res(){return playerCivId>=0?civs[playerCivId].res:_emptyRes}
function foxes(){return playerCivId>=0?civs[playerCivId].foxes:[]}
function foxCap(){ return playerCivId>=0 ? civFoxCap(civs[playerCivId]) : 0; }
function isAdjToOwned(pid){
  if(playerCivId<0) return false;
  const adj=provAdj.get(pid); if(!adj) return false;
  for(const n of adj){
    if(provinces[n]&&provinces[n].isSea) continue; // sea zones don't count as owned-adjacency
    if(civs[playerCivId].ownedProvs.has(n)) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

// Returns true if ANY province owned by civId shares a tile border with ANY player-owned province.
// Used to gate war declarations — the civ must physically touch the player somewhere on the map.
function isAdjToCiv(civId){
  if(playerCivId<0) return false;
  const playerOwned = civs[playerCivId].ownedProvs;
  for(const pid of civs[civId].ownedProvs){
    const adj = provAdj.get(pid); if(!adj) continue;
    for(const n of adj) if(playerOwned.has(n)) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

// ── FULL-ENGINE PERFORMANCE PASS: retained rendering + zero-churn HUD/audio/highlights ──
// ── CAMERA ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
let camX=570, camY=240, zoom=0.24;
let time=0, spawnTick=0, gameReady=false, mapReady=false;
let gameSpeed=0;        // 0=paused, 1/2/3/5 = ticks per frame multiplier
let gameDayFrac=0;      // fractional day counter for date display
let gameDay=1, gameMonth=1, gameYear=2024; // set properly per scenario in startGame
let showFoxes=true, showLabels=true, showBuildings=true, showCities=true, showBorders=true;

// ── IRON FRONT v18 FULL SOUNDSCAPE (ported + adapted) ───────────
const AudioEngine = {
    ctx: null,
    initialized: false,
    muted: false,
    masterVolume: 0.80,
    masterGain: null,
    compressor: null,
    convolver: null,
    reverbGain: null,
    buses: {},
    noiseBuffer: null,
    activeNodes: {},
    activeVoices: 0,
    maxVoices: 72,
    lastPlayed: new Map(),
    ambientStarted: false,
    musicStarted: false,    musicTimer: 0,
    musicStep: 0,
    nextWorldAccentAt: 0,
    firearmBuffers: [], firearmReady: [], firearmLoadStarted: false, firearmVariant: 0,
    marchBuffers: [], marchReady: [], marchLoadStarted: false, marchVariant: 0,
    marchUrls: [
      'https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/01-footstep_0.ogg',
      'https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/02-footstep.ogg',
      'https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/03-footstep.ogg',
      'https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/04-footstep.ogg',
      'https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/05-footstep.ogg',
      'https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/06-footstep.ogg'
    ],
    firearmUrls: [
      'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeathByDenim/openspades-free-pak/main/Sounds/Weapons/Rifle/Fire.opus',
      'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeathByDenim/openspades-free-pak/main/Sounds/Weapons/Rifle/Fire1.opus',
      'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeathByDenim/openspades-free-pak/main/Sounds/Weapons/Rifle/Fire2.opus',
      'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeathByDenim/openspades-free-pak/main/Sounds/Weapons/Rifle/Fire3.opus',
      'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeathByDenim/openspades-free-pak/main/Sounds/Weapons/Rifle/FireFar.opus',
      'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DeathByDenim/openspades-free-pak/main/Sounds/Weapons/SMG/FireStereo.opus'
    ],

    init() {
        if (this.initialized) { this.resume(); return; }
        try {
            const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
            if (!AC) return;
            this.ctx = new AC({ latencyHint: 'interactive' });
            this.masterGain = this.ctx.createGain();
            this.compressor = this.ctx.createDynamicsCompressor();
            this.compressor.threshold.setValueAtTime(-16, this.ctx.currentTime);
            this.compressor.knee.setValueAtTime(16, this.ctx.currentTime);
            this.compressor.ratio.setValueAtTime(5, this.ctx.currentTime);
            this.compressor.attack.setValueAtTime(0.004, this.ctx.currentTime);
            this.compressor.release.setValueAtTime(0.18, this.ctx.currentTime);
            this.masterGain.gain.value = this.masterVolume;
            this.masterGain.connect(this.compressor);
            this.compressor.connect(this.ctx.destination);

            const makeBus = (gain) => {
                const node = this.ctx.createGain();
                node.gain.value = gain;
                node.connect(this.masterGain);
                return node;
            };
            this.buses.ui = makeBus(0.72);
            this.buses.world = makeBus(0.78);
            this.buses.combat = makeBus(0.86);
            this.buses.ambience = makeBus(0.30);
            this.buses.music = makeBus(0.22);

            this.convolver = this.ctx.createConvolver();
            this.reverbGain = this.ctx.createGain();
            this.reverbGain.gain.value = 0.30;
            this.convolver.buffer = this.makeImpulse(0.72, 2.1);
            this.convolver.connect(this.reverbGain);
            this.reverbGain.connect(this.masterGain);

            this.noiseBuffer = this.makeNoiseBuffer(2.0);
            this.initialized = true;
            this.resume();
            this._loadFirearmRecordings();
            this._loadMarchRecordings();
            this.syncControls();
        } catch (e) {
            console.warn('Audio init failed:', e);
        }
    },

    resume() {
        try {
            if (this.ctx && this.ctx.state === 'suspended') this.ctx.resume();
        } catch (e) {}
    },

    makeNoiseBuffer(seconds = 2) {
        const frames = Math.max(1, Math.floor(this.ctx.sampleRate * seconds));
        const buffer = this.ctx.createBuffer(1, frames, this.ctx.sampleRate);
        const data = buffer.getChannelData(0);
        let brown = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < frames; i++) {
            const white = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
            brown = (brown + 0.02 * white) / 1.02;
            data[i] = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, white * 0.72 + brown * 1.8)) * 0.56;
        }
        return buffer;
    },

    makeImpulse(seconds = 0.7, decay = 2) {
        const frames = Math.max(1, Math.floor(this.ctx.sampleRate * seconds));
        const buffer = this.ctx.createBuffer(2, frames, this.ctx.sampleRate);
        for (let ch = 0; ch < 2; ch++) {
            const data = buffer.getChannelData(ch);
            for (let i = 0; i < frames; i++) {
                const env = Math.pow(1 - i / frames, decay);
                data[i] = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * env * (ch ? 0.82 : 1);
            }
        }
        return buffer;
    },

    setVolume(value) {
        this.masterVolume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Number(value) || 0));
        if (this.masterGain && this.ctx) {
            const target = this.muted ? 0 : this.masterVolume;
            this.masterGain.gain.cancelScheduledValues(this.ctx.currentTime);
            this.masterGain.gain.setTargetAtTime(target, this.ctx.currentTime, 0.015);
        }
        this.syncControls();
    },

    toggleMute() {
        this.init();
        this.muted = !this.muted;
        this.setVolume(this.masterVolume);
        if (!this.muted) this.confirm();
        return this.muted;
    },

    _settingRefs: null,
    _settings() {
        let r=this._settingRefs;
        if(!r){r=this._settingRefs={vol:document.getElementById('set-vol'),volVal:document.getElementById('set-vol-val'),sfx:document.getElementById('set-sfx'),ambient:document.getElementById('set-ambient'),music:document.getElementById('set-music')};}
        return r;
    },
    syncControls() {
        const r=this._settings(),slider=r.vol,value=r.volVal;
        if (slider && document.activeElement !== slider) slider.value = Math.round(this.masterVolume * 100);
        if (value) value.textContent = Math.round(this.masterVolume * 100);
    },

    sfxEnabled() { const el=this._settings().sfx; return !el || el.checked; },
    ambientEnabled() { const el=this._settings().ambient; return !el || el.checked; },
    musicEnabled() { const el=this._settings().music; return !el || el.checked; },

    busEnabled(bus) {
        if (bus === 'ambience') return this.ambientEnabled();
        if (bus === 'music') return this.musicEnabled();
        return this.sfxEnabled();
    },

    syncFromSettings() {
        const slider = this._settings().vol;
        if (slider) this.setVolume((Number(slider.value) || 0) / 100);
        if (!this.initialized || !gameReady) return;
        if (this.ambientEnabled()) this.startAmbience(); else this.stopAmbience();
        if (this.musicEnabled()) this.startMusic(); else this.stopMusic();
    },

    canPlay(key, minGapMs = 0) {
        const now = performance.now();
        const last = this.lastPlayed.get(key) || -Infinity;
        if (now - last < minGapMs) return false;
        this.lastPlayed.set(key, now);
        return true;
    },

    stopGroup(groupId) {
        if (!groupId || !this.activeNodes[groupId]) return;
        const nodes = this.activeNodes[groupId].slice();
        this.activeNodes[groupId].length = 0;
        for (const node of nodes) {
            try { if (node.stop) node.stop(); } catch (e) {}
            try { node.disconnect(); } catch (e) {}
        }
    },

    registerNode(groupId, node) {
        if (!groupId || !node) return;
        if (!this.activeNodes[groupId]) this.activeNodes[groupId] = [];
        this.activeNodes[groupId].push(node);
    },

    attachSourceLifecycle(source, groupId = null) {
        this.activeVoices++;
        if (groupId) this.registerNode(groupId, source);
        const previous = source.onended;
        source.onended = () => {
            this.activeVoices = Math.max(0, this.activeVoices - 1);
            if (groupId && this.activeNodes[groupId]) {
                const idx = this.activeNodes[groupId].indexOf(source);
                if (idx !== -1) this.activeNodes[groupId].splice(idx, 1);
            }
            if (typeof previous === 'function') {
                try { previous(); } catch (e) {}
            }
        };
    },

    makePanner(pan = 0) {
        if (!this.ctx || !this.ctx.createStereoPanner) return null;
        const panner = this.ctx.createStereoPanner();
        panner.pan.value = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, pan));
        return panner;
    },

    connectOutput(node, bus = 'world', pan = 0, reverb = 0) {
        const busNode = this.buses[bus] || this.buses.world || this.masterGain;
        const panner = this.makePanner(pan);
        if (panner) {
            node.connect(panner);
            panner.connect(busNode);
            if (reverb > 0 && this.convolver) {
                const send = this.ctx.createGain();
                send.gain.value = reverb;
                panner.connect(send);
                send.connect(this.convolver);
            }
        } else {
            node.connect(busNode);
            if (reverb > 0 && this.convolver) {
                const send = this.ctx.createGain();
                send.gain.value = reverb;
                node.connect(send);
                send.connect(this.convolver);
            }
        }
    },

    playTone(frequency, duration, type = 'sine', volume = 0.1, ramp = null, delay = 0, groupId = null, pan = 0, bus = 'ui', reverb = 0, attack = 0.004) {
        try {
            this.init();
            if (!this.ctx || this.muted || !this.busEnabled(bus) || this.activeVoices >= this.maxVoices) return null;
            this.resume();
            const now = this.ctx.currentTime + Math.max(0, delay);
            const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
            const gain = this.ctx.createGain();
            osc.type = type;
            const startFreq = Math.max(20, frequency);
            osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(startFreq, now);
            if (ramp && Number.isFinite(ramp.target)) {
                osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(20, ramp.target), now + Math.max(0.01, duration));
            }
            const vol = Math.max(0.0001, Math.min(0.95, volume));
            gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, now);
            gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(vol, now + Math.max(0.002, attack));
            gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + Math.max(0.01, duration));
            osc.connect(gain);
            this.connectOutput(gain, bus, pan, reverb);
            this.attachSourceLifecycle(osc, groupId);
            osc.start(now);
            osc.stop(now + Math.max(0.02, duration) + 0.01);
            return osc;
        } catch (e) { return null; }
    },

    playNoise(duration, volume = 0.1, filterFreq = 1200, filterType = 'lowpass', delay = 0, groupId = null, pan = 0, bus = 'world', reverb = 0.08, attack = 0.003, playbackRate = 1) {
        try {
            this.init();
            if (!this.ctx || this.muted || !this.busEnabled(bus) || !this.noiseBuffer || this.activeVoices >= this.maxVoices) return null;
            const now = this.ctx.currentTime + Math.max(0, delay);
            const src = this.ctx.createBufferSource();
            const filter = this.ctx.createBiquadFilter();
            const gain = this.ctx.createGain();
            src.buffer = this.noiseBuffer;
            src.playbackRate.value = playbackRate;
            filter.type = filterType;
            filter.frequency.setValueAtTime(Math.max(60, filterFreq), now);
            filter.Q.value = filterType === 'bandpass' ? 1.2 : 0.55;
            gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, now);
            gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(0.0001, Math.min(0.95, volume)), now + Math.max(0.002, attack));
            gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + Math.max(0.015, duration));
            src.connect(filter);
            filter.connect(gain);
            this.connectOutput(gain, bus, pan, reverb);
            this.attachSourceLifecycle(src, groupId);
            src.start(now, Math.random() * Math.max(0.01, this.noiseBuffer.duration - 0.2));
            src.stop(now + Math.max(0.02, duration) + 0.01);
            return src;
        } catch (e) { return null; }
    },

    spatialForGrid(x, y) {
        try {
            const px = (x - camX) * TS * zoom;
            const py = (y - camY) * TS * zoom;
            const w = Math.max(1, canvas?.width || window.innerWidth || 1);
            const h = Math.max(1, canvas?.height || window.innerHeight || 1);
            const visible = px >= -120 && px <= w + 120 && py >= -120 && py <= h + 120;
            const pan = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, ((px / w) * 2) - 1));
            const edge = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, Math.hypot(px - w * 0.5, py - h * 0.5) / Math.max(w, h)));
            return { visible, pan, gain: 1 - edge * 0.38 };
        } catch (e) {
            return { visible: true, pan: 0, gain: 1 };
        }
    },

    click() {
        if (!this.canPlay('ui-click', 18)) return;
        const p = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 40;
        this.playTone(1120 + p, 0.045, 'triangle', 0.13, { target: 760 + p }, 0, 'ui-click', 0, 'ui', 0.02);
        this.playNoise(0.022, 0.035, 3600, 'highpass', 0, 'ui-click', 0, 'ui', 0);
    },

    confirm() {
        if (!this.canPlay('ui-confirm', 45)) return;
        this.playTone(660, 0.07, 'sine', 0.11, null, 0, 'ui-confirm', -0.05, 'ui', 0.05);
        this.playTone(990, 0.10, 'sine', 0.09, null, 0.055, 'ui-confirm', 0.05, 'ui', 0.08);
    },

    dropdown() {
        if (!this.canPlay('ui-dropdown', 45)) return;
        this.playTone(760, 0.055, 'triangle', 0.10, { target: 920 }, 0, 'ui-dropdown', -0.08, 'ui', 0.03);
        this.playTone(1160, 0.065, 'triangle', 0.08, { target: 990 }, 0.045, 'ui-dropdown', 0.08, 'ui', 0.04);
    },

    error() {
        if (!this.canPlay('ui-error', 120)) return;
        this.playTone(220, 0.13, 'square', 0.09, { target: 165 }, 0, 'ui-error', 0, 'ui', 0.01);
        this.playTone(146, 0.16, 'triangle', 0.08, { target: 116 }, 0.08, 'ui-error', 0, 'ui', 0.02);
    },

    select() {
        if (!this.canPlay('ui-select', 30)) return;
        this.playTone(520 + Math.random() * 50, 0.035, 'sine', 0.07, null, 0, 'ui-select', 0, 'ui', 0.01);
    },

    war() {
        if (!this.canPlay('war-declare', 450)) return;
        const grp = 'war';
        this.stopGroup(grp);
        this.playNoise(0.58, 0.22, 240, 'lowpass', 0, grp, -0.12, 'combat', 0.32, 0.002, 0.78);
        this.playTone(68, 0.62, 'sawtooth', 0.24, { target: 42 }, 0, grp, -0.10, 'combat', 0.35, 0.006);
        this.playTone(196, 0.72, 'triangle', 0.14, { target: 147 }, 0.08, grp, 0.06, 'combat', 0.42, 0.018);
        this.playTone(98, 0.85, 'square', 0.09, { target: 82 }, 0.11, grp, 0.18, 'combat', 0.25, 0.02);
        this.playNoise(0.18, 0.12, 2800, 'bandpass', 0.33, grp, 0.22, 'combat', 0.28, 0.001, 1.18);
        this.playTone(392, 0.18, 'triangle', 0.10, { target: 330 }, 0.46, grp, 0.08, 'world', 0.32);
    },

    peace() {
        if (!this.canPlay('peace', 240)) return;
        const grp = 'peace';
        this.stopGroup(grp);
        const notes = [261.63, 329.63, 392.0, 523.25];
        notes.forEach((f, i) => this.playTone(f, 0.78 - i * 0.05, 'sine', 0.085, null, i * 0.085, grp, (i - 1.5) * 0.14, 'world', 0.52, 0.025));
        this.playTone(1046.5, 0.85, 'triangle', 0.055, { target: 784 }, 0.03, grp, 0.16, 'world', 0.65, 0.006);
        this.playNoise(0.22, 0.025, 5200, 'highpass', 0.12, grp, 0, 'world', 0.40, 0.02, 1.35);
    },

    annex() {
        if (!this.canPlay('annex', 320)) return;
        const grp = 'annex';
        this.stopGroup(grp);
        this.playNoise(0.78, 0.28, 190, 'lowpass', 0, grp, 0, 'combat', 0.42, 0.002, 0.70);
        this.playTone(72, 0.72, 'sawtooth', 0.28, { target: 34 }, 0, grp, -0.08, 'combat', 0.45, 0.008);
        this.playTone(110, 0.56, 'triangle', 0.18, { target: 55 }, 0.06, grp, 0.08, 'combat', 0.36, 0.006);
        this.playNoise(0.11, 0.11, 4200, 'bandpass', 0.08, grp, 0.18, 'combat', 0.22, 0.001, 1.6);
        [220, 277.18, 329.63].forEach((f, i) => this.playTone(f, 0.46, 'triangle', 0.065, null, 0.20 + i * 0.07, grp, (i - 1) * 0.14, 'world', 0.40));
    },

    revolt() {
        if (!this.canPlay('revolt', 420)) return;
        const grp = 'revolt';
        this.stopGroup(grp);
        this.playNoise(0.62, 0.15, 1350, 'bandpass', 0, grp, -0.10, 'world', 0.24, 0.01, 0.82);
        for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            const base = i % 2 ? 560 : 410;
            this.playTone(base, 0.19, 'sawtooth', 0.08, { target: base * 1.10 }, i * 0.15, grp, i % 2 ? 0.25 : -0.25, 'world', 0.28, 0.005);
        }
        this.playNoise(0.22, 0.10, 2800, 'highpass', 0.18, grp, 0.08, 'combat', 0.18, 0.001, 1.25);
    },

    industry() {
        if (!this.canPlay('industry', 160)) return;
        const grp = 'industry';
        this.playNoise(0.30, 0.08, 760, 'bandpass', 0, grp, -0.12, 'world', 0.10, 0.002, 0.9);
        this.playTone(92, 0.30, 'sawtooth', 0.10, { target: 132 }, 0, grp, -0.08, 'world', 0.08, 0.012);
        [840, 1160, 1540].forEach((f, i) => this.playTone(f, 0.055, 'square', 0.045, { target: f * 0.7 }, 0.045 + i * 0.065, grp, (i - 1) * 0.15, 'ui', 0.05, 0.001));
        this.playNoise(0.065, 0.055, 4200, 'highpass', 0.22, grp, 0.14, 'world', 0.08, 0.001, 1.45);
    },

    victory() {
        if (!this.canPlay('victory', 400)) return;
        const grp = 'victory';
        this.stopGroup(grp);
        const notes = [261.63, 329.63, 392, 523.25, 659.25, 783.99];
        notes.forEach((f, i) => this.playTone(f, i < 3 ? 0.55 : 0.78, i % 2 ? 'triangle' : 'sine', 0.075, null, i * 0.09, grp, (i - 2.5) * 0.12, 'world', 0.48, 0.018));
        this.playNoise(0.35, 0.05, 5000, 'highpass', 0.33, grp, 0, 'world', 0.42, 0.025, 1.2);
    },

    alliance() {
        if (!this.canPlay('alliance', 220)) return;
        const grp = 'alliance';
        [392, 493.88, 587.33, 783.99].forEach((f, i) => this.playTone(f, 0.38 + i * 0.05, 'sine', 0.07, null, i * 0.06, grp, (i - 1.5) * 0.12, 'world', 0.35, 0.012));
        this.playNoise(0.10, 0.028, 4800, 'highpass', 0.08, grp, 0, 'ui', 0.22, 0.002, 1.3);
    },

    allianceBreak() {
        if (!this.canPlay('alliance-break', 260)) return;
        const grp = 'alliance-break';
        this.playNoise(0.18, 0.10, 1800, 'bandpass', 0, grp, 0, 'world', 0.18, 0.001, 1.05);
        this.playTone(294, 0.28, 'triangle', 0.09, { target: 196 }, 0, grp, -0.08, 'world', 0.22);
        this.playTone(196, 0.34, 'sawtooth', 0.065, { target: 116 }, 0.10, grp, 0.08, 'world', 0.22);
    },

    gift() {
        if (!this.canPlay('gift', 120)) return;
        [660, 880, 1320].forEach((f, i) => this.playTone(f, 0.24, 'sine', 0.055, { target: f * 1.06 }, i * 0.045, 'gift', (i - 1) * 0.16, 'ui', 0.32, 0.005));
        this.playNoise(0.16, 0.020, 6000, 'highpass', 0.05, 'gift', 0, 'ui', 0.36, 0.005, 1.45);
    },

    smite() {
        if (!this.canPlay('smite', 180)) return;
        const grp = 'smite';
        this.playNoise(0.48, 0.28, 260, 'lowpass', 0, grp, 0, 'combat', 0.48, 0.001, 0.72);
        this.playNoise(0.095, 0.18, 4800, 'highpass', 0, grp, -0.04, 'combat', 0.18, 0.001, 1.65);
        this.playTone(66, 0.58, 'sawtooth', 0.24, { target: 28 }, 0, grp, 0.04, 'combat', 0.45, 0.002);
    },

    paintStroke(screenX = null) {
        if (!this.canPlay('paint', 85)) return;
        const pan = Number.isFinite(screenX) ? Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, (screenX / Math.max(1, window.innerWidth)) * 2 - 1)) : 0;
        this.playNoise(0.055, 0.025, 2200, 'bandpass', 0, 'paint', pan, 'ui', 0.02, 0.002, 1.2 + Math.random() * 0.25);
        this.playTone(310 + Math.random() * 90, 0.035, 'triangle', 0.025, null, 0, 'paint', pan, 'ui', 0.01);
    },

    territoryCapture(x, y, major = false) {
        if (!this.canPlay(major ? 'capture-major' : 'capture', major ? 110 : 65)) return;
        const s = this.spatialForGrid(x, y);
        if (!s.visible) return;
        const vol = (major ? 0.12 : 0.055) * s.gain;
        this.playNoise(major ? 0.23 : 0.095, vol, major ? 620 : 1500, major ? 'lowpass' : 'bandpass', 0, major ? 'capture-major' : 'capture', s.pan, 'combat', major ? 0.26 : 0.08, 0.001, 0.86 + Math.random() * 0.35);
        this.playTone(major ? 88 : 180 + Math.random() * 45, major ? 0.26 : 0.08, major ? 'sawtooth' : 'triangle', vol * 0.82, { target: major ? 48 : 130 }, 0, major ? 'capture-major' : 'capture', s.pan, 'combat', major ? 0.22 : 0.05, 0.002);
    },

    navalLaunch(x, y) {
        if (!this.canPlay('naval-launch', 210)) return;
        const s = this.spatialForGrid(x, y);
        if (!s.visible) return;
        this.playTone(82, 0.48, 'sawtooth', 0.10 * s.gain, { target: 58 }, 0, 'naval-launch', s.pan, 'world', 0.24, 0.012);
        this.playTone(185, 0.44, 'triangle', 0.06 * s.gain, { target: 165 }, 0.06, 'naval-launch', s.pan, 'world', 0.34, 0.018);
        this.playNoise(0.26, 0.085 * s.gain, 900, 'bandpass', 0.02, 'naval-launch', s.pan, 'world', 0.18, 0.002, 0.78);
        this.playNoise(0.12, 0.045 * s.gain, 4200, 'highpass', 0.05, 'naval-launch', s.pan, 'world', 0.12, 0.001, 1.25);
    },

    navalCombat(x, y) {
        if (!this.canPlay('naval-combat', 105)) return;
        const s = this.spatialForGrid(x, y);
        if (!s.visible) return;
        this.playNoise(0.18, 0.13 * s.gain, 360, 'lowpass', 0, 'naval-combat', s.pan, 'combat', 0.32, 0.001, 0.78);
        this.playTone(76, 0.21, 'sawtooth', 0.12 * s.gain, { target: 38 }, 0, 'naval-combat', s.pan, 'combat', 0.34, 0.002);
        this.playNoise(0.055, 0.075 * s.gain, 5200, 'highpass', 0, 'naval-combat', s.pan, 'combat', 0.12, 0.001, 1.55);
    },

    navalSink(x, y) {
        if (!this.canPlay('naval-sink', 250)) return;
        const s = this.spatialForGrid(x, y);
        if (!s.visible) return;
        this.playTone(74, 0.62, 'sawtooth', 0.11 * s.gain, { target: 24 }, 0, 'naval-sink', s.pan, 'world', 0.38, 0.005);
        this.playNoise(0.55, 0.10 * s.gain, 720, 'lowpass', 0.06, 'naval-sink', s.pan, 'world', 0.34, 0.004, 0.62);
        this.playNoise(0.18, 0.055 * s.gain, 3400, 'highpass', 0.10, 'naval-sink', s.pan, 'world', 0.18, 0.002, 1.25);
    },

    beachhead(x, y) {
        if (!this.canPlay('beachhead', 220)) return;
        const s = this.spatialForGrid(x, y);
        if (!s.visible) return;
        this.playNoise(0.32, 0.12 * s.gain, 500, 'lowpass', 0, 'beachhead', s.pan, 'combat', 0.34, 0.001, 0.74);
        this.playTone(96, 0.30, 'sawtooth', 0.11 * s.gain, { target: 54 }, 0, 'beachhead', s.pan, 'combat', 0.30, 0.002);
        this.playNoise(0.14, 0.065 * s.gain, 2500, 'bandpass', 0.04, 'beachhead', s.pan, 'combat', 0.18, 0.001, 1.22);
        this.playTone(392, 0.24, 'triangle', 0.045 * s.gain, { target: 523 }, 0.15, 'beachhead', s.pan, 'world', 0.30);
    },

    save() {
        if (!this.canPlay('save', 100)) return;
        this.playTone(740, 0.06, 'sine', 0.07, null, 0, 'save', -0.08, 'ui', 0.06);
        this.playTone(988, 0.11, 'sine', 0.07, null, 0.055, 'save', 0.08, 'ui', 0.10);
    },

    load() {
        if (!this.canPlay('load', 100)) return;
        this.playTone(520, 0.08, 'triangle', 0.07, { target: 660 }, 0, 'load', -0.08, 'ui', 0.08);
        this.playTone(784, 0.14, 'sine', 0.065, null, 0.06, 'load', 0.08, 'ui', 0.12);
    },

    speedChange(speed) {
        if (!this.canPlay('speed', 55)) return;
        const f = 540 + Math.max(1, speed) * 120;
        this.playTone(f, 0.055, 'triangle', 0.055, { target: f * 1.08 }, 0, 'speed', 0, 'ui', 0.02);
    },

    pauseState(paused) {
        if (!this.canPlay('pause-state', 50)) return;
        this.playTone(paused ? 250 : 520, 0.10, 'triangle', 0.065, { target: paused ? 180 : 700 }, 0, 'pause-state', 0, 'ui', 0.05);
    },

    startAmbience() {
        this.init();
        if (!this.ctx || this.muted || !this.ambientEnabled() || this.ambientStarted || !this.noiseBuffer) return;
        if (this.activeVoices > this.maxVoices - 3) return;
        this.ambientStarted = true;
        const now = this.ctx.currentTime;

        const wind = this.ctx.createBufferSource();
        wind.buffer = this.noiseBuffer;
        wind.loop = true;
        wind.playbackRate.value = 0.61;
        const windFilter = this.ctx.createBiquadFilter();
        windFilter.type = 'lowpass';
        windFilter.frequency.value = 680;
        const windGain = this.ctx.createGain();
        windGain.gain.value = 0.020;
        wind.connect(windFilter);
        windFilter.connect(windGain);
        windGain.connect(this.buses.ambience);
        this.attachSourceLifecycle(wind, 'ambience');
        wind.start(now);

        const rumble = this.ctx.createOscillator();
        rumble.type = 'sine';
        rumble.frequency.value = 43;
        const rumbleGain = this.ctx.createGain();
        rumbleGain.gain.value = 0.014;
        rumble.connect(rumbleGain);
        rumbleGain.connect(this.buses.ambience);
        this.attachSourceLifecycle(rumble, 'ambience');
        rumble.start(now);

        const radio = this.ctx.createBufferSource();
        radio.buffer = this.noiseBuffer;
        radio.loop = true;
        radio.playbackRate.value = 1.57;
        const radioFilter = this.ctx.createBiquadFilter();
        radioFilter.type = 'bandpass';
        radioFilter.frequency.value = 1850;
        radioFilter.Q.value = 1.8;
        const radioGain = this.ctx.createGain();
        radioGain.gain.value = 0.0045;
        radio.connect(radioFilter);
        radioFilter.connect(radioGain);
        radioGain.connect(this.buses.ambience);
        this.attachSourceLifecycle(radio, 'ambience');
        radio.start(now);
    },

    stopAmbience() {
        this.stopGroup('ambience');
        this.ambientStarted = false;
    },

    updateWorldAudio() {
        if (!this.initialized || this.muted || !this.ctx || !gameReady || gameSpeed <= 0 || !this.ambientEnabled()) return;
        const now = performance.now();
        if (now < this.nextWorldAccentAt) return;
        const wars = typeof warPairs !== 'undefined' ? warPairs.size : 0;
        if (!wars) {
            this.nextWorldAccentAt = now + 5200 + Math.random() * 4200;
            return;
        }
        this.nextWorldAccentAt = now + Math.max(950, 3600 - Math.min(18, wars) * 115) + Math.random() * 2400;

        let pid = -1;
        if (typeof _contestedProvIds !== 'undefined' && _contestedProvIds && _contestedProvIds.size) {
            let pick = Math.floor(Math.random() * _contestedProvIds.size);
            for (const id of _contestedProvIds) { if (pick-- <= 0) { pid = id; break; } }
        }
        if (pid < 0 && playerCivId >= 0 && typeof _warEnemiesFor === 'function') {
            const enemies = _warEnemiesFor(playerCivId);
            for (const enemyId of enemies) {
                const enemy = civs[enemyId];
                if (!enemy) continue;
                for (const ep of enemy.ownedProvs) { pid = ep; break; }
                if (pid >= 0) break;
            }
        }
        const p = pid >= 0 ? provinces[pid] : null;
        if (!p) return;
        const s = this.spatialForGrid(p.centerTx, p.centerTy);
        if (!s.visible) return;
        this.playNoise(0.22, 0.018 * s.gain, p.isSea ? 520 : 360, 'lowpass', 0, 'world-accent', s.pan, 'ambience', 0.24, 0.008, 0.72);
        this.playTone(p.isSea ? 58 : 74 + Math.random() * 16, 0.24, 'sawtooth', 0.014 * s.gain, { target: p.isSea ? 36 : 42 }, 0, 'world-accent', s.pan, 'ambience', 0.22, 0.006);
    },

    startMusic() {
        this.init();
        if (!this.ctx || this.muted || !this.musicEnabled() || this.musicStarted) return;
        this.musicStarted = true;
        this.musicStep = 0;
        this._scheduleMusicPhrase(40);
    },

    stopMusic() {
        this.musicStarted = false;
        if (this.musicTimer) { clearTimeout(this.musicTimer); this.musicTimer = 0; }
        this.stopGroup('music');
    },

    _scheduleMusicPhrase(delayMs = 0) {
        if (this.musicTimer) clearTimeout(this.musicTimer);
        this.musicTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            this.musicTimer = 0;
            if (!this.musicStarted || !this.musicEnabled() || !gameReady) return;
            const war = typeof warPairs !== 'undefined' && warPairs.size > 0;
            const roots = war ? [55, 58.27, 65.41, 49] : [65.41, 73.42, 58.27, 77.78];
            const root = roots[this.musicStep++ % roots.length];
            const dur = war ? 4.8 : 6.2;
            this.playTone(root, dur, 'sine', war ? 0.027 : 0.022, {target:root*0.997}, 0, 'music', -0.12, 'music', 0.52, 0.55);
            this.playTone(root * 1.5, dur * 0.92, 'triangle', war ? 0.014 : 0.012, null, 0.18, 'music', 0.10, 'music', 0.58, 0.65);
            this.playTone(root * 2, dur * 0.78, 'sine', 0.0085, null, 0.34, 'music', 0.22, 'music', 0.66, 0.80);
            if (war) this.playNoise(0.36, 0.010, 420, 'lowpass', 0.22, 'music', 0, 'music', 0.25, 0.08, 0.62);
            this._scheduleMusicPhrase((war ? 4300 : 6200) + Math.random() * 2200);
        }, Math.max(0, delayMs));
    },

    _loadMarchRecordings() {
        if (this.marchLoadStarted || !this.ctx) return;
        this.marchLoadStarted = true;
        for (let i=0;i<this.marchUrls.length;i++) fetch(this.marchUrls[i],{mode:'cors',cache:'force-cache'})
          .then(r=>{if(!r.ok)throw new Error('HTTP '+r.status);return r.arrayBuffer();})
          .then(ab=>this.ctx.decodeAudioData(ab)).then(buf=>{this.marchBuffers[i]=buf;if(!this.marchReady.includes(i)){this.marchReady.push(i);this.marchReady.sort((a,b)=>a-b);}}).catch(()=>{});
    },
    armyMarch(x,y) {
        // One spatial formation cue at most every 145 ms globally: thousands of units
        // therefore cost only a handful of audio voices, never one voice per division.
        if(!this.ctx||this.muted||!this.sfxEnabled()||!this.canPlay('army-march',145)||this.activeVoices>=this.maxVoices-2)return;
        const ready=this.marchReady;if(!ready.length)return;const sp=this.spatialForGrid(x,y);if(!sp.visible)return;
        const layers=ready.length>2?2:1, base=this.marchVariant++;
        for(let k=0;k<layers;k++){
          const pick=ready[(base+k*2+((Math.random()*ready.length)|0))%ready.length],buf=this.marchBuffers[pick];if(!buf)continue;
          const src=this.ctx.createBufferSource(),g=this.ctx.createGain();src.buffer=buf;
          src.playbackRate.value=(k?0.91:0.97)+Math.random()*.12;
          g.gain.value=(k?0.022:0.036)*sp.gain;
          let tail=g;if(this.ctx.createStereoPanner){const pan=this.ctx.createStereoPanner();pan.pan.value=Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,sp.pan+(k?0.08:-0.06)));g.connect(pan);tail=pan;}
          tail.connect(this.buses.world||this.masterGain);src.connect(g);src.start(0,Math.random()*Math.max(0,.01));
          this.activeVoices++;src.onended=()=>{try{src.disconnect();g.disconnect();if(tail!==g)tail.disconnect();}catch(_){}this.activeVoices=Math.max(0,this.activeVoices-1);};
        }
    },

    _loadFirearmRecordings() {
        if (this.firearmLoadStarted || !this.ctx) return;
        this.firearmLoadStarted = true;
        for (let i=0;i<this.firearmUrls.length;i++) fetch(this.firearmUrls[i],{mode:'cors',cache:'force-cache'})
          .then(r=>{if(!r.ok)throw new Error('HTTP '+r.status);return r.arrayBuffer();})
          .then(ab=>this.ctx.decodeAudioData(ab)).then(buf=>{this.firearmBuffers[i]=buf;if(!this.firearmReady.includes(i)){this.firearmReady.push(i);this.firearmReady.sort((a,b)=>a-b);}}).catch(()=>{});
    },
    _realGunshot(x,y,intensity=1,sp=null) {
        if(!this.ctx||this.muted||!this.sfxEnabled()||this.activeVoices>=this.maxVoices)return false;
        const ready=this.firearmReady;if(!ready.length)return false;
        sp=sp||this.spatialForGrid(x,y);if(!sp.visible)return false;
        const pick=ready[(this.firearmVariant+++((Math.random()*ready.length)|0))%ready.length];
        const src=this.ctx.createBufferSource(),g=this.ctx.createGain();src.buffer=this.firearmBuffers[pick];src.playbackRate.value=.94+Math.random()*.12;g.gain.value=Math.min(.22,.072*intensity)*sp.gain;
        let tail=g;if(this.ctx.createStereoPanner){const pan=this.ctx.createStereoPanner();pan.pan.value=sp.pan;g.connect(pan);tail=pan;}tail.connect(this.buses.combat||this.masterGain);src.connect(g);src.start();this.activeVoices++;
        src.onended=()=>{try{src.disconnect();g.disconnect();if(tail!==g)tail.disconnect();}catch(_){}this.activeVoices=Math.max(0,this.activeVoices-1);};return true;
    },

    battle(x, y, sea = false) {
        if (!this.canPlay(sea ? 'battle-sea' : 'battle-land', sea ? 105 : 82)) return;
        const s = this.spatialForGrid(x, y); if (!s.visible) return;
        if (sea) { this.navalCombat(x, y); return; }
        const realShot=this._realGunshot(x,y,.85+Math.random()*.35,s);
        this.playNoise(realShot?.055:.085, (realShot?.018:.048) * s.gain, 1450 + Math.random()*550, 'bandpass', 0, 'battle-land', s.pan, 'combat', 0.10, 0.001, 0.90 + Math.random()*0.28);
        this.playTone(92 + Math.random()*48, realShot?.07:.11, 'sawtooth', (realShot?.014:.050) * s.gain, {target:58 + Math.random()*18}, 0, 'battle-land', s.pan, 'combat', 0.16, 0.001);
        if (Math.random() < 0.34) this.playNoise(0.035, 0.032 * s.gain, 4800, 'highpass', 0.015, 'battle-land', s.pan, 'combat', 0.05, 0.001, 1.4);
    },

    recruit(count = 1) {
        if (!this.canPlay('recruit', 120)) return;
        const weight = Math.min(1, 0.55 + Math.log2(Math.max(1, count)) * 0.09);
        this.playNoise(0.09, 0.075*weight, 1700, 'bandpass', 0, 'recruit', -0.12, 'ui', 0.08, 0.001, 0.95);
        this.playTone(220, 0.12, 'triangle', 0.075*weight, {target:330}, 0.03, 'recruit', 0.02, 'ui', 0.12);
        this.playTone(440, 0.13, 'triangle', 0.060*weight, {target:660}, 0.10, 'recruit', 0.12, 'ui', 0.14);
    },

    moveOrder(x, y, count = 1) {
        if (!this.canPlay('move-order', 55)) return;
        const s = this.spatialForGrid(x, y); if (!s.visible) return;
        const v = Math.min(0.075, 0.035 + Math.log2(Math.max(1,count))*0.005) * s.gain;
        this.playTone(510, 0.045, 'square', v, {target:720}, 0, 'move-order', s.pan, 'ui', 0.03);
        this.playNoise(0.030, v*0.55, 3200, 'bandpass', 0.012, 'move-order', s.pan, 'ui', 0.01, 0.001, 1.35);
    },

    autoMove(enabled) {
        if (!this.canPlay('auto-move', 90)) return;
        this.playTone(enabled ? 420 : 300, 0.09, 'triangle', 0.070, {target:enabled?720:190}, 0, 'auto-move', -0.05, 'ui', 0.05);
        this.playTone(enabled ? 760 : 180, 0.10, 'sine', 0.050, null, 0.065, 'auto-move', 0.07, 'ui', 0.07);
    },

    tech(kind = 'econ') {
        if (!this.canPlay('tech', 130)) return;
        const base = kind === 'mil' ? 392 : 523.25;
        [1,1.25,1.5,2].forEach((m,i)=>this.playTone(base*m,0.22+i*0.04,'sine',0.050,null,i*0.055,'tech',(i-1.5)*0.08,'ui',0.20,0.008));
        this.playNoise(0.12,0.022,5200,'highpass',0.08,'tech',0,'ui',0.12,0.01,1.3);
    },

    capitulation(win = true) {
        if (!this.canPlay('capitulation', 350)) return;
        if (win) this.victory();
        else {
            this.playTone(130, 0.78, 'sawtooth', 0.16, {target:55}, 0, 'capitulation', 0, 'combat', 0.42, 0.02);
            this.playNoise(0.62, 0.11, 340, 'lowpass', 0.04, 'capitulation', 0, 'combat', 0.34, 0.008, 0.66);
            this.playTone(196, 0.72, 'triangle', 0.09, {target:98}, 0.12, 'capitulation', 0.1, 'world', 0.48, 0.03);
        }
    },

    unitLoss(x, y, playerUnit = false) {
        if (!this.canPlay(playerUnit ? 'unit-loss-player' : 'unit-loss', playerUnit ? 150 : 240)) return;
        const s=this.spatialForGrid(x,y); if(!s.visible)return;
        this.playNoise(0.11,(playerUnit?0.065:0.032)*s.gain,620,'lowpass',0,'unit-loss',s.pan,'combat',0.14,0.001,0.72);
        this.playTone(playerUnit?86:104,0.14,'triangle',(playerUnit?0.060:0.028)*s.gain,{target:48},0,'unit-loss',s.pan,'combat',0.18,0.002);
    },

    divisionTransition(oldPid, newPid, civId) {
        if (oldPid < 0 || newPid < 0) return;
        const a = provinces[oldPid], b = provinces[newPid];
        if (!a || !b) return;
        // Ordinary land movement is boots only. No impact/capture/thump synthesis.
        if (!a.isSea && !b.isSea) { this.armyMarch(b.centerTx,b.centerTy); return; }
        // Preserve the distinct embark/disembark cues for the player's naval transitions.
        if (civId !== playerCivId) return;
        if (!a.isSea && b.isSea) this.navalLaunch(b.centerTx, b.centerTy);
        else if (a.isSea && !b.isSea) this.beachhead(b.centerTx, b.centerTy);
    },

    peaceAction() {
        if (!this.canPlay('peace-action', 80)) return;
        this.playTone(440,0.07,'sine',0.060,{target:660},0,'peace-action',-0.05,'ui',0.08);
        this.playTone(880,0.12,'triangle',0.050,null,0.055,'peace-action',0.08,'ui',0.12);
    }

};


function tileAt(tx,ty){
  if(tx<0||ty<0||tx>=WORLD_W||ty>=WORLD_H||!tileKindBuf)return null;
  const i=ty*WORLD_W+tx;
  const pid=tileProvMap?tileProvMap[i]:-1,cid=(pid>=0&&!provinces[pid]?.isSea)?(provinces[pid]?.countryId??-1):-1;return {type:tileKindBuf[i]===1?'land':'water',cid,v:(tx*7+ty*13)%6};
}
function tcx(tx){return tx*TS+TS/2}
function tcy(ty){return ty*TS+TS/2}
function screenToTile(sx,sy){return{tx:Math.floor(sx/(zoom*TS)+camX),ty:Math.floor(sy/(zoom*TS)+camY)}}
function clampCam(){const mx=WORLD_W-canvas.width/(zoom*TS),my=WORLD_H-canvas.height/(zoom*TS);camX=Math.max(0,Math.min(Math.max(0,mx),camX));camY=Math.max(0,Math.min(Math.max(0,my),camY))}
function tileProvAt(tx,ty){if(tx<0||ty<0||tx>=WORLD_W||ty>=WORLD_H)return -1;return tileProvMap[ty*WORLD_W+tx]}

// ── COLOUR BUFFERS ────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Base terrain colour is derivable from immutable geography, so do not keep a second
// WORLD_W×WORLD_H RGBA buffer alive for the entire session. tileColorBuf remains as a
// compatibility name but is deliberately released after startup.
let tileColorBuf=null;
let ownedColorBuf=null;    // Uint32Array[WORLD_W*WORLD_H] current displayed colour per tile
const SEA_ABGR=(0xFF000000|(0x50<<16)|(0x38<<8)|0x14)>>>0;
const SEA_ABGR2=(0xFF000000|(0x48<<16)|(0x30<<8)|0x10)>>>0;
const SEA_ABGR3=(0xFF000000|(0x52<<16)|(0x3a<<8)|0x18)>>>0;
// Navigable sea zone — slightly lighter/bluer to distinguish from deep water
const SEA_PROV_ABGR =(0xFF000000|(0x72<<16)|(0x52<<8)|0x20)>>>0;
const SEA_PROV_ABGR2=(0xFF000000|(0x6a<<16)|(0x4c<<8)|0x1e)>>>0;

// Fast ABGR alpha-blend: t=0→all a, t=1→all b  (t passed as 0..1 float)
function blendAbgr(a,b,t){
  const ti=Math.round(t*256)|0, ti2=256-ti;
  return (0xFF000000|
    ((((a>>16&0xff)*ti2+(b>>16&0xff)*ti)>>8)<<16)|
    ((((a>> 8&0xff)*ti2+(b>> 8&0xff)*ti)>>8)<< 8)|
    ( ((a    &0xff)*ti2+(b    &0xff)*ti)>>8))>>>0;
}

function _fillBaseWorldColors(dst){
  if(!dst)return;
  const seaCols=[SEA_ABGR,SEA_ABGR2,SEA_ABGR3];
  const seaRows=Array.from({length:3},(_,phase)=>{const row=new Uint32Array(WORLD_W);for(let x=0;x<WORLD_W;x++)row[x]=seaCols[(x+phase)%3];return row;});
  for(let y=0;y<WORLD_H;y++)dst.set(seaRows[y%3],y*WORLD_W);
  const countryAbgr=countries.map(c=>hexToAbgr(c.color));
  // Province source-country IDs are immutable, so the raster-time country-per-pixel
  // buffer is not needed after adjacency generation.
  for(const p of provinces){
    if(!p?.tiles?.length)continue;
    if(p.isSea){for(const ti of p.tiles){const x=ti%WORLD_W,y=(ti/WORLD_W)|0;dst[ti]=((x+y)&1)===0?SEA_PROV_ABGR:SEA_PROV_ABGR2;}}
    else {const col=countryAbgr[p.countryId]??0xff5a7a6a;for(const ti of p.tiles)dst[ti]=col;}
  }
}
function buildColorBufs(){
  const N=WORLD_W*WORLD_H;
  ownedColorBuf=new Uint32Array(N);
  tileCivBuf=new Int16Array(N);tileCivBuf.fill(-1);
  _fillBaseWorldColors(ownedColorBuf);
  tileColorBuf=null;
}

// Bake owned-tile colour: pure civ territory colour, no terrain influence
function bakeProvOwnedColor(pid,civId){
  const p=provinces[pid];if(!p)return;
  const civAbgr=civs[civId].terrAbgr,u=_worldTexU32;
  for(let j=0;j<p.tiles.length;j++){
    const ti=p.tiles[j];ownedColorBuf[ti]=civAbgr;tileCivBuf[ti]=civId;
    if(u)u[ti]=civAbgr;
  }
  _markWorldProvinceDirty(p);
  _hlDirty=true;
}
// Restore a province's tiles to unowned appearance
function restoreProvUnownedColor(pid){
  const p=provinces[pid];if(!p)return;
  const u=_worldTexU32;
  // Land provinces originate inside one immutable atlas country; sea zones retain their
  // exact alternating colour. Reconstructing this rare unowned transition avoids a full
  // permanent base RGBA buffer.
  let landCol=0;
  if(!p.isSea&&p.tiles.length){const cid=p.countryId;landCol=countries[cid]?hexToAbgr(countries[cid].color):hexToAbgr('#6a7a5a');}
  for(let j=0;j<p.tiles.length;j++){
    const ti=p.tiles[j],x=ti%WORLD_W,y=(ti/WORLD_W)|0;
    const col=p.isSea?(((x+y)&1)===0?SEA_PROV_ABGR:SEA_PROV_ABGR2):landCol;
    ownedColorBuf[ti]=col;tileCivBuf[ti]=-1;if(u)u[ti]=col;
  }
  _markWorldProvinceDirty(p);_hlDirty=true;
}

// v0.4 keeps the old Europe/Russia/MENA footprint as the legacy ordering
// prefix, then appends every remaining world-atlas country.  The ordering
// matters because old save/TNO data used deterministic country IDs.
const REGION_LON0=-28,REGION_LON1=90,REGION_LAT0=14,REGION_LAT1=72;
const PROJ_BBOX={type:'Feature',geometry:{type:'Polygon',coordinates:[[
  [REGION_LON0,REGION_LAT0],[REGION_LON1,REGION_LAT0],
  [REGION_LON1,REGION_LAT1],[REGION_LON0,REGION_LAT1],
  [REGION_LON0,REGION_LAT0]
]]}}; // retained for legacy/TNO metadata compatibility
const EXCLUDE_LEGACY=new Set(['China','Japan','South Korea','North Korea','Dem. Rep. Korea','Korea',
  'Mongolia','India','Myanmar','Bangladesh','Nepal','Bhutan','Sri Lanka','Pakistan',
  'Vietnam','Laos','Thailand','Cambodia','Malaysia','Singapore','Indonesia',
  'Philippines','Brunei','Papua New Guinea','Timor-Leste','Taiwan']);

function inLegacyRegion(feat){
  const name=feat.properties.name||'';
  if(EXCLUDE_LEGACY.has(name)) return false;
  if(name==='Russia') return true;
  const [cx,cy]=d3.geoCentroid(feat);
  return cx>=REGION_LON0&&cx<=REGION_LON1&&cy>=REGION_LAT0&&cy<=REGION_LAT1;
}
function inRegion(){ return true; } // full-world v0.4

function _cityLatinBase(name){return String(name||'').normalize('NFKD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').replace(/[’‘`]/g,"'");}
function _phoneticCityName(name,lang){
  let x=_cityLatinBase(name);
  // Compact deterministic Latin romanization for rows whose primary scripts are non-Latin.
  // Established exonyms above always win; these rules are intentionally conservative.
  if(lang==='ru')return x.replace(/th/gi,'t').replace(/ph/gi,'f').replace(/w/gi,'v').replace(/j/gi,'zh').replace(/y/gi,'i');
  if(lang==='ar'||lang==='fa')return x.replace(/p/gi,'b').replace(/v/gi,'f').replace(/g(?=[eiy])/gi,'j').replace(/c(?=[eiy])/gi,'s');
  if(lang==='ja')return x.replace(/l/gi,'r').replace(/ti/gi,'chi').replace(/tu/gi,'tsu').replace(/di/gi,'ji').replace(/v/gi,'b');
  if(lang==='ko')return x.replace(/f/gi,'p').replace(/v/gi,'b').replace(/z/gi,'j');
  if(lang==='hi')return x.replace(/ph/gi,'f').replace(/w/gi,'v');
  if(lang==='mn')return x.replace(/w/gi,'v');
  return x;
}
function _extraCityLanguageName(name,lang){
  const o=CITY_EXTRA_EXONYMS[lang];if(o&&o[name])return o[name];
  return _phoneticCityName(name,lang);
}
const CITY_LANGUAGE_ROWS=(()=>{
  const built={};
  for(const lang of CITY_ACTIVE_LANGUAGE_CODES){
    const base=CITY_LANGUAGE_ROWS_BASE[lang]||[];
    built[lang]=Object.freeze(CITY_CANONICAL_CITY_NAMES.map(name=>{const i=_CITY_LANGUAGE_BASE_INDEX.get(name);return i===undefined?_extraCityLanguageName(name,lang):base[i];}));
  }
  const future={};
  for(const lang of CITY_FUTURE_LANGUAGE_CODES){
    const base=CITY_LANGUAGE_ROWS_BASE._?.[lang]||[];
    future[lang]=Object.freeze(CITY_CANONICAL_CITY_NAMES.map(name=>{const i=_CITY_LANGUAGE_BASE_INDEX.get(name);return i===undefined?_extraCityLanguageName(name,lang):base[i];}));
  }
  built._=Object.freeze(future);return Object.freeze(built);
})();

const _CITY_LANGUAGE_NAME_INDEX=new Map(CITY_CANONICAL_CITY_NAMES.map((name,index)=>[name,index]));
function _cityLanguageRow(lang){return CITY_LANGUAGE_ROWS[lang]||CITY_LANGUAGE_ROWS._?.[lang]||null;}

let _cityOriginalOwnerIds = null; // captured at scenario/editor start; serialized in saves
let _destroyedCitySourceIds = new Set(); // legacy compatibility only; city geography is permanent and this set must remain empty
let _citiesByPid = null;
let _capitalCityByCiv = new Int32Array(0), _capitalPidByCiv = new Int32Array(0), _capitalDirty = true;
let _originalMapOwnerIds = null; // province owner at scenario/editor start; used by peace liberation + serialized in saves

function _captureOriginalMapOwners(force=false){
  if(!provOwner||!provinces?.length) return;
  if(!force&&_originalMapOwnerIds&&_originalMapOwnerIds.length===provOwner.length) return;
  _originalMapOwnerIds=Int16Array.from(provOwner);
}
function _deriveOriginalMapOwnersFromScenario(){
  if(!provinces?.length) return null;
  // Native TNO 1962 must be reconstructed from the SAME geographic resolver as a fresh
  // game. Never consult the obsolete regional snapshot owners for this scenario: those IDs
  // belong to the removed legacy TNO mesh and can corrupt old-save peace/liberation borders.
  if(activeScenario==='tno1962'&&typeof _tnoNative1962Owner==='function'){
    const byName=new Map();for(const c of civs.filter(Boolean)){byName.set(c.name,c.id);if(c.tnoCanonicalName)byName.set(c.tnoCanonicalName,c.id);}
    if(typeof TNO_NATIVE_1962_DEFS!=='undefined'&&typeof _tnoSimplifyName==='function')for(const [canonical] of TNO_NATIVE_1962_DEFS){const short=_tnoSimplifyName(canonical),c=civs.find(x=>x&&x.name===short);if(c)byName.set(canonical,c.id);}
    const out=new Int16Array(provinces.length);out.fill(-1);
    const counts=new Int32Array(civs.length);
    for(let pid=0;pid<provinces.length;pid++){
      const p=provinces[pid];if(!p||p.isSea)continue;
      const base=countries[p.countryId]?.name||'',ll=proj?.invert?.([p.centerTx,p.centerTy])||[0,0];
      const id=byName.get(_tnoNative1962Owner(base,ll[0],ll[1]));
      if(Number.isInteger(id)&&id>=0){out[pid]=id;if(id<counts.length)counts[id]++;}
    }
    const seeds={...TNO_NATIVE_1962_SEEDS,...TNO_NATIVE_1962_RUSSIA_SEEDS,'Allied Administration of Guiana-Cayenne':[-52.3,4.0],'Republic of Cameroon':[10.5,4.5],'Union of Kamerun':[13.5,5.0],'Mosul and Kerkuk':[43.1,36.3]};
    for(const [name,pt] of Object.entries(seeds)){
      const id=byName.get(name);if(!Number.isInteger(id)||id<0||counts[id]>0)continue;
      let best=-1,bd=Infinity;
      for(let pid=0;pid<provinces.length;pid++){const p=provinces[pid],owner=out[pid];if(!p||p.isSea||owner<0||counts[owner]<=1)continue;const ll=proj?.invert?.([p.centerTx,p.centerTy]);if(!ll)continue;const dx=(ll[0]-pt[0])*Math.cos((ll[1]+pt[1])*Math.PI/360),dy=ll[1]-pt[1],d=dx*dx+dy*dy;if(d<bd){bd=d;best=pid;}}
      if(best>=0){const old=out[best];counts[old]--;out[best]=id;counts[id]++;}
    }
    return out;
  }
  // Hidden legacy TNO snapshots retain their authoritative legacy owner arrays.
  if(typeof _isTnoScenario==='function'&&_isTnoScenario(activeScenario)){
    const owners=TNO_SCENARIO_DATA?.[activeScenario]?.owners;
    if(Array.isArray(owners)&&owners.length===provinces.length) return Int16Array.from(owners.map(v=>Number.isInteger(v)?v:-1));
  }
  // Rebuild WW1 from the same deterministic province-by-province resolver used by the fresh scenario.
  if(activeScenario==='ww1_1914'&&typeof _ww1ResolveOwner==='function'){
    const baseByName={};
    for(const c of civs){
      const modern=(c&&c.countryId>=0&&countries[c.countryId])?countries[c.countryId].name:'';
      if(modern) baseByName[modern]=c.id;
    }
    const findNamed=name=>{const c=civs.find(x=>x&&x.name===name);return c?c.id:-1;};
    const khiva=findNamed('Khanate of Khiva'),jabal=findNamed('Emirate of Jabal Shammar'),idrisid=findNamed('Idrisid Emirate of Asir');
    const customIds={khiva:'@'+khiva,jabal:'@'+jabal,idrisid:'@'+idrisid};
    const out=new Int16Array(provinces.length).fill(-1);
    for(let pid=0;pid<provinces.length;pid++){
      const p=provinces[pid];if(!p||p.isSea)continue;
      const source=countries[p.countryId]?.name||'';const [lon,lat]=_ww1Geo(p);
      const target=_ww1ResolveOwner(source,p,lon,lat,customIds);
      let id=-1;
      if(typeof target==='string'&&target.startsWith('@')) id=+target.slice(1);
      else id=baseByName[target];
      if(!Number.isInteger(id)||id<0||!civs[id]) id=baseByName[source];
      out[pid]=Number.isInteger(id)&&id>=0?id:-1;
    }
    return out;
  }
  // Modern/fallback: reconstruct the untouched map by each province's fixed countryId.
  const byCountryId=new Map();
  for(const c of civs) if(c&&c.countryId>=0&&!byCountryId.has(c.countryId)) byCountryId.set(c.countryId,c.id);
  const out=new Int16Array(provinces.length).fill(-1);
  for(let pid=0;pid<provinces.length;pid++){
    const p=provinces[pid];if(!p||p.isSea)continue;
    const id=byCountryId.get(p.countryId);if(Number.isInteger(id))out[pid]=id;
  }
  return out;
}
function _restoreOriginalMapOwners(saved){
  if(Array.isArray(saved)&&saved.length===provinces.length){
    _originalMapOwnerIds=Int16Array.from(saved.map(v=>Number.isInteger(v)?v:-1));
    return;
  }
  // Backward compatibility for old saves: rebuild known built-in scenario starts
  // instead of treating the save's current occupations as the "original map".
  _originalMapOwnerIds=_deriveOriginalMapOwnersFromScenario();
}

function _cityBaseCountryName(civId){
  const civ=civs[civId];
  if(!civ) return '';
  if(civ.countryId>=0 && countries[civ.countryId]) return countries[civ.countryId].name || civ.name || '';
  return civ.name || '';
}
const _CITY_CONTROLLER_LANG_CACHE=new Map();
function _cityLanguageForController(civId){
  const base=_cityBaseCountryName(civId);let cached=_CITY_CONTROLLER_LANG_CACHE.get(base);if(cached!==undefined)return cached;
  const direct=CITY_CONTROLLER_LANGUAGE[base];if(direct){_CITY_CONTROLLER_LANG_CACHE.set(base,direct);return direct;}
  // Custom/historical nations do not have a Natural-Earth countryId. Resolve their
  // governing language by state identity so TNO occupation labels do not silently
  // fall back to English.
  if(/Reich|German|Ostland|Ukraine|Moskowien|Kaukasien|Gotenland|Norwegian State|Kingdom of Denmark/i.test(base)){_CITY_CONTROLLER_LANG_CACHE.set(base,'de');return 'de';}
  if(/Russia|Russian|Siber|Omsk|Komi|Vologda|Vyatka|Yugra|Zlatoust|Perm|Tatar|Bashkort|Ural|Magnitogorsk|Orenburg|Tyumen|Irkutsk|Buryat|Transbaikal|Magadan|Amur|Sakha|Vorkuta|Kemerovo|Krasnoyarsk|Novosibirsk|Oyrotia|Free Aviators|Pacific Fleet|Samara|Sverdlovsk|Tomsk|Chita/i.test(base)){_CITY_CONTROLLER_LANG_CACHE.set(base,'ru');return 'ru';}
  if(/French|France|Monaco/i.test(base)){_CITY_CONTROLLER_LANG_CACHE.set(base,'fr');return 'fr';}
  if(/Iberian|Andorra/i.test(base)){_CITY_CONTROLLER_LANG_CACHE.set(base,'es');return 'es';}
  // hi/vi/id/ptBR/mn/ko/fa/esMX are deliberately stored only under CITY_LANGUAGE_ROWS._.
  // They are not connected to current controllers until the future map is added.
  if(/Japan|Manchuria/i.test(base)){_CITY_CONTROLLER_LANG_CACHE.set(base,'ja');return 'ja';}
  if(/China|Guangdong|NRA|Xinjiang|Tibet/i.test(base)){_CITY_CONTROLLER_LANG_CACHE.set(base,'zh');return 'zh';}
  if(/Arab|Saudi|Iraq|Mosul|Yemen|Oman|Trucial|Palestine|Syria|Egypt|Algeria|Morocco|Tunisia|Sudan/i.test(base)){_CITY_CONTROLLER_LANG_CACHE.set(base,'ar');return 'ar';}
  _CITY_CONTROLLER_LANG_CACHE.set(base,'en');return 'en';
}
function _findCityProvince(tx,ty){
  const x=Math.max(0,Math.min(WORLD_W-1,Math.round(tx)));
  const y=Math.max(0,Math.min(WORLD_H-1,Math.round(ty)));
  let pid=tileProvAt(x,y);
  if(pid>=0 && provinces[pid] && !provinces[pid].isSea) return pid;
  // Coastline/point-rounding fallback: nearest land province within four tiles.
  for(let r=1;r<=4;r++){
    let best=-1,bestD=Infinity;
    for(let oy=-r;oy<=r;oy++) for(let ox=-r;ox<=r;ox++){
      if(Math.max(Math.abs(ox),Math.abs(oy))!==r) continue;
      const nx=x+ox,ny=y+oy;if(nx<0||ny<0||nx>=WORLD_W||ny>=WORLD_H) continue;
      const q=tileProvAt(nx,ny);if(q<0||!provinces[q]||provinces[q].isSea) continue;
      const d=ox*ox+oy*oy;if(d<bestD){bestD=d;best=q;}
    }
    if(best>=0) return best;
  }
  return -1;
}
function _fallbackOriginalCityOwner(c){
  if(!c || c.pid<0) return -1;
  const countryId=provinces[c.pid]?.countryId;
  if(countryId==null||countryId<0) return provOwner[c.pid]??-1;
  const base=civs.find(x=>x && !x.customNation && x.countryId===countryId);
  return base ? base.id : (provOwner[c.pid]??-1);
}
function _captureCityOriginalOwners(force=false){
  if(!_cityPx) return;
  if(!force && _cityOriginalOwnerIds && _cityOriginalOwnerIds.length===_cityPx.length) return;
  _cityOriginalOwnerIds=Int16Array.from(_cityPx.map(c=>c.pid>=0?(provOwner[c.pid]??-1):-1));_markCapitalsDirty();
}
function _restoreCityOriginalOwners(saved){
  if(_cityPx && Array.isArray(saved) && saved.length===_cityPx.length){
    _cityOriginalOwnerIds=Int16Array.from(saved.map(v=>Number.isInteger(v)?v:-1));_markCapitalsDirty();
    return;
  }
  // Backward-compatible old saves: use fixed province cores rather than current
  // occupation where possible, so a loaded occupation does not redefine "original".
  if(_cityPx){_cityOriginalOwnerIds=Int16Array.from(_cityPx.map(_fallbackOriginalCityOwner));_markCapitalsDirty();}
}

// Relative urban-size hints are used only when a state has lost/never had its mapped
// capital. The city dataset has no population field, so major metros get explicit
// relative weights and all other cities fall back to their host province footprint.
const CITY_SIZE_HINT=Object.freeze({
  'Tokyo':100,'Delhi':98,'Shanghai':97,'Mumbai':94,'Beijing':92,'Dhaka':90,'Cairo':88,'Mexico City':87,'São Paulo':86,'Istanbul':84,
  'Karachi':83,'Lagos':82,'Moscow':80,'Manila':79,'Jakarta':78,'Seoul':77,'Guangzhou':76,'London':75,'Paris':73,'Tehran':72,
  'Bengaluru':70,'Chennai':68,'Hyderabad':67,'Lahore':66,'Kinshasa':65,'Bogotá':64,'Ho Chi Minh City':63,'Bangkok':62,'Lima':61,'New York':60,
  'Los Angeles':58,'Rio de Janeiro':57,'Osaka':56,'Chongqing':55,'Wuhan':54,'Tianjin':53,'Baghdad':52,'Riyadh':51,'Alexandria':50,'Barcelona':49,
  'Madrid':48,'Rome':47,'Milan':46,'Berlin':45,'Sydney':44,'Melbourne':43,'Toronto':42,'Montreal':41,'Johannesburg':40,'Cape Town':39
});
function _markCapitalsDirty(){
  _capitalDirty=true;
  if(typeof _labelLayerValid!=='undefined'){_labelLayerValid=false;_labelLayerKey='';}
}
function _citySizeScore(c){
  if(!c)return -Infinity;
  const hinted=CITY_SIZE_HINT[c.name]||0,area=(c.pid>=0?(provinces[c.pid]?.tiles?.length||0):0);
  return hinted*1000000+area;
}
function _rebuildCapitalAssignments(){
  const n=civs.length;
  if(_capitalCityByCiv.length!==n){_capitalCityByCiv=new Int32Array(n);_capitalPidByCiv=new Int32Array(n);}
  _capitalCityByCiv.fill(-1);_capitalPidByCiv.fill(-1);
  const hasOriginal=new Uint8Array(n),best=new Float64Array(n);best.fill(-Infinity);
  if(_cityPx){
    // First preserve a country's own mapped capital if it still owns one and it was not destroyed.
    for(let i=0;i<_cityPx.length;i++){
      const c=_cityPx[i];if(!c||c.pid<0)continue;
      const owner=provOwner[c.pid];if(owner<0||owner>=n)continue;
      const original=_cityOriginalOwnerIds&&i<_cityOriginalOwnerIds.length?_cityOriginalOwnerIds[i]:_fallbackOriginalCityOwner(c);
      if(c.baseCap&&original===owner){
        const score=_citySizeScore(c);if(!hasOriginal[owner]||score>best[owner]){hasOriginal[owner]=1;best[owner]=score;_capitalCityByCiv[owner]=i;_capitalPidByCiv[owner]=c.pid;}
      }
    }
    // Any state without a surviving capital promotes its biggest currently-owned mapped city.
    for(let i=0;i<_cityPx.length;i++){
      const c=_cityPx[i];if(!c||c.pid<0)continue;
      const owner=provOwner[c.pid];if(owner<0||owner>=n||hasOriginal[owner])continue;
      const score=_citySizeScore(c);if(score>best[owner]){best[owner]=score;_capitalCityByCiv[owner]=i;_capitalPidByCiv[owner]=c.pid;}
    }
  }
  // Edge case: a tiny/custom state may own no mapped city at all. Give it an
  // administrative capital in its largest province so camera/AI logic stays defined.
  for(const civ of civs){
    if(!civ||!civ.ownedProvs?.size||_capitalPidByCiv[civ.id]>=0)continue;
    let bestPid=-1,bestArea=-1;for(const pid of civ.ownedProvs){const p=provinces[pid];if(!p||p.isSea)continue;const area=p.tiles?.length||0;if(area>bestArea){bestArea=area;bestPid=pid;}}
    _capitalPidByCiv[civ.id]=bestPid;
  }
  _capitalDirty=false;
}
function _capitalCityIndexForCiv(civId){if(_capitalDirty)_rebuildCapitalAssignments();return civId>=0&&civId<_capitalCityByCiv.length?_capitalCityByCiv[civId]:-1;}
function _capitalProvinceForCiv(civId){if(_capitalDirty)_rebuildCapitalAssignments();return civId>=0&&civId<_capitalPidByCiv.length?_capitalPidByCiv[civId]:-1;}
function _cityIsCapital(index){
  if(_capitalDirty)_rebuildCapitalAssignments();const c=_cityPx?.[index];if(!c||c.pid<0)return false;const owner=provOwner[c.pid];return owner>=0&&owner<_capitalCityByCiv.length&&_capitalCityByCiv[owner]===index;
}
function _destroyCitiesInProvinces(pids){
  // Cities are permanent map geography. Older annihilation builds hid city markers by
  // persisting source IDs here; keep the function as a compatibility no-op so no war,
  // scenario or stale call site can ever erase a city again.
  if(_destroyedCitySourceIds.size)_destroyedCitySourceIds.clear();
  return 0;
}
function _cityDisplayLanguage(c,index){
  if(!c || c.pid<0) return '';
  const owner=provOwner[c.pid];
  const original=_cityOriginalOwnerIds && index<_cityOriginalOwnerIds.length
    ? _cityOriginalOwnerIds[index] : _fallbackOriginalCityOwner(c);
  if(owner<0 || original<0 || owner===original) return '';
  return _cityLanguageForController(owner);
}
function _isLatinOccupationLabel(value){
  return !/[\u0370-\u03ff\u0400-\u052f\u0590-\u08ff\u0900-\u0dff\u2e80-\u9fff\uac00-\ud7af]/u.test(String(value||''));
}
function _resolveCityOccupationName(name,lang){
  const row=_cityLanguageRow(lang);
  const index=_CITY_LANGUAGE_NAME_INDEX.get(String(name||''));
  // Unknown future/editor-added city names are left untouched. Every city shipped in CITIES
  // is required to have an explicit row cell; there is no cross-language/English fallback.
  if(!row||index===undefined)return String(name||'');
  const value=row[index];
  return (typeof value==='string'&&value.trim()&&_isLatinOccupationLabel(value))?value:String(name||'');
}
function _cityTranslationCoverageAudit(){
  const expected=CITY_CANONICAL_CITY_NAMES.length;
  const duplicateCities=CITY_CANONICAL_CITY_NAMES.filter((name,i,a)=>a.indexOf(name)!==i);
  const report={version:CITY_LANGUAGE_DATA_VERSION,expectedCities:expected,mapCities:CITIES.length,duplicateCities:[...new Set(duplicateCities)],languages:{},complete:true};
  if(CITIES.length!==expected||duplicateCities.length)report.complete=false;
  const langs=[...CITY_ACTIVE_LANGUAGE_CODES,...CITY_FUTURE_LANGUAGE_CODES];
  for(const lang of langs){
    const row=_cityLanguageRow(lang),missing=[],nonLatin=[];
    if(!row||row.length!==expected){report.complete=false;report.languages[lang]={expected,actual:row?.length||0,missing:['ROW_LENGTH'],nonLatin:[],identical:0,changed:0};continue;}
    let identical=0,changed=0;
    for(let i=0;i<expected;i++){
      const value=row[i],source=CITY_CANONICAL_CITY_NAMES[i];
      if(typeof value!=='string'||!value.trim())missing.push(source);
      else if(!_isLatinOccupationLabel(value))nonLatin.push(source);
      if(value===source)identical++;else changed++;
    }
    if(missing.length||nonLatin.length)report.complete=false;
    report.languages[lang]={expected,actual:row.length,missing,nonLatin,identical,changed};
  }
  return report;
}
const CITY_LANGUAGE_COVERAGE_AUDIT=_cityTranslationCoverageAudit();
if(!CITY_LANGUAGE_COVERAGE_AUDIT.complete)console.error('City language matrix incomplete',CITY_LANGUAGE_COVERAGE_AUDIT);
function _cityDisplayName(c,index){
  if(!c)return '';
  const owner=c.pid>=0?provOwner[c.pid]:-1,name=c.name||'';
  const original=_cityOriginalOwnerIds&&index>=0&&index<_cityOriginalOwnerIds.length?_cityOriginalOwnerIds[index]:_fallbackOriginalCityOwner(c);
  const lang=(owner<0||original<0||owner===original)?'':_cityLanguageForController(owner);
  if(_cityDisplayOwnerCache&&index>=0&&index<_cityDisplayOwnerCache.length&&_cityDisplayOwnerCache[index]===owner&&_cityDisplayOriginalCache[index]===original&&_cityDisplayBaseCache[index]===name&&_cityDisplayLangCache[index]===lang)return _cityDisplayResolvedCache[index];
  const resolved=lang?_resolveCityOccupationName(name,lang):name;
  if(_cityDisplayOwnerCache&&index>=0&&index<_cityDisplayOwnerCache.length){_cityDisplayOwnerCache[index]=owner;_cityDisplayOriginalCache[index]=original;_cityDisplayBaseCache[index]=name;_cityDisplayLangCache[index]=lang;_cityDisplayResolvedCache[index]=resolved;}
  return resolved;
}


// ── DETERMINISTIC SEEDED RNG (mulberry32) ────────────────────────
// Produces the exact same sequence given the same seed every run.
// Used for Voronoi seeding so province borders are 100% stable.
function makeRng(seed){
  let s=seed>>>0;
  return function(){
    s+=0x6D2B79F5;
    let t=Math.imul(s^s>>>15,1|s);
    t=t+Math.imul(t^t>>>7,61|t)^t;
    return((t^t>>>14)>>>0)/4294967296;
  };
}

// Stable integer hash of a string (country name) → u32 seed
function hashStr(str){
  let h=0x811c9dc5;
  for(let i=0;i<str.length;i++){h=Math.imul(h^str.charCodeAt(i),0x01000193);}
  return h>>>0;
}

// ── PROVINCE NAMING ───────────────────────────────────────────────
function sampleArr(arr,n){const out=[];const step=Math.max(1,Math.floor(arr.length/n));for(let i=0;i<arr.length&&out.length<n;i+=step)out.push(arr[i]);return out}
