// ── HISTORICAL PROVINCE MATCHING ─────────────────────────────────
// Exclusive 1-to-1 assignment: each historical point goes to its
// single nearest province centroid. No two points share a centroid.
// buildHistAssignment() is called ONCE per country after all Voronoi
// centroids are known, returning a Map<cellIndex → name>.

let _histTileCache = null;
function buildHistTileCache(){
  _histTileCache = {};
  for(const [country, pts] of Object.entries(HIST_PROVINCES)){
    _histTileCache[country] = pts.map(pt => {
      const px = proj([pt.lon, pt.lat]);
      return px ? {tx: px[0], ty: px[1], name: pt.name} : null;
    }).filter(Boolean);
  }
}

// centroids: array of {cx,cy} — one per valid Voronoi cell (nulls excluded).
// Returns Map<centroidIndex, name>.
function buildHistAssignment(countryName, centroids){
  if(!_histTileCache) return new Map();
  const pts = _histTileCache[countryName];
  if(!pts || !pts.length || !centroids.length) return new Map();

  // Historical points must never silently disappear just because two points pick
  // the same nearest generated cell. Build the complete point↔cell candidate list,
  // then greedily take the globally closest free pair. Since loadProvinces keeps at
  // least pts.length cells, every historical point receives one unique province.
  const candidates=[];
  for(let pi=0;pi<pts.length;pi++){
    const p=pts[pi];
    for(let ci=0;ci<centroids.length;ci++){
      const c=centroids[ci],dx=c.cx-p.tx,dy=c.cy-p.ty;
      candidates.push({pi,ci,d:dx*dx+dy*dy});
    }
  }
  candidates.sort((a,b)=>a.d-b.d||a.pi-b.pi||a.ci-b.ci);
  const result=new Map(),usedCells=new Uint8Array(centroids.length),usedPts=new Uint8Array(pts.length);
  let assigned=0;
  for(let i=0;i<candidates.length&&assigned<pts.length;i++){
    const {pi,ci}=candidates[i];
    if(usedPts[pi]||usedCells[ci])continue;
    result.set(ci,pts[pi].name);usedPts[pi]=1;usedCells[ci]=1;assigned++;
  }
  return result;
}

function makeProvinceName(co, provRelX, provRelY, idx, total){
  const ax=Math.abs(provRelX), ay=Math.abs(provRelY);
  let dir;
  if(total<=2){
    dir = provRelX<-0.15?'Western':provRelX>0.15?'Eastern':provRelY<0?'Northern':'Southern';
  } else if(ax<0.12&&ay<0.12){
    dir='Central';
  } else if(ay>ax*1.4){
    dir=provRelY<0?'Northern':'Southern';
  } else if(ax>ay*1.4){
    dir=provRelX<0?'Western':'Eastern';
  } else {
    const ns=provRelY<0?'North':'South';
    const ew=provRelX<0?'west':'east';
    dir=ns+ew;
  }
  const short=(co?.name||'Unknown').split(' ')[0].slice(0,10);
  return `${dir} ${short}`;
}

// Legacy helper retained for API/save-tool compatibility; startup no longer calls it.
function lloydRelax(seedTxArr, seedTyArr, tiles, iterations){
  const k = seedTxArr.length;
  const sX = seedTxArr.slice(); // float working copies
  const sY = seedTyArr.slice();

  for(let iter=0; iter<iterations; iter++){
    const sumX = new Float64Array(k);
    const sumY = new Float64Array(k);
    const cnt  = new Int32Array(k);

    for(const ti of tiles){
      const tx2 = ti % WORLD_W, ty2 = Math.floor(ti / WORLD_W);
      let best=0, bestD=Infinity;
      for(let si=0; si<k; si++){
        const d=(tx2-sX[si])**2+(ty2-sY[si])**2;
        if(d<bestD){bestD=d;best=si;}
      }
      sumX[best]+=tx2; sumY[best]+=ty2; cnt[best]++;
    }

    for(let si=0; si<k; si++){
      if(cnt[si]>0){ sX[si]=sumX[si]/cnt[si]; sY[si]=sumY[si]/cnt[si]; }
    }
  }

  // Snap to nearest land tile — strict < ensures lowest tile-index wins on tie
  for(let si=0; si<k; si++){
    let best=tiles[0], bestD=Infinity;
    for(const ti of tiles){
      const tx2=ti%WORLD_W, ty2=Math.floor(ti/WORLD_W);
      const d=(tx2-sX[si])**2+(ty2-sY[si])**2;
      if(d<bestD){bestD=d;best=ti;}
    }
    seedTxArr[si]=best%WORLD_W;
    seedTyArr[si]=Math.floor(best/WORLD_W);
  }
}

// ── FAST DETERMINISTIC PROVINCE PARTITIONING ─────────────────────
// The previous full-world generator did five all-seed Lloyd passes plus a final
// all-seed Voronoi pass. With ~35 tiles/province that becomes O(N*k) and explodes
// for continental countries. This replacement chooses spatially stratified seeds
// and grows them simultaneously over the country's 4-neighbour land graph: near O(N).
let _partitionAssign=null;
let _partitionQueue=null;
function _ensurePartitionScratch(){
  const N=WORLD_W*WORLD_H;
  if(!_partitionAssign||_partitionAssign.length!==N){_partitionAssign=new Int32Array(N);_partitionAssign.fill(-1);}
  if(!_partitionQueue||_partitionQueue.length!==N)_partitionQueue=new Int32Array(N);
}
function _tileBounds(tiles){
  let minX=WORLD_W,maxX=0,minY=WORLD_H,maxY=0;
  for(let j=0;j<tiles.length;j++){const ti=tiles[j],x=ti%WORLD_W,y=(ti/WORLD_W)|0;if(x<minX)minX=x;if(x>maxX)maxX=x;if(y<minY)minY=y;if(y>maxY)maxY=y;}
  return {minX,maxX,minY,maxY};
}
function _stratifiedSeeds(tiles,k,bounds,salt=0){
  if(!tiles.length)return [];
  if(k<=1)return [tiles[(hashStr(String(salt))%tiles.length)>>>0]];
  const {minX,maxX,minY,maxY}=bounds,w=Math.max(1,maxX-minX+1),h=Math.max(1,maxY-minY+1);
  let cols=Math.max(1,Math.round(Math.sqrt(k*w/h)));
  let rows=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(k/cols));
  while(cols*rows<k)rows++;
  const bins=cols*rows,best=new Int32Array(bins);best.fill(-1);
  const bestD=new Float64Array(bins);bestD.fill(Infinity);
  const rng=makeRng((hashStr(String(salt))^tiles.length^k)>>>0);
  const jx=new Float32Array(bins),jy=new Float32Array(bins);
  for(let b=0;b<bins;b++){jx[b]=(rng()-.5)*.44;jy[b]=(rng()-.5)*.44;}
  for(let j=0;j<tiles.length;j++){
    const ti=tiles[j],x=ti%WORLD_W,y=(ti/WORLD_W)|0;
    const bx=Math.min(cols-1,Math.max(0,Math.floor((x-minX)*cols/w)));
    const by=Math.min(rows-1,Math.max(0,Math.floor((y-minY)*rows/h)));
    const b=by*cols+bx;
    const cx=minX+(bx+.5+jx[b])*(w/cols),cy=minY+(by+.5+jy[b])*(h/rows);
    const dx=x-cx,dy=y-cy,d=dx*dx+dy*dy;
    if(d<bestD[b]){bestD[b]=d;best[b]=ti;}
  }
  const seeds=[],seen=new Set();
  for(let b=0;b<bins;b++){const ti=best[b];if(ti>=0&&!seen.has(ti)){seen.add(ti);seeds.push(ti);}}
  // Irregular coastlines/archipelagos can leave empty spatial bins. Fill any shortfall
  // from deterministic quantiles of the already row-major tile list.
  if(seeds.length<k){
    const need=k-seeds.length,step=tiles.length/Math.max(1,need);
    for(let n=0;n<need&&seeds.length<k;n++){
      let pos=Math.min(tiles.length-1,Math.floor((n+.5)*step)),tries=0,ti=tiles[pos];
      while(seen.has(ti)&&tries<tiles.length){pos=(pos+1)%tiles.length;ti=tiles[pos];tries++;}
      if(!seen.has(ti)){seen.add(ti);seeds.push(ti);}
    }
  }
  // A few extra occupied bins are harmless but would shrink provinces. Keep k
  // representatives spread uniformly through the candidate list.
  if(seeds.length>k){
    const out=[];const step=seeds.length/k;for(let i=0;i<k;i++)out.push(seeds[Math.min(seeds.length-1,Math.floor((i+.5)*step))]);return out;
  }
  return seeds;
}
function _growPartition(tiles,seeds,acceptIndex){
  _ensurePartitionScratch();
  const a=_partitionAssign,q=_partitionQueue;
  for(let j=0;j<tiles.length;j++)a[tiles[j]]=-1;
  let head=0,tail=0;
  for(let si=0;si<seeds.length;si++){const ti=seeds[si];if(a[ti]>=0)continue;a[ti]=si;q[tail++]=ti;}
  const flood=()=>{
    while(head<tail){
      const ti=q[head++],owner=a[ti],x=ti%WORLD_W,y=(ti/WORLD_W)|0;
      let ni;
      if(x>0){ni=ti-1;if(a[ni]<0&&acceptIndex(ni))a[ni]=owner,q[tail++]=ni;}
      if(x<WORLD_W-1){ni=ti+1;if(a[ni]<0&&acceptIndex(ni))a[ni]=owner,q[tail++]=ni;}
      if(y>0){ni=ti-WORLD_W;if(a[ni]<0&&acceptIndex(ni))a[ni]=owner,q[tail++]=ni;}
      if(y<WORLD_H-1){ni=ti+WORLD_W;if(a[ni]<0&&acceptIndex(ni))a[ni]=owner,q[tail++]=ni;}
    }
  };
  flood();
  // Guarantee disconnected islands/components are never dropped. They become an
  // extra province only when no requested seed could reach them.
  let seedCount=seeds.length;
  for(let j=0;j<tiles.length;j++){
    const ti=tiles[j];if(a[ti]>=0)continue;
    head=0;tail=0;a[ti]=seedCount++;q[tail++]=ti;flood();
  }
  const groups=Array.from({length:seedCount},()=>[]);
  for(let j=0;j<tiles.length;j++){const ti=tiles[j],g=a[ti];if(g>=0)groups[g].push(ti);}
  return groups;
}
function _mergeTinyGroups(groups,minTiles,acceptIndex,minGroups=1){
  if(minTiles<=1)return groups;
  const a=_partitionAssign;
  let active=0;for(let g=0;g<groups.length;g++)if(groups[g].length)active++;
  for(let g=0;g<groups.length&&active>minGroups;g++){
    const src=groups[g];if(!src.length||src.length>=minTiles)continue;
    const counts=new Map();
    for(const ti of src){
      const x=ti%WORLD_W,y=(ti/WORLD_W)|0;
      let ni;
      if(x>0){ni=ti-1;if(acceptIndex(ni)){const ng=a[ni];if(ng>=0&&ng!==g)counts.set(ng,(counts.get(ng)||0)+1);}}
      if(x<WORLD_W-1){ni=ti+1;if(acceptIndex(ni)){const ng=a[ni];if(ng>=0&&ng!==g)counts.set(ng,(counts.get(ng)||0)+1);}}
      if(y>0){ni=ti-WORLD_W;if(acceptIndex(ni)){const ng=a[ni];if(ng>=0&&ng!==g)counts.set(ng,(counts.get(ng)||0)+1);}}
      if(y<WORLD_H-1){ni=ti+WORLD_W;if(acceptIndex(ni)){const ng=a[ni];if(ng>=0&&ng!==g)counts.set(ng,(counts.get(ng)||0)+1);}}
    }
    let best=-1,bestN=0;for(const [ng,n] of counts)if(n>bestN&&groups[ng]?.length){best=ng;bestN=n;}
    if(best<0)continue;
    for(const ti of src){a[ti]=best;groups[best].push(ti);}src.length=0;active--;
  }
  return groups;
}

async function loadProvinces(){
  const N=WORLD_W*WORLD_H;
  tileProvMap = new Int32Array(N);tileProvMap.fill(-1);
  setLoad(58,'Generating provinces…');

  // Country tile lists were collected while the atlas was rasterised; this avoids
  // another 1.7M-tile map scan and avoids sorting already row-major pixels.
  const cTiles=_countryLandTiles||[];
  const cids=[];for(let cid=0;cid<cTiles.length;cid++)if(cTiles[cid]?.length)cids.push(cid);

  for(let ci=0;ci<cids.length;ci++){
    const cid=cids[ci],tiles=cTiles[cid],co=countries[cid];
    const bounds=_tileBounds(tiles);
    const {minX,maxX,minY,maxY}=bounds;
    let sx=0,sy=0;for(let j=0;j<tiles.length;j++){const ti=tiles[j];sx+=ti%WORLD_W;sy+=(ti/WORLD_W)|0;}
    const ccx=sx/tiles.length,ccy=sy/tiles.length;
    const extX=Math.max(1,(maxX-minX)/2),extY=Math.max(1,(maxY-minY)/2);
    const histPtCount=(_histTileCache?.[co?.name||'']?.length)||0;
    const k=Math.max(1,Math.max(Math.round(tiles.length/VORONOI_TARGET),Math.round(Math.hypot(maxX-minX,maxY-minY)/28),histPtCount));

    const seeds=_stratifiedSeeds(tiles,k,bounds,co?.name||cid);
    let groups=_growPartition(tiles,seeds,ni=>tileKindBuf[ni]===1&&tileCountryBuf[ni]===cid);
    groups=_mergeTinyGroups(groups,3,ni=>tileKindBuf[ni]===1&&tileCountryBuf[ni]===cid,Math.max(1,histPtCount));

    const cellCentroids=new Array(groups.length).fill(null);
    for(let i=0;i<groups.length;i++){
      const pt=groups[i];if(!pt.length)continue;let xsum=0,ysum=0,minPX=WORLD_W,maxPX=0,minPY=WORLD_H,maxPY=0;
      for(let j=0;j<pt.length;j++){const ti=pt[j],x=ti%WORLD_W,y=(ti/WORLD_W)|0;xsum+=x;ysum+=y;if(x<minPX)minPX=x;if(x>maxPX)maxPX=x;if(y<minPY)minPY=y;if(y>maxPY)maxPY=y;}
      cellCentroids[i]={cx:xsum/pt.length,cy:ysum/pt.length,minX:minPX,maxX:maxPX,minY:minPY,maxY:maxPY};
    }
    const validCellIdx=[],validCentroids=[];
    for(let i=0;i<cellCentroids.length;i++)if(cellCentroids[i]){validCellIdx.push(i);validCentroids.push(cellCentroids[i]);}
    const rawAssign=buildHistAssignment(co?.name||'',validCentroids),histName=new Map();
    rawAssign.forEach((name,vi)=>histName.set(validCellIdx[vi],name));

    const usedNames={};
    for(let i=0;i<groups.length;i++){
      const pt=groups[i],cc=cellCentroids[i];if(!pt.length||!cc)continue;
      const pid=provinces.length,relX=(cc.cx-ccx)/extX,relY=(cc.cy-ccy)/extY;
      const baseName=histName.get(i)||makeProvinceName(co,relX,relY,i,groups.length);
      let name=baseName;if(usedNames[baseName]){usedNames[baseName]++;name=baseName+' '+usedNames[baseName];}else usedNames[baseName]=1;
      for(let j=0;j<pt.length;j++)tileProvMap[pt[j]]=pid;
      provinces.push({id:pid,countryId:cid,name,centerTx:Math.round(cc.cx),centerTy:Math.round(cc.cy),
        minX:cc.minX,maxX:cc.maxX,minY:cc.minY,maxY:cc.maxY,tiles:pt,
        bld:{farm:0,sawmill:0,mine:0,market:0,barracks:0,fort:0,tower:0}});
    }

    // The source-country tile list has now been partitioned into province tiles.
    // Release it immediately instead of retaining both representations until startup ends.
    cTiles[cid]=null;
    if(ci%12===0){setLoad(58+Math.round(ci/cids.length*18),`Provinces: ${co?.name||'…'}`);await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,0));}
  }
}

// Compact static edge table used by all dynamic political-border rebuilds.
// Record layout: [landPid, neighbourPidOrMinus1, x1, y1, x2, y2].
// Building it once here turns conquest-time border updates from a 1.728M-tile scan
// into a pass over province/coast boundary edges only.
let _territoryEdgeData=null;

// Compact immutable province graph for hot-path traversal. provAdj remains the
// compatibility/source-of-truth Map<Set>; these arrays preserve exactly the same
// neighbor insertion order while avoiding Map/Set iterator/hash overhead in BFS,
// AI, editor brushes, and border/front queries.
let _adjOffsets=new Int32Array(0),_adjList=new Int32Array(0);
function _buildAdjCSR(){
  const n=provinces.length;
  const offsets=new Int32Array(n+1);let total=0;
  for(let pid=0;pid<n;pid++){offsets[pid]=total;const a=provAdj.get(pid);if(a)total+=a.size;}
  offsets[n]=total;
  const list=new Int32Array(total);let k=0;
  for(let pid=0;pid<n;pid++){const a=provAdj.get(pid);if(a)for(const v of a)list[k++]=v;}
  _adjOffsets=offsets;_adjList=list;
}
function _adjBegin(pid){return (pid>=0&&pid+1<_adjOffsets.length)?_adjOffsets[pid]:0;}
function _adjEnd(pid){return (pid>=0&&pid+1<_adjOffsets.length)?_adjOffsets[pid+1]:0;}

function computeAdjacency(){
  provAdj=new Map();
  const pSeg=[],cSeg=[],seaSeg=[],terrEdges=[];
  const N=WORLD_W*WORLD_H;
  const addAdj=(a,b)=>{
    if(a<0||b<0||a===b)return;
    if(!provAdj.has(a))provAdj.set(a,new Set());
    if(!provAdj.has(b))provAdj.set(b,new Set());
    provAdj.get(a).add(b);provAdj.get(b).add(a);
  };
  const addEdge=(iA,iB,x1,y1,x2,y2)=>{
    const pA=tileProvMap[iA],pB=tileProvMap[iB];
    const kindA=tileKindBuf[iA],kindB=tileKindBuf[iB];
    addAdj(pA,pB);

    const landA=pA>=0&&kindA===1&&!provinces[pA]?.isSea;
    const landB=pB>=0&&kindB===1&&!provinces[pB]?.isSea;
    const seaA=pA>=0&&!!provinces[pA]?.isSea;
    const seaB=pB>=0&&!!provinces[pB]?.isSea;

    // Static province/country edges are land↔land only. Dynamic territory edges
    // also include coastlines, regardless of whether land happens to be the A or B
    // side of this right/down scan. The previous optimized graph only kept edges
    // when A was land, dropping roughly half of orientation-dependent coast edges.
    if(landA&&landB){
      if(tileCountryBuf[iA]===tileCountryBuf[iB]){if(pA!==pB)pSeg.push(x1,y1,x2,y2);}
      else cSeg.push(x1,y1,x2,y2);
    }
    if(pA!==pB&&(landA||landB)) terrEdges.push(pA,pB,x1,y1,x2,y2);

    // Sea-zone boundaries should likewise be orientation-independent.
    if(pA!==pB&&(seaA||seaB)) seaSeg.push(x1,y1,x2,y2);
  };

  for(let i=0;i<N;i++){
    const x=i%WORLD_W,y=(i/WORLD_W)|0;
    if(x<WORLD_W-1)addEdge(i,i+1,x+1,y,x+1,y+1);
    if(y<WORLD_H-1)addEdge(i,i+WORLD_W,x,y+1,x+1,y+1);
  }
  _buildAdjCSR();
  _provBorderSegs=new Float32Array(pSeg);_provBorderPathChunks=null;
  _countryBorderSegs=new Float32Array(cSeg);_countryBorderPathChunks=null;
  _seaBorderSegs=new Float32Array(seaSeg);_seaBorderPathChunks=null;
  _territoryEdgeData=new Int32Array(terrEdges);_territoryEdgeChunkStore=null;
  _tbChunkAllPaths.clear();_tbChunkPlayerPaths.clear();_tbTargetedDirty=false;
  _invalidateStaticBorderTexture();
}

// ── SEA PROVINCE NAMES — geographic full-world anchors ───────────
// Stored in lon/lat so labels stay correct under any projection or viewport.
const _SEA_ZONE_NAMES=[
  {lon:16,lat:36,r:18,name:'Mediterranean Sea'},{lon:34,lat:43,r:8,name:'Black Sea'},
  {lon:4,lat:56,r:8,name:'North Sea'},{lon:20,lat:58,r:8,name:'Baltic Sea'},
  {lon:3,lat:67,r:10,name:'Norwegian Sea'},{lon:38,lat:74,r:12,name:'Barents Sea'},
  {lon:52,lat:42,r:8,name:'Caspian Sea'},{lon:39,lat:20,r:9,name:'Red Sea'},
  {lon:52,lat:26,r:7,name:'Persian Gulf'},{lon:-90,lat:25,r:10,name:'Gulf of Mexico'},
  {lon:-74,lat:16,r:14,name:'Caribbean Sea'},{lon:-42,lat:40,r:34,name:'North Atlantic Ocean'},
  {lon:-20,lat:-25,r:32,name:'South Atlantic Ocean'},{lon:-160,lat:32,r:42,name:'North Pacific Ocean'},
  {lon:-125,lat:-25,r:42,name:'South Pacific Ocean'},{lon:78,lat:-18,r:38,name:'Indian Ocean'},
  {lon:0,lat:82,r:28,name:'Arctic Ocean'},{lon:0,lat:-66,r:36,name:'Southern Ocean'},
  {lon:57,lat:17,r:16,name:'Arabian Sea'},{lon:88,lat:15,r:15,name:'Bay of Bengal'},
  {lon:94,lat:10,r:9,name:'Andaman Sea'},{lon:108,lat:14,r:14,name:'South China Sea'},
  {lon:126,lat:30,r:10,name:'East China Sea'},{lon:125,lat:37,r:7,name:'Yellow Sea'},
  {lon:134,lat:40,r:9,name:'Sea of Japan'},{lon:132,lat:18,r:15,name:'Philippine Sea'},
  {lon:166,lat:-17,r:17,name:'Coral Sea'},{lon:158,lat:-40,r:15,name:'Tasman Sea'},
  {lon:130,lat:-10,r:10,name:'Arafura Sea'},{lon:125,lat:-15,r:9,name:'Timor Sea'},
  {lon:111,lat:-6,r:8,name:'Java Sea'},{lon:-3,lat:2,r:15,name:'Gulf of Guinea'},
  {lon:42,lat:-18,r:10,name:'Mozambique Channel'},{lon:-175,lat:58,r:12,name:'Bering Sea'},
  {lon:-68,lat:54,r:10,name:'Labrador Sea'},{lon:-35,lat:67,r:12,name:'Greenland Sea'},
  {lon:15,lat:44,r:6,name:'Adriatic Sea'},{lon:25,lat:39,r:6,name:'Aegean Sea'},
  {lon:16,lat:55,r:5,name:'Kattegat'},
];
function _seaZoneName(cx,cy){
  if(!proj?.invert)return 'Sea Zone';
  const ll=proj.invert([cx,cy]);if(!ll)return 'Sea Zone';
  const lon=ll[0],lat=ll[1];let best=null,bestD=Infinity;
  for(const z of _SEA_ZONE_NAMES){
    let dx=Math.abs(lon-z.lon);if(dx>180)dx=360-dx;dx*=Math.cos((lat+z.lat)*Math.PI/360);
    const dy=lat-z.lat,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
    if(d<z.r&&d<bestD){bestD=d;best=z;}
  }
  return best?best.name:'Sea Zone';
}

// ── SEA PROVINCE GENERATION ───────────────────────────────────────
// Creates navigable sea provinces out of significant water bodies.
// Sea provinces are passable by all divisions, uncaptureable, and
// combat inside them runs at near-normal speed (naval attrition, ~5x slower movement only).
function generateSeaProvinces(){
  const N=WORLD_W*WORLD_H;
  const visited=new Uint8Array(N),q=_partitionQueue&&_partitionQueue.length===N?_partitionQueue:new Int32Array(N);
  _partitionQueue=q;
  const SEA_PROV_TARGET=700;
  let seaCount=0;

  // Flood one connected water body at a time using a typed queue. The previous
  // implementation then ran k-means++ over million-tile oceans (O(N*k²)).
  // We instead spatially seed + multi-source grow each body (near O(N)).
  for(let start=0;start<N;start++){
    if(visited[start]||!validTile[start]||tileKindBuf[start]===1)continue;
    let head=0,tail=0;q[tail++]=start;visited[start]=1;
    let minX=WORLD_W,maxX=0,minY=WORLD_H,maxY=0;
    const adjLand=new Set();
    while(head<tail){
      const ti=q[head++];const x=ti%WORLD_W,y=(ti/WORLD_W)|0;
      if(x<minX)minX=x;if(x>maxX)maxX=x;if(y<minY)minY=y;if(y>maxY)maxY=y;
      let ni;
      if(x>0){ni=ti-1;if(tileKindBuf[ni]===1){const p=tileProvMap[ni];if(p>=0)adjLand.add(p);}else if(validTile[ni]&&!visited[ni])visited[ni]=1,q[tail++]=ni;}
      if(x<WORLD_W-1){ni=ti+1;if(tileKindBuf[ni]===1){const p=tileProvMap[ni];if(p>=0)adjLand.add(p);}else if(validTile[ni]&&!visited[ni])visited[ni]=1,q[tail++]=ni;}
      if(y>0){ni=ti-WORLD_W;if(tileKindBuf[ni]===1){const p=tileProvMap[ni];if(p>=0)adjLand.add(p);}else if(validTile[ni]&&!visited[ni])visited[ni]=1,q[tail++]=ni;}
      if(y<WORLD_H-1){ni=ti+WORLD_W;if(tileKindBuf[ni]===1){const p=tileProvMap[ni];if(p>=0)adjLand.add(p);}else if(validTile[ni]&&!visited[ni])visited[ni]=1,q[tail++]=ni;}
    }
    if(tail<120||adjLand.size<2)continue;
    const body=new Uint32Array(tail);body.set(q.subarray(0,tail));
    const k=Math.max(1,Math.round(body.length/SEA_PROV_TARGET));
    const bounds={minX,maxX,minY,maxY};
    const seeds=_stratifiedSeeds(body,k,bounds,'sea:'+start+':'+body.length);
    let groups=_growPartition(body,seeds,ni=>validTile[ni]&&tileKindBuf[ni]===0);
    groups=_mergeTinyGroups(groups,30,ni=>validTile[ni]&&tileKindBuf[ni]===0);
    for(const tiles of groups){
      if(!tiles.length)continue;let sx=0,sy=0,pMinX=WORLD_W,pMaxX=0,pMinY=WORLD_H,pMaxY=0;
      for(let j=0;j<tiles.length;j++){const ti=tiles[j],x=ti%WORLD_W,y=(ti/WORLD_W)|0;sx+=x;sy+=y;if(x<pMinX)pMinX=x;if(x>pMaxX)pMaxX=x;if(y<pMinY)pMinY=y;if(y>pMaxY)pMaxY=y;}
      const cx=sx/tiles.length,cy=sy/tiles.length,pid=provinces.length;
      provinces.push({id:pid,countryId:-1,isSea:true,name:_seaZoneName(cx,cy),centerTx:Math.round(cx),centerTy:Math.round(cy),
        minX:pMinX,maxX:pMaxX,minY:pMinY,maxY:pMaxY,tiles,
        bld:{farm:0,sawmill:0,mine:0,market:0,barracks:0,fort:0,tower:0}});
      for(let j=0;j<tiles.length;j++)tileProvMap[tiles[j]]=pid;
      seaCount++;
    }
  }
  console.log(`Generated ${seaCount} sea provinces (fast partitioner)`);
}

// ── CIVILISATION INIT ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// Determine resource base for a civ based on how many provinces they have
function civStartRes(provCount){
  const base=100+provCount*4;
  return {wood:base,stone:Math.round(base*.8),food:Math.round(base*1.2),coins:Math.round(base*.6)};
}

// Seed starting buildings into a civ's provinces (HOI4-style: scattered industry)
function seedBuildings(civ){
  const pids=Array.from(civ.ownedProvs);
  // Capital = first province found; gets hall + level-2 farm
  const cap=provinces[pids[0]];
  cap.bld.farm=2;
  // Distribute random buildings across provinces
  const rng=(n)=>Math.floor(Math.random()*n);
  for(const pid of pids){
    const p=provinces[pid];
    const r=Math.random();
    if(r<0.30){p.bld.farm=Math.max(p.bld.farm,1);}
    else if(r<0.52){p.bld.mine=1;}
    else if(r<0.68){p.bld.sawmill=1;}
    else if(r<0.76){p.bld.market=1;}
    // Large countries get more level-2 buildings
    if(pids.length>20&&Math.random()<0.12){
      const upgCands=ECON_BLDS.filter(b=>p.bld[b]===1);
      if(upgCands.length) p.bld[upgCands[rng(upgCands.length)]]=2;
    }
    // Occasional military
    if(Math.random()<0.08) p.bld.barracks=1;
    if(Math.random()<0.05) p.bld.fort=1;
  }
}

function initCivs(){
  civs.length=0;
  const byCountry=Array.from({length:countries.length},()=>[]);
  for(let pid=0;pid<provinces.length;pid++){const cid=provinces[pid].countryId;if(cid>=0&&cid<byCountry.length)byCountry[cid].push(pid);}
  provOwner=new Int16Array(provinces.length);provOwner.fill(-1);

  for(let cid=0;cid<byCountry.length;cid++){
    const pids=byCountry[cid],co=countries[cid];if(!co||!pids.length)continue;
    const civId=civs.length,terrAbgr=hexToAbgr(lighten(co.color,.20));
    const civ={id:civId,countryId:cid,name:co.name,color:co.color,terrAbgr,borderAbgr:hexToAbgr(lighten(co.color,.35)),
      res:civStartRes(pids.length),ownedProvs:new Set(pids),territory:new LazyTerritorySet(pids),foxes:[],spawnTick:0,isPlayer:false,customNation:false,_moveMul:1,
      _territoryVersion:1,_cd:{base:co.color,baseD:darken(co.color,.22),helm:darken(co.color,.38),helmD:darken(darken(co.color,.38),.12),lite:lighten(co.color,.50)}};
    civs.push(civ);
    for(const pid of pids){
      provOwner[pid]=civId;const tiles=provinces[pid].tiles;
      for(let j=0;j<tiles.length;j++){const ti=tiles[j];tileCivBuf[ti]=civId;ownedColorBuf[ti]=terrAbgr;}
    }
    seedBuildings(civ);
  }
  _botAliveListDirty=true;_botWarCacheDirty=true;_markAllBotStrategyDirty();
  _markWorldFullDirty();_hlDirty=true;
}

let _suppressWarContribution=false;
// Event-driven capitulation check: only nations that actually lose their final province
// are reconsidered, instead of rescanning every civ in every active war every combat tick.
const _warConclusionCandidates=new Set();
const _warConclusionScratch=[];
function civClaimProvince(pid,civId){
  if(provOwner[pid]===civId) return;
  const prev=provOwner[pid];
  const _audioWarCapture=gameReady&&!_suppressWarContribution&&prev>=0&&civId>=0&&areAtWar(prev,civId);
  const _audioMajorCapture=_audioWarCapture&&civs[prev]&&civs[prev].ownedProvs.size<=2;
  _touchRouteOwnership(prev,civId);_invalidateSafeIncoming(pid);_wakeBlockedIncoming(pid);
  // Wartime captures contribute only to bot-vs-bot automatic victor weighting.
  if(!_suppressWarContribution && prev>=0 && civId>=0 && areAtWar(prev,civId)){
    _recordWarContribution(civId, prev, pid);
    _trackAnnihilationCapture(prev,civId,pid);
  }
  if(prev>=0){
    civs[prev]._territoryVersion=((civs[prev]._territoryVersion||1)+1)>>>0||1;
    civs[prev].ownedProvs.delete(pid);
    civs[prev].territory.deleteProvince?.(pid);
    if(civs[prev].ownedProvs.size===0)_warConclusionCandidates.add(prev);
    restoreProvUnownedColor(pid);
  }
  provOwner[pid]=civId;
  if(civId>=0){
    civs[civId]._territoryVersion=((civs[civId]._territoryVersion||1)+1)>>>0||1;
    civs[civId].ownedProvs.add(pid);
    civs[civId].territory.addProvince?.(pid);
    bakeProvOwnedColor(pid,civId);
    burst(tcx(provinces[pid].centerTx),tcy(provinces[pid].centerTy),civs[civId].color);
  }
  _markBotStrategyAround(pid,prev,civId);
  if(playerAutoMoveUniversal&&playerCivId>=0){
    const touchesPlayerSide=(prev===playerCivId||civId===playerCivId||(prev>=0&&(areAllied(playerCivId,prev)||areAtWar(playerCivId,prev)))||(civId>=0&&(areAllied(playerCivId,civId)||areAtWar(playerCivId,civId))));
    if(touchesPlayerSide)_markPlayerArmyPlanDirty(false);
  }
  _botWarCacheDirty=true;_botAliveListDirty=true;
  _markTerritoryProvinceBorderDirty(pid); // invalidate only border chunks touching this province
  _allianceLabelDirty=true;  // alliance label positions change when territory changes
  _alOverlayDirty=true;  // alliance color overlay needs rebuild too
  _allianceBorderDirty=true; // also invalidate alliance border (territory changed)
  _civLabelDirty=true;   // invalidate HOI4 label positions
  _markCapitalsDirty();
  _econOwnershipChanged(pid,prev,civId); // O(1) aggregate transfer instead of rescanning the world
  if(prev===playerCivId||civId===playerCivId)_markUpgradeMetaDirty();
  // Invalidate BOTH raw and Path2D country-outline caches. Keeping the Path2D
  // cache alive here used to draw a ghost of the nation's original border after
  // provinces changed ownership. Selection must always follow CURRENT ownership.
  if(prev>=0) _invalidateCivOutline(prev);
  if(civId>=0) _invalidateCivOutline(civId);
  // No generic capture impact here: undefended movement must sound like marching,
  // while actual fighting is sonified exclusively by tickCombat() -> AudioEngine.battle().
}

let selectedCivId=-1; // kept for legacy compat
function buildSelectGrid(filter=''){ buildCountryBar(filter); } // shim


// ── STARTING TECHS (Modern Day) ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// Each tier represents a real-world technology level bracket.
// We give the PLAYER the techs matching their chosen nation's level.
// Tier definitions (cumulative within each tree):
//
// ECONOMIC tiers (cumulative):
//   tier1: farm1,wood1,stone1,trade1
//   tier2: +farm2,wood2,stone2,trade2
//   tier3: +farm3,surplus,banking
//   tier4: +steam1,rail1,steel1,mfg1
//   tier5: +oil1,elec1,chem1,tele1
//   tier6: +nuke_eng,dig1,ai1,biotech1
//
// MILITARY tiers (cumulative):
//   mil1: gun1,arm1,bot1,spc1
//   mil2: +gun2,arm2,bot2,spc2
//   mil3: +gun3,arm3,bot3,spc3,air1
//   mil4: +gun4,arm4,bot4,spc4,air2
//   mil5: +gun5,arm5,bot5,spc5,air3,wmd1
//   mil6: +gun6,arm6,bot6,spc6,air4,wmd2
//   mil7: +air5,wmd3
//   mil8: +air6,wmd4,wmd5,wmd6  (nuclear powers only)

const _ECON_TIERS = [
  ['farm1','wood1','stone1','trade1'],
  ['farm2','wood2','stone2','trade2'],
  ['farm3','surplus','banking'],
  ['steam1','rail1','steel1','mfg1'],
  ['oil1','elec1','chem1','tele1'],
  ['nuke_eng','dig1','ai1','biotech1'],
  ['syn1','nano1','fusion1','qcomp1'],       // Tier VII — Near-Future
  ['dyson1','mind1','matter1','warp1'],       // Tier VIII — Far Future
  ['omega1','singularity1','cosmos1','void1'], // Tier IX — Transcendent
  ['stellar_econ','quantum_trade'],             // Tier X — Celestial
  ['dim_forge','postscarcity'],                 // Tier XI — Dimensional
  ['ascendant_econ','infinite_exchange'],       // Tier XII — Ascendant
];
const _MIL_TIERS = [
  ['gun1','arm1','bot1','spc1'],
  ['gun2','arm2','bot2','spc2'],
  ['gun3','arm3','bot3','spc3','air1'],
  ['gun4','arm4','bot4','spc4','air2'],
  ['gun5','arm5','bot5','spc5','air3','wmd1'],
  ['gun6','arm6','bot6','spc6','air4','wmd2'],
  ['air5','wmd3'],
  ['air6','wmd4','wmd5','wmd6'],
  ['gun7','arm7','bot7','spc7','air7','wmd7'],  // Tier IX  — Near-Future
  ['gun8','arm8','bot8','spc8','air8','wmd8'],  // Tier X   — Far Future
  ['gun9','arm9','bot9','spc9','air9','wmd9'],  // Tier XI  — Transcendent
];

// Returns array of tech IDs for econ tier 1..N (cumulative) + mil tier 1..M (cumulative)
function _buildTechSet(econTier, milTier){
  const ids = [];
  for(let i=0;i<econTier;i++) ids.push(..._ECON_TIERS[i]);
  for(let i=0;i<milTier;i++) ids.push(..._MIL_TIERS[i]);
  return ids;
}
